missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸及馆方或学术来源对画面质量和艺术家代表性的资料；若作品质量或代表性不同，会改变当前价值判断。
missing.en: An image, dimensions, and museum or scholarly evidence concerning the work’s quality and representativeness of the artist are missing; different evidence could change the current value assessment.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 荷兰19世纪风景画收藏中的定位及与同类作品的比较，无法支撑其作为组内唯一对象的代表性判断。
missing.en: Its position within MFA’s nineteenth-century Dutch landscape holdings and comparison with related works are missing, so its claimed representativeness as the only object in the group cannot be supported.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录和馆藏编号，也缺作品在馆内荷兰19世纪风景画收藏中的定位。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the MFA official record and accession number, together with the work’s position within the museum’s nineteenth-century Dutch landscape holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认题名、梅曲归属、1660年断代和油彩媒材；尤其缺馆方对“索福尼斯巴之死”题名假说的说明。归属或题材识别不同会改变作品的历史叙事价值。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the title, attribution to Metsu, 1660 date, and oil medium is missing; in particular, the museum’s explanation of the “Death of Sophonisba” title hypothesis is absent. A different attribution or subject identification would change the work’s narrative and historical value.

missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸及馆方或学术来源对其艺术质量、完成度和梅曲作品中的代表性的资料；这些事实若不同，会改变当前价值判断。
missing.en: An image, dimensions, and museum or scholarly evidence concerning its quality, finish, and representativeness among Metsu’s works are missing; different facts could change the current value assessment.

missing.zh: 缺与 MFA 馆内其他梅曲作品及荷兰黄金时代风俗画的比较资料，无法核实其较低重复度和中上独特性。
missing.en: Comparative information with MFA’s other Metsu works and Dutch Golden Age genre paintings is missing, so its claimed lower repetition and above-average distinctiveness cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对“索福尼斯巴之死”题材识别及其与馆内梅曲作品比较的资料。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the museum’s subject-identification evidence for “Death of Sophonisba” and comparison with MFA’s other Metsu works.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认题名、梅曲归属、1654年断代和油彩媒材；若归属或年代不同，会改变作品的艺术史重要性。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the title, attribution to Metsu, 1654 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date would change the work’s art-historical importance.

missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸及馆方或学术来源对其艺术质量、完成度和梅曲风俗画典范性的资料；这些事实若不同，会改变当前价值判断。
missing.en: An image, dimensions, and museum or scholarly evidence concerning its quality, finish, and canonical character as a Metsu genre painting are missing; different facts could change the current value assessment.

missing.zh: 缺与 MFA 其他梅曲作品及馆内荷兰黄金时代风俗画的直接比较，无法核实其“组内品质与典范性最高”及较低重复度。
missing.en: Direct comparison with MFA’s other Metsu works and Dutch Golden Age genre paintings is missing, so the claims of highest quality/canonical status in the group and lower repetition cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺与馆内其他梅曲作品的直接比较，无法支撑其组内典范性和不可替代性判断。
top_missing_en: The key gap is direct comparison with MFA’s other Metsu works, needed to support its canonical status and distinctiveness within the group.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认题名、Gainsborough Dupont 归属、年代和油彩媒材；若归属不同，会显著改变作品的艺术史定位。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the title, attribution to Gainsborough Dupont, date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution would substantially change the work’s art-historical position.

missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸及馆方或学术来源对其艺术质量、完成度和与托马斯·盖恩斯伯勒关系的资料；这些事实若不同，会改变当前价值判断。
missing.en: An image, dimensions, and museum or scholarly evidence concerning its quality, finish, and relationship to Thomas Gainsborough are missing; different facts could change the current value assessment.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 英国18世纪风景画收藏中的定位及与馆内同类作品的比较，无法支撑其作为组内唯一对象的代表性。
missing.en: Its position within MFA’s eighteenth-century British landscape holdings and comparison with related works are missing, so its representativeness as the only object in the group cannot be supported.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品归属及其在 MFA 英国18世纪风景画收藏中的定位。
top_missing_en: The key gap is confirmation of the attribution and the work’s position within MFA’s eighteenth-century British landscape holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认题名、杜格归属、1640年断代和油彩媒材；若归属或年代不同，会改变作品的艺术史定位。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the title, attribution to Dughet, 1640 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date would change its art-historical position.

missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸及馆方或学术来源对其艺术质量、完成度、巴洛克风景画代表性和宗教叙事的资料；这些事实若不同，会改变当前价值判断。
missing.en: An image, dimensions, and museum or scholarly evidence concerning its quality, finish, representativeness of Baroque landscape painting, and religious narrative are missing; different facts could change the current value assessment.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 意大利17世纪古典风景画收藏中的定位及与馆内同类作品的比较，无法核实其组内唯一性和补位价值。
missing.en: Its position within MFA’s seventeenth-century Italian classical landscape holdings and comparison with related works are missing, so its uniqueness and supplementary value within the group cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品质量资料及其在 MFA 意大利17世纪古典风景画收藏中的定位。
top_missing_en: The key gap is quality evidence and the work’s position within MFA’s seventeenth-century Italian classical landscape holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对作者归属、作品题名、1513年断代及媒材的确认；若归属或年代明显不同，会改变其文艺复兴绘画历史地位判断。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution, title, 1513 date, and medium is missing; a materially different attribution or date would change the work's historical standing within Renaissance painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在Gaspare Negro创作中的位置及其艺术史评价。
missing.en: The work's place within Gaspare Negro's oeuvre and its art-historical assessment are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA意大利文艺复兴绘画同类藏品的可比清单及该作相对位置，无法核实其是否确属常规、可替代藏品。
missing.en: A comparison set of MFA Italian Renaissance paintings and this work's relative position within it are missing, so its alleged conventionality and substitutability cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作的官方归属与艺术史地位，以及它在MFA同类藏品中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: The official attribution and art-historical standing, together with the work's relative position among MFA's comparable holdings, are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对Gaspare Traversi归属、题名、1750年断代及媒材的确认。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Gaspare Traversi, title, 1750 date, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺该作在Traversi作品中的代表性、艺术史评价及是否为其社会题材风俗画的重要例证。
missing.en: The work's representativeness within Traversi's oeuvre, art-historical assessment, and status as an important example of his social genre painting are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA十八世纪意大利风俗画藏品规模、同类作品及该作相对独特性的核实资料。
missing.en: Evidence establishing the scale of MFA's eighteenth-century Italian genre-painting holdings, comparable works, and this work's relative distinctiveness is missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方归属确认及该作在Traversi作品和MFA同类藏品中的相对地位。
top_missing_en: The official attribution and the work's relative standing within Traversi's oeuvre and MFA's comparable holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认Gaudenzio Ferrari的作者归属、题名、年代及媒材；现有记录连年代和媒材也未列出。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Gaudenzio Ferrari, title, date, and medium is missing; the current record does not even provide the date or medium.

missing.zh: 缺该作在Gaudenzio Ferrari创作中的时期、质量与艺术史重要性。
missing.en: The work's period, quality, and art-historical importance within Gaudenzio Ferrari's oeuvre are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA意大利文艺复兴绘画中圣母子题材的同类数量、质量及该作的相对位置。
missing.en: The number, quality, and relative position of comparable Virgin-and-Child works in MFA's Italian Renaissance holdings are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方作品记录、作品艺术史地位及其在MFA同类圣母子绘画中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: The official object record, the work's art-historical standing, and its relative position among MFA's comparable Virgin-and-Child paintings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认Gentile Bellini的作者归属、1460年断代、题名及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Gentile Bellini, the 1460 date, title, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺“probably Pasquale Malipiero”这一身份识别的馆方或学术依据；若总督身份不能成立，作品的威尼斯政治史叙事价值会改变。
missing.en: The curatorial or scholarly basis for identifying the sitter as “probably Pasquale Malipiero” is missing; if the doge's identification is not supported, the work's Venetian political-history value would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作在Gentile Bellini肖像画创作中的位置及其相对代表性。
missing.en: The work's place and relative representativeness within Gentile Bellini's portraiture are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA威尼斯文艺复兴肖像藏品的同类比较及该作的馆藏相对位置。
missing.en: A comparison with MFA's Venetian Renaissance portrait holdings and the work's relative position within them is missing.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是总督身份识别、Bellini归属及其在MFA同类肖像中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are the sitter identification as a doge, the Bellini attribution, and the work's relative representativeness among MFA's comparable portraits.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认Georg Baselitz归属、1984年断代、题名及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Georg Baselitz, the 1984 date, title, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺《Lazarus》在Baselitz创作生涯中的时期、创作背景及其在倒置人物绘画中的具体位置。
missing.en: The work's period, context, and specific place within Baselitz's inverted-figure painting practice are missing.

missing.zh: 缺该作是否为Baselitz战后德国绘画代表作的馆方或学术依据。
missing.en: Curatorial or scholarly evidence that the work is representative of Baselitz's postwar German painting is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA战后德国绘画藏品的同类规模、重要作品及该作相对位置。
missing.en: The scale, important works, and the object's relative position within MFA's postwar German painting holdings are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在Baselitz创作中的具体代表性及其在MFA战后德国绘画板块中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: The work's specific representativeness within Baselitz's oeuvre and its relative position in MFA's postwar German painting holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方对象记录确认题名、作者Georg von Hoesslin、年代、媒材及馆藏编号；现有条目甚至没有入藏号和年代。
missing.en: An MFA object record confirming the title, attribution to Georg von Hoesslin, date, medium, and accession number is missing; the current entry lacks even the accession number and date.

missing.zh: 缺Georg von Hoesslin及该作的艺术史地位、创作时期和作品质量依据。
missing.en: Evidence for Georg von Hoesslin's and this work's art-historical standing, period, and quality is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA欧洲古典遗迹风景画同类藏品及该作相对位置，无法核实其“唯一”“边缘”或可替代性判断。
missing.en: MFA's comparable European classical-ruin landscapes and this work's relative position are missing, so the claims of uniqueness, marginality, or substitutability cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺基本官方对象确认，以及作者和作品艺术史地位、MFA同类比较资料。
top_missing_en: Basic official object verification, the artist's and work's art-historical standing, and comparison with MFA's holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认George Morland归属、题名、1790年断代及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to George Morland, title, 1790 date, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺《Carters with a Load of Slate》在Morland风俗画中的时期、质量和代表性评价。
missing.en: The work's period, quality, and representativeness within Morland's genre paintings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA十八世纪英国风俗画同类藏品及本作与《The Wreckers》的馆内相对位置依据。
missing.en: Evidence about MFA's comparable eighteenth-century British genre paintings and this work's relative position to The Wreckers is missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在Morland作品中的代表性及其与MFA同类、尤其与《The Wreckers》的相对位置。
top_missing_en: The work's representativeness within Morland's oeuvre and its relative position among MFA's comparable works, especially The Wreckers, are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认George Morland归属、题名、1791年断代及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to George Morland, title, 1791 date, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺《The Wreckers》在Morland作品中的艺术史位置、创作背景及其是否具有较高代表性。
missing.en: The work's art-historical position, context, and degree of representativeness within Morland's oeuvre are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA十八世纪英国风俗画同类比较及本作相对于《Carters with a Load of Slate》的馆内地位依据。
missing.en: A comparison with MFA's eighteenth-century British genre paintings and evidence for this work's relative position to Carters with a Load of Slate are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺《The Wreckers》的作品级艺术史依据及其在MFA同类藏品中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: Work-level art-historical evidence and the object's relative representativeness among MFA's comparable holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认George Morren归属、题名、1892年断代及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to George Morren, title, 1892 date, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺George Morren在比利时新印象主义中的具体艺术史地位及《Garden Wall》在其创作中的代表性。
missing.en: The artist's specific art-historical standing within Belgian Neo-Impressionism and the work's representativeness within Morren's oeuvre are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA比利时新印象主义及相关新印象主义藏品的同类数量和质量清单；“组内唯一”及补足该板块的判断无法核实。
missing.en: A count and quality comparison of MFA's Belgian Neo-Impressionist and related Neo-Impressionist holdings are missing; the claims that it is the only example and fills a collection gap cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺作者与作品的艺术史代表性，以及MFA同类藏品数量；“组内唯一”是当前不可核实的核心依据。
top_missing_en: The artist's and work's art-historical representativeness and the number of comparable MFA holdings are missing; the claim that it is the only example is a central unverified basis.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认George Romney归属、题名、1773年断代及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to George Romney, title, 1773 date, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺《Portrait of Two Girls (Misses Cumberland)》在Romney肖像画中的创作时期、质量及代表性依据。
missing.en: Evidence for the work's period, quality, and representativeness within Romney's portraiture is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA十八世纪英国肖像画同类藏品及本作相对于Romney其他肖像的馆内位置。
missing.en: MFA's comparable eighteenth-century British portraits and this work's relative position among Romney portraits are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作的官方确认、作品级代表性依据及其在MFA英国肖像画中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: The official object confirmation, work-level evidence of representativeness, and relative position within MFA's British portrait holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认George Romney归属、题名、1788年断代及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to George Romney, title, 1788 date, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺Mrs. Billington身份、其作为Saint Cecilia的图像识别及该作在Romney成熟期创作中的位置的馆方或学术依据。
missing.en: Curatorial or scholarly evidence for Mrs. Billington's identity, her identification as Saint Cecilia, and the work's place in Romney's mature oeuvre is missing.

missing.zh: 缺该作是否为Romney音乐主题或角色化肖像的代表例证，以及其相对《Portrait of Two Girls》等同类作品的依据。
missing.en: Evidence that the work is representative of Romney's musical or role-based portraits, and its relative standing against comparable works such as Portrait of Two Girls, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA十八世纪英国肖像画藏品中Romney作品的规模、质量和本作相对位置。
missing.en: The scale, quality, and relative position of Romney works within MFA's eighteenth-century British portrait holdings are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺人物身份与圣塞西莉亚图像识别的依据，以及该作在Romney和MFA同类肖像中的代表性。
top_missing_en: The evidence for the sitter's identity and the Saint Cecilia identification, as well as the work's representativeness within Romney and MFA's comparable portraits, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认George Romney归属、题名、1780年断代及媒材。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to George Romney, title, 1780 date, and medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺William Chafyn Grove身份及该作在Romney男性肖像创作中的时期、质量和代表性依据。
missing.en: Evidence for William Chafyn Grove's identity and the work's period, quality, and representativeness within Romney's male portraiture is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA十八世纪英国肖像画同类藏品及该作相对于本组其他Romney肖像的馆内位置。
missing.en: MFA's comparable eighteenth-century British portraits and this work's relative position against the other Romney portraits in the set are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在Romney男性肖像中的作品级代表性及其与MFA同类作品的相对位置。
top_missing_en: The work's representativeness within Romney's male portraiture and its relative position among MFA's comparable works are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆方或学术图录对乔治·罗姆尼作者归属及该肖像在其创作生涯中代表性的确认；若归属、年代或艺术史定位不同，会改变其作为英国十八世纪肖像画范例的定级依据。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly-catalogue confirmation of George Romney’s attribution and the portrait’s representativeness within his career; a different attribution, date, or art-historical assessment would change the basis for its tier.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 同类馆藏中英国十八世纪肖像、尤其罗姆尼肖像的数量与比较位置，以核实其馆内不可替代性是否确实有限。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the number and relative importance of eighteenth-century British portraits, especially Romney portraits, in the MFA collection, needed to verify whether its in-collection distinctiveness is limited.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方或学术来源对作品作者归属、艺术史代表性及其在 MFA 同类馆藏中相对位置的确认。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of the attribution, art-historical representativeness, and relative position within the MFA’s comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆方或学术图录对乔治·罗姆尼作者归属、年代及该肖像在其作品中的代表性确认；这些事实若不同，会改变其艺术史价值判断。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly-catalogue confirmation of George Romney’s attribution, date, and the portrait’s representativeness within his oeuvre; different facts would alter its art-historical assessment.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 同类馆藏中罗姆尼及其他英国十八世纪贵族肖像的比较资料，以验证该作的重复度和馆内补位价值。
missing.en: Missing comparison data on Romney and other eighteenth-century British aristocratic portraits in the MFA collection, needed to verify the work’s redundancy and collection-complement value.

top_missing_zh: 缺罗姆尼作者归属与作品代表性，以及其相对于 MFA 同类肖像的馆内比较证据。
top_missing_en: Missing evidence for Romney’s attribution and the work’s representativeness, together with its position relative to comparable MFA portraits.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆方或学术来源对乔治·斯塔布斯作者归属、1771 年年代及作品在其动物画创作中的代表性确认；这些事实若不同，会直接影响其典范性判断。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of George Stubbs’s attribution, the 1771 date, and the work’s representativeness within his animal paintings; different facts would directly affect its canonical status.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 英国十八世纪动物画及斯塔布斯作品的馆藏比较，尤其缺其是否为馆内该艺术家或该类型的关键代表作的证据。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the MFA’s eighteenth-century British animal paintings and Stubbs holdings, particularly evidence of whether this is a key representative work of the artist or category in the museum.

top_missing_zh: 缺斯塔布斯作者归属与作品代表性的权威确认，以及其在 MFA 英国动物画馆藏中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of Stubbs’s attribution and the work’s representativeness, as well as its relative position within the MFA’s British animal-painting holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏号及对应官方作品记录，无法核实这件作品的确切馆藏身份、题名、作者归属和 1921 年年代。若对象对应错误或归属不同，布拉克成熟期静物的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the MFA accession number and corresponding official object record, so the exact object identity, title, attribution, and 1921 date cannot be verified. If the object is misidentified or differently attributed, the basis for its tier as a mature Braque still life would change.

missing.zh: 缺权威图录对该作在布拉克静物及立体主义后续发展中的具体艺术史位置说明。
missing.en: Missing an authoritative catalogue assessment of the work’s specific position within Braque’s still lifes and the subsequent development of Cubism.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 法国现代主义静物及布拉克作品的馆藏比较，以核实其在馆内的典范性和不可替代性。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the MFA’s French modernist still lifes and Braque holdings, needed to verify the work’s canonical status and distinctiveness within the collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆藏号对应的 MFA 官方记录，以及对作者归属、艺术史位置和馆内相对重要性的核实。
top_missing_en: Missing the MFA official record corresponding to an accession number, together with verification of attribution, art-historical position, and relative importance within the collection.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆方或学术图录对该作作者归属、1925 年年代及其在布拉克成熟期静物中的具体代表性确认；这些事实若不同，会改变其艺术史价值和定级依据。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly-catalogue confirmation of the attribution, 1925 date, and specific representativeness within Braque’s mature still lifes; different facts would change its art-historical value and tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 同类布拉克静物及法国现代主义静物的数量、质量和展示叙事比较，以验证其相对第 832 件的重复度和补位价值。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the number, quality, and display narrative of comparable Braque still lifes and French modernist still lifes at the MFA, needed to verify its redundancy and complement value relative to seq. 832.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源对作品归属、成熟期代表性及其相对于 MFA 同类静物的比较确认。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of attribution, mature-period representativeness, and comparison with the MFA’s comparable still lifes.

missing.zh: 缺作品确切年代、材质和 MFA 官方记录；年代若落入不同艺术史阶段，或对象身份、作者归属不同，会改变其在十九世纪法国风景画中的定位。
missing.en: Missing the exact date, medium, and MFA official record; a different period, object identity, or attribution would change its position within nineteenth-century French landscape painting.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对乔治·米歇尔作者归属及《Castle in Ruins》在其作品中的代表性确认。
missing.en: Missing authoritative confirmation of Georges Michel’s attribution and the representativeness of Castle in Ruins within his oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 同类法国前期十九世纪风景画及米歇尔作品的馆藏比较，以验证该作所称的较高辨识度和不可替代性。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the MFA’s comparable early-nineteenth-century French landscapes and Michel holdings, needed to verify the work’s claimed distinctiveness and non-replaceability.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品年代、材质、官方馆藏记录，以及米歇尔作者归属和馆内相对代表性的证据。
top_missing_en: Missing the date, medium, official object record, and evidence for Michel’s attribution and relative representativeness within the MFA.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏号及官方作品记录，无法核实对象身份、作者归属、确切年代和材质；其中作者或年代若不同，会改变其艺术史分类与定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the MFA accession number and official object record, preventing verification of the object identity, attribution, exact date, and medium; a different attribution or date would change its art-historical classification and tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对该风车景观在乔治·米歇尔作品中的代表性确认，以及与 MFA 同类风景画的比较。
missing.en: Missing authoritative confirmation of the work’s representativeness within Georges Michel’s oeuvre and comparison with comparable MFA landscapes.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象记录以核实基本身份，并缺米歇尔作者归属、年代和同类馆藏比较证据。
top_missing_en: Missing the official object record for basic identity verification, together with attribution, dating, and comparable-collection evidence for Michel’s work.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏号及官方作品记录，无法核实对象身份、作者归属、确切年代和材质；这些事实若不同，会改变其艺术史分类和定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the MFA accession number and official object record, preventing verification of the object identity, attribution, exact date, and medium; different facts would change its art-historical classification and tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对该作在乔治·米歇尔作品中的代表性，以及它与第 835 件是否构成实质性重复的确认。
missing.en: Missing authoritative confirmation of the work’s representativeness within Georges Michel’s oeuvre and whether it is substantively redundant with seq. 835.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象记录、作品年代及其与第 835 件重复关系的权威核实。
top_missing_en: Missing the official object record, authoritative dating, and verification of its relationship and redundancy relative to seq. 835.

missing.zh: 缺作品确切年代及 MFA 馆方或学术来源对秀拉作者归属、题名和该作在其创作中的代表性确认；若并非秀拉的油画或艺术史定位不同，会直接影响其较高定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the exact date and MFA or scholarly confirmation of Seurat’s attribution, title, and the work’s representativeness within his career; if it is not a Seurat oil painting or is differently assessed, the basis for its high tier would change.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 新印象主义及秀拉作品的馆藏比较，尤其缺该作是否为馆内秀拉或点彩绘画叙事中的关键代表作的证据。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the MFA’s Neo-Impressionist and Seurat holdings, particularly evidence of whether this is a key representative work in the museum’s Seurat or Pointillist narrative.

top_missing_zh: 缺秀拉作者归属、作品年代与代表性的权威确认，以及其在 MFA 新印象主义馆藏中的关键性证据。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of Seurat’s attribution, dating, and representativeness, plus evidence of its significance within the MFA’s Neo-Impressionist holdings.

missing.zh: 缺作品材质及 MFA 馆方或学术图录对鲁奥作者归属、1944 年年代和该小丑形象在其创作中的代表性确认；这些事实若不同，会改变其艺术史定位。
missing.en: Missing the medium and MFA or scholarly-catalogue confirmation of Rouault’s attribution, 1944 date, and the representativeness of this clown image within his oeuvre; different facts would change its art-historical position.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 鲁奥及法国二十世纪表现主义作品的馆藏比较，以验证该作作为该板块唯一对象时的实际不可替代性。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the MFA’s Rouault and French twentieth-century Expressionist holdings, needed to verify its actual distinctiveness as the sole object in that category.

top_missing_zh: 缺鲁奥作品身份、年代、材质和在 MFA 法国表现主义馆藏中相对位置的权威证据。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative evidence for the Rouault object’s identity, date, medium, and relative position within the MFA’s French Expressionist holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏号对应的官方记录、作品年代、材质及题名所指的具体图像或寓意内容；尤其缺 Gerard Soest 作者归属确认。若作者或对象身份不同，会直接改变其在英国十七世纪艺术中的意义。
missing.en: Missing the official record corresponding to the MFA accession number, the date, medium, and the specific image or allegorical content denoted by the title; Gerard Soest’s attribution is especially unconfirmed. A different attribution or object identity would directly change its significance in seventeenth-century British art.

missing.zh: 缺权威艺术史来源对该作在 Gerard Soest 作品及英国十七世纪肖像与寓意画中的代表性评价。
missing.en: Missing authoritative art-historical assessment of the work’s representativeness within Gerard Soest’s oeuvre and seventeenth-century British portrait and allegorical painting.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 同类英国十七世纪肖像与寓意画的馆藏比较，以核实其所谓组内唯一性是否转化为实际馆内不可替代性。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the MFA’s comparable seventeenth-century British portrait and allegorical paintings, needed to verify whether its claimed category uniqueness translates into actual in-collection distinctiveness.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象记录和 Soest 作者归属、作品内容及艺术史代表性的核实；现有资料不足以支撑其相对位置判断。
top_missing_en: Missing the official object record and verification of Soest’s attribution, the work’s content, and its art-historical representativeness; the current evidence is insufficient for its relative-position assessment.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆方或学术图录对 Gerard ter Borch 作者归属、1670 年年代及该女性肖像在其创作中的代表性确认；这些事实若不同，会改变其艺术史价值判断。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly-catalogue confirmation of Gerard ter Borch’s attribution, the 1670 date, and the portrait’s representativeness within his oeuvre; different facts would alter its art-historical assessment.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 荷兰黄金时代肖像及 ter Borch 作品的馆藏比较，以验证该作的品质、重复度和馆内不可替代性。
missing.en: Missing a comparison of the MFA’s Dutch Golden Age portraits and ter Borch holdings, needed to verify the work’s quality, redundancy, and distinctiveness within the collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺 ter Borch 作者归属、年代和作品代表性的权威确认，以及其在 MFA 荷兰黄金时代肖像中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of ter Borch’s attribution, dating, and representativeness, together with its relative position among the MFA’s Dutch Golden Age portraits.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对作者归属的确认（赫拉德·特博赫本人、工作室、圈子或后人）；若归属不同，作品在荷兰黄金时代绘画中的艺术史地位会直接改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the attribution—Gerard ter Borch himself, his workshop, circle, or a follower—is missing; a different attribution would directly change the work’s art-historical standing within Dutch Golden Age painting.

missing.zh: 缺该画在 MFA 荷兰绘画收藏中的相对重要性及当前展陈地位；这决定它是否只是常规藏品，还是具有足以支撑更高等级的馆藏代表性。
missing.en: The work’s relative importance within MFA’s Dutch painting collection and its current display status are missing; these determine whether it is a routine holding or a collection-representative work capable of supporting a higher tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对作者归属的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA’s official attribution confirmation is missing.

missing.zh: 缺作品的创作年代、媒材和尺寸等 MFA 官方基本记录；若其年代或媒材与现有条目不同，作品在荷兰黄金时代绘画中的定位可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official basic record for the date, medium, and dimensions is missing; a different date or medium could change the work’s placement within Dutch Golden Age painting.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对范登埃克霍特本人归属的确认，以及该作品在其创作中的位置；若是工作室、圈子或后人作品，现有艺术史重要性依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation that the work is by Gerbrand van den Eeckhout, together with its place in his oeuvre, is missing; a workshop, circle, or follower attribution would change the basis for its art-historical importance.

missing.zh: 缺该画在 MFA 荷兰绘画收藏中的相对地位和展陈状态；没有这项证据，无法验证它是否仅为常规藏品。
missing.en: Its relative position within MFA’s Dutch painting collection and its display status are missing; without this evidence, it cannot be verified as merely a routine holding.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对作者归属及其在范登埃克霍特创作中的位置的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and the work’s place in van den Eeckhout’s oeuvre is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对里希特本人归属的确认，以及该作在其1984年绘画中的作品位置；若归属或作品类型判断不同，现有 Tier 依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of Richter’s authorship and the work’s place among his 1984 paintings is missing; a different attribution or work classification would change the current tier rationale.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 现代艺术收藏中的相对代表性、展陈状态及与其他里希特作品的关系；这些事实决定它是否只是馆藏中的一般里希特作品。
missing.en: The work’s relative representativeness within MFA’s modern-art collection, display status, and relationship to the other Richter works are missing; these facts determine whether it is merely a standard Richter holding.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 里希特藏品中的相对代表性及与其他里希特作品的关系。
top_missing_en: The work’s relative representativeness among MFA’s Richter holdings and its relationship to the other Richter works are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对作品完整所有权结构的确认，包括“50% undivided interest”是否仍为馆方现行法律与馆藏描述；所有权性质会直接影响其馆藏身份与可展示性。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the complete ownership structure—including whether “50% undivided interest” remains the museum’s current legal and collection description—is missing; the ownership status directly affects the object’s collection identity and displayability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认该作的作者归属、尺寸及当前展陈或可访问状态；这些事实决定它能否作为馆内里希特抽象绘画的实际代表。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the attribution, dimensions, and current display or accessibility status is missing; these facts determine whether it can function as an actual representative of Richter’s abstract painting at MFA.

missing.zh: 缺该作在里希特抽象画系列及 MFA 相关收藏中的具体作品史位置；仅凭题名和年份无法证明其典范性。
missing.en: The work’s specific place within Richter’s abstract-picture series and MFA’s related holdings is missing; title and date alone do not establish its canonical status.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对“50% undivided interest”所有权结构及当前馆藏描述的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA’s confirmation of the “50% undivided interest” ownership structure and current collection description is missing.

missing.zh: 缺作品的 MFA 官方馆藏编号及完整馆藏记录；目前无法核验这件作品是否确为该馆藏对象及其正式标题。
missing.en: The MFA accession number and complete collection record are missing; it cannot currently be verified that this is the museum’s object or its official title.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对贝克海德本人归属的确认，以及作品在其城市景观创作中的位置；若归属层级不同，现有代表性判断会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of Berckheyde’s authorship and the work’s place within his cityscape production is missing; a different attribution level would change the current representativeness assessment.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰艺术收藏中的相对地位和展陈状态；这决定它是否具有超出一般专题藏品的馆藏代表性。
missing.en: Its relative position within MFA’s Dutch-art collection and its display status are missing; these determine whether it has representativeness beyond an ordinary specialist holding.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法先核验对象身份。
top_missing_en: The official MFA collection record and accession number are missing, so the object’s identity cannot first be verified.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认作品确为赫里特·道本人之作，以及其在道的精细画创作中的位置；若为工作室或圈子作品，现有代表性依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming that the work is by Gerrit Dou himself, and its place within his fijnschilder production, is missing; a workshop or circle attribution would change the basis for its representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰绘画收藏中的相对重要性、展陈状态及与其他道作品的比较；这些事实支撑其被列为同组代表性最高作品的判断。
missing.en: The work’s relative importance, display status, and comparison with MFA’s other Dou holdings are missing; these facts support the claim that it is the most representative work in its group.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他赫里特·道作品的馆藏比较及相对重要性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence comparing it with MFA’s other Gerrit Dou holdings and establishing its relative importance is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认作者归属为 Gherardo Starnina，以及这件圣徒像在相关祭坛画组中的位置；归属或组构关系不同会改变其艺术史与叙事价值。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution to Gherardo Starnina and the panel’s place within the associated altarpiece group is missing; a different attribution or group relationship would change its art-historical and narrative value.

missing.zh: 缺该组祭坛画的重建、原始位置及四件面板之间关系的权威证据；这直接决定单件作品是否具有成组展示和叙事价值。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence reconstructing the altarpiece, its original location, and the relationship among the four panels is missing; this directly determines whether an individual panel has group-display and narrative value.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 当前展陈状态及其在馆内早期意大利艺术收藏中的相对位置。
missing.en: The current display status and relative position within MFA’s early Italian-art collection are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺四件面板所属祭坛画的重建及其相互关系证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence reconstructing the altarpiece and the relationships among its four panels is missing.
error_note_zh: 本条的 accession_number 为 20.1855，与 seq 850 的 Saint Vincent 完全相同；而 seq 847 的 Saint Stephen 与同组其他面板并列为不同对象，至少存在馆藏编号重复或对象身份错配。
error_note_en: This object has accession number 20.1855, exactly the same as Saint Vincent in seq 850. Since Saint Stephen and the other panels are presented as distinct objects in the group, there is at least a duplicated accession number or an object-identity mismatch.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认作者归属为 Gherardo Starnina，以及“Isaiah with Two Angels”在相关祭坛画组中的确切位置。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution to Gherardo Starnina and this panel’s exact place within the associated altarpiece group is missing.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料确认该面板与 seq 847、849、850 面板属于同一祭坛画、原始组合及图像程序；这决定其叙事完整性和馆藏代表性。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence that this panel belongs with the panels in seqs. 847, 849, and 850, including their original arrangement and iconographic program, is missing; this determines its narrative completeness and collection representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 当前展陈及早期意大利艺术收藏中的相对重要性。
missing.en: Its current display status and relative importance within MFA’s early Italian-art collection are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该面板与同组其他面板的祭坛画归属、原始组合及图像程序证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the panel’s altarpiece affiliation, original arrangement, and iconographic program with the other panels is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认作者归属为 Gherardo Starnina，以及该面板在相关祭坛画组中的位置。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution to Gherardo Starnina and the panel’s place within the associated altarpiece group is missing.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料确认该面板与 seq 847、848、850 的同组关系、原始排列及图像程序；若关系不成立，现有成组叙事依据会改变。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence confirming this panel’s group relationship, original arrangement, and iconographic program with seqs. 847, 848, and 850 is missing; if that relationship does not hold, the current group-narrative rationale would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 当前展陈及早期意大利艺术收藏中的相对重要性。
missing.en: Its current display status and relative importance within MFA’s early Italian-art collection are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该面板与同组其他面板的祭坛画关系及原始图像程序证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the panel’s altarpiece relationship and original iconographic program with the other panels is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认作者归属为 Gherardo Starnina，以及该面板在相关祭坛画组中的位置。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution to Gherardo Starnina and the panel’s place within the associated altarpiece group is missing.

missing.zh: 该条的 accession_number 与 seq 847 的 Saint Stephen 同为 20.1855；缺该对象正确馆藏编号及其与 Saint Stephen 是否为同一实物的核验。
missing.en: This record shares accession number 20.1855 with Saint Stephen in seq. 847; verification of the correct accession number and whether the two entries refer to the same physical object is missing.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料确认该面板与其他三件面板的同组关系、原始排列及当前展陈状态；这些事实决定其作为祭坛画组成员的价值。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence confirming this panel’s group relationship, original arrangement, and current display status with the other three panels is missing; these facts determine its value as a member of the altarpiece group.

top_missing_zh: 缺正确馆藏编号，并需核验其是否与 seq 847 的 Saint Stephen 发生对象错配。
top_missing_en: The correct accession number is missing, and it must be verified whether this is an object-identity mismatch with Saint Stephen in seq. 847.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及馆方对其创作语境、系列关系或艺术家生涯位置的说明；这些资料可能改变代表性和现场视觉影响判断。
missing.en: Missing the work’s dimensions and the museum’s account of its context, relationship to any series, or place in the artist’s career; these could change judgments of representativeness and visual impact.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对作者归属、创作年代及其在帕尼尼作品中的位置的确认。
top_missing_en: Museum confirmation of the attribution, date, and place within Panini’s oeuvre is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方对作者归属和创作年代的确认；不同归属或年代可能改变其在帕尼尼建筑与废墟画中的艺术史定位。
missing.en: Missing museum confirmation of the attribution and date; a different attribution or date could change its art-historical position within Panini’s architectural and ruin paintings.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及馆方对其与其他帕尼尼卡普里乔作品关系的说明；这些资料可能改变其代表性和与同类作品的可替代性判断。
missing.en: Missing the work’s dimensions and the museum’s account of its relationship to other Panini capricci; these could change judgments of representativeness and substitutability within the group.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对作者归属、创作年代及其与其他帕尼尼卡普里乔作品关系的确认。
top_missing_en: Museum confirmation of the attribution, date, and relationship to other Panini capricci is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方对作者归属和1750年年代的确认；若作者归属或年代不同，作品作为帕尼尼罗马建筑景观画代表作的判断可能改变。
missing.en: Missing museum confirmation of the attribution and the 1750 date; a different attribution or date could change its status as a representative Panini view of Rome.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及馆方对其与特莱维喷泉图像史、创作语境及艺术家生涯位置的说明；这些资料可能改变代表性和视觉影响判断。
missing.en: Missing the work’s dimensions and the museum’s account of its place in the visual history of the Trevi Fountain, its context, and its position in the artist’s career; these could change judgments of representativeness and visual impact.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对作者归属、1750年年代及作品在帕尼尼罗马景观画中的位置的确认。
top_missing_en: Museum confirmation of the attribution, 1750 date, and place within Panini’s Roman views is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方对作者归属和创作年代的确认；不同归属或年代可能改变作品在意大利巴洛克静物画中的艺术史定位。
missing.en: Missing museum confirmation of the attribution and date; a different attribution or date could change the work’s art-historical position within Italian Baroque still life.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及馆方对其艺术家生涯位置、创作语境和收藏意义的说明；这些资料可能改变视觉影响与代表性判断。
missing.en: Missing the work’s dimensions and the museum’s account of its place in the artist’s career, context, and collection significance; these could change judgments of visual impact and representativeness.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对作者归属、创作年代及其在意大利巴洛克静物画中的位置的确认。
top_missing_en: Museum confirmation of the attribution, date, and place within Italian Baroque still life is missing.

missing.zh: 缺美国波士顿美术馆官方对象记录对馆藏号22.403、作品正式标题（包括“Annunication; Crucifixion”是否为双联或两幅作品）、作者归属及创作年代的核实；若官方归属或年代与现值不同，十四世纪意大利早期宗教画的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: The MFA's official object record has not been checked for accession no. 22.403, the formal title (including whether “Annunication; Crucifixion” denotes a diptych or two works), attribution, and date; a different official attribution or date would change the basis for its tier as an early Italian religious painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在MFA欧洲绘画收藏中的馆方定位：是否为展厅重点、常设展品或仅为一般性藏品，以及与馆内同类十四世纪意大利宗教画相比的相对重要性。
missing.en: The work's curatorial position within the MFA's European painting collection is missing: whether it is a gallery highlight, a regularly displayed work, or a routine holding, and how it ranks against comparable fourteenth-century Italian religious paintings in the MFA.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸、图像及保存状态等足以判断实际观赏影响与绘画质量的官方资料；若作品规模、完成度或状态显著不同，视觉性与艺术价值的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Official information on dimensions, image, and conservation condition is missing, all of which bear on its actual visual impact and quality; materially different scale, completeness, or condition would affect the tier rationale.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是MFA官方记录对作品身份、作者归属和年代的核实，以及馆方在本馆同类收藏中的定位。
top_missing_en: The key gap is official MFA verification of the work's identity, attribution, and date, together with its curatorial position among comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号1981.353、作者归属、作品年代及正式标题的核实；尤其缺创作年代，无法确认其在意大利早期巴洛克绘画中的历史位置。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 1981.353, attribution, date, and formal title; the missing date is especially important for placing the work within early Italian Baroque painting.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或权威图录对普罗卡奇尼及此作艺术史地位的具体判断，包括是否为其具有代表性的作品，而非仅为普通宗教画。
missing.en: A museum or authoritative catalogue assessment of Procaccini's standing and this work's representativeness is missing; it is not established whether this is a representative work rather than a routine religious painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在MFA展厅中的实际状态与策展定位，包括是否展出、是否被列为重点作品，以及与馆内其他意大利巴洛克宗教画的比较位置。
missing.en: Its actual MFA display status and curatorial position are missing, including whether it is exhibited or highlighted and how it compares with the MFA's other Italian Baroque religious paintings.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是官方年代、作者归属和作品代表性判断，以及其在MFA中的展陈定位。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are official date and attribution, an assessment of the work's representativeness, and its display and curatorial position at the MFA.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号45.101、作者姓名规范形式、作品标题、年代及归属的核实；这些信息决定其是否确为1735年前后的克雷斯皮肖像画。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 45.101, the standardized artist name, title, date, and attribution; these facts determine whether it is indeed a Crespi portrait from around 1735.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对该肖像及其被画者Florius Senesius身份、社会职务和委托背景的确认；若人物身份或委托语境具有特殊历史意义，作品的社会史价值与定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Authoritative confirmation is missing for the sitter Florius Senesius, his office, and the commission context; if the sitter or commission has unusual historical significance, the work's social-historical value and tier rationale would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作与MFA其他克雷斯皮作品及同类十八世纪意大利肖像画的馆内比较，尤其缺馆方是否认为它具有独立代表性而非与现有作品重复。
missing.en: A museum-level comparison with the MFA's other Crespi works and comparable eighteenth-century Italian portraits is missing, particularly whether the MFA treats it as independently representative rather than redundant.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在MFA是否展出及其展厅或策展重点状态。
missing.en: Its MFA display status and whether it occupies a highlighted gallery or curatorial position are missing.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是被画者及委托背景的核实，以及该作相对于MFA其他克雷斯皮作品的独立代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are verification of the sitter and commission context, and the work's independent representativeness relative to the MFA's other Crespi holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号69.958、作者归属、作品标题和约1700年年代的核实。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 69.958, attribution, title, and the circa-1700 date.

missing.zh: 缺权威图录对该作是否属于克雷斯皮具有代表性的乐手或风俗题材作品、以及其艺术质量的具体判断。
missing.en: An authoritative catalogue assessment is missing of whether this is a representative Crespi work on musicians or genre subjects and of its artistic quality.

missing.zh: 缺该作相对于MFA其他克雷斯皮作品及馆内意大利风俗画的比较位置，无法核实其重复性是否确实限制不可替代性。
missing.en: Its comparative position against the MFA's other Crespi works and Italian genre paintings is missing, so the claimed limitation on distinctiveness through redundancy cannot be verified.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否在MFA展出、所在展厅及是否为馆方重点作品的确认。
missing.en: Confirmation is missing of whether the work is displayed at the MFA, its gallery location, and whether it is a museum-highlighted work.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是作品的权威艺术质量与代表性判断，以及它相对于MFA其他克雷斯皮作品的比较位置。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are an authoritative assessment of the work's quality and representativeness, and its comparative position among the MFA's Crespi holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆藏号及官方对象记录，因而尚未核实作品标题、作者Giuseppe Raggio、年代1883和媒材油彩是否确属同一件馆藏。
missing.en: The MFA accession number and official object record are missing, so it has not been verified that the title, Giuseppe Raggio attribution, 1883 date, and oil medium all refer to the same MFA holding.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对Giuseppe Raggio在十九世纪意大利绘画中的艺术史地位及此作代表性的判断。
missing.en: An authoritative assessment is missing of Giuseppe Raggio's position in nineteenth-century Italian painting and of this work's representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA欧洲绘画收藏中的策展定位，以及与馆内同类意大利乡村风景画相比是否确属边缘或具有特殊补位价值。
missing.en: Its curatorial position in the MFA's European painting collection is missing, including whether it is genuinely marginal or has a distinctive role compared with the MFA's Italian rural landscapes.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸、图像和保存状态，无法核实其视觉影响与实际观赏价值。
missing.en: Dimensions, image, and conservation condition are missing, preventing verification of its visual impact and actual viewing value.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是MFA馆藏身份的官方核实，以及Raggio与此作在馆内和艺术史中的实际代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are official verification of the MFA object identity and the work's actual representativeness in the museum and in art history.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号21.1461、作品正式标题、作者归属、创作年代及媒材的完整核实；尤其缺绝对年代，无法确定其在十八世纪威尼斯风景画传统中的位置。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 21.1461, formal title, attribution, date, and medium; the missing date is especially important for placing it within the eighteenth-century Venetian landscape tradition.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对Giuseppe Zais及此作在威尼斯风景画史中的具体地位、代表性和艺术质量判断。
missing.en: An authoritative assessment is missing of Giuseppe Zais's and this work's specific position, representativeness, and artistic quality within Venetian landscape painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作与MFA其他威尼斯风景画及意大利风景画的比较，无法确认其重复性是否足以限制不可替代性。
missing.en: A comparison with the MFA's other Venetian and Italian landscapes is missing, so it cannot be established whether redundancy materially limits its distinctiveness.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在MFA的展出状态、展厅位置和馆方重点程度。
missing.en: Its MFA display status, gallery location, and degree of curatorial emphasis are missing.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是官方年代与作者归属核实，以及该作在MFA威尼斯风景画收藏中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are official verification of the date and attribution, and the work's relative representativeness within the MFA's Venetian landscape holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号46.842、Godaert Kamper作者归属、作品标题、1644年年代及媒材的核实。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 46.842, the Godaert Kamper attribution, title, 1644 date, and medium.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对Godaert Kamper的艺术史地位、该作是否为其可代表作品及其艺术质量的判断。
missing.en: An authoritative assessment is missing of Godaert Kamper's art-historical standing, whether this is a representative work, and its artistic quality.

missing.zh: 缺该作与MFA荷兰风俗画收藏及同类音乐聚会题材的比较位置，无法核实其是否只是一般性类型补充。
missing.en: Its comparative position among the MFA's Dutch genre paintings and similar musical-party subjects is missing, so its status as merely a generic supplement cannot be verified.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否在MFA展出及是否被馆方作为荷兰风俗画重点作品呈现。
missing.en: It is missing whether the work is displayed at the MFA and whether the museum presents it as a highlighted Dutch genre painting.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是作者与作品代表性的权威核实，以及其相对于MFA荷兰风俗画收藏的独特位置。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are authoritative verification of the artist and the work's representativeness, and its distinct position among the MFA's Dutch genre holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号29.1129、Gonzalo Pérez的作者归属、正式标题和创作年代的核实；尤其缺年代，无法确认其究竟属于何一早期西班牙或瓦伦西亚绘画阶段。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 29.1129, the Gonzalo Pérez attribution, formal title, and date; the missing date is especially important for determining which phase of early Spanish or Valencian painting it belongs to.

missing.zh: 缺对红衣主教Alonso Borja（Borgia）身份、肖像/赞助关系及作品委托背景的权威确认；这些事实直接决定其宗教制度史解释力。
missing.en: Authoritative confirmation is missing of Cardinal Alonso Borja (Borgia)'s identity, the portrait or patronage relationship, and the commission context; these facts directly determine its interpretive value for religious and institutional history.

missing.zh: 缺权威图录对Gonzalo Pérez及此作在早期西班牙或瓦伦西亚绘画中的代表性、归属确定性和艺术质量判断。
missing.en: An authoritative catalogue assessment is missing of Gonzalo Pérez's and this work's representativeness, attribution certainty, and artistic quality within early Spanish or Valencian painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA早期欧洲绘画展厅中的展出状态、重点程度及与同类早期西班牙和尼德兰宗教画的比较位置。
missing.en: Its display status and curatorial prominence in the MFA's early European galleries, as well as its position relative to comparable early Spanish and Netherlandish religious paintings, are missing.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是红衣主教身份与委托背景、作品年代及作者归属的权威核实。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are authoritative verification of the cardinal's identity and commission context, the date, and the attribution.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号1978.466、Goodhart Master归属、作品年代、地域/画派和正式标题的核实；匿名大师归属若变化，作品的艺术史定位会直接改变。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 1978.466, the Goodhart Master attribution, date, region or school, and formal title; a different anonymous-master attribution would directly change the work's art-historical position.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对Goodhart Master这一归属的确定程度、该作在其作品群中的代表性，以及受难器物图像的具体图像学意义判断。
missing.en: An authoritative assessment is missing of the certainty of the Goodhart Master attribution, the work's representativeness within that master's oeuvre, and the specific iconographic significance of the Instruments of the Passion.

missing.zh: 缺该作与MFA中世纪晚期尼德兰宗教画及匿名大师作品的比较位置，无法确认其非重复性是否足以支持现有定级。
missing.en: Its comparative position among the MFA's late medieval Netherlandish religious paintings and anonymous-master works is missing, so its distinctiveness cannot be verified.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否在MFA展出、所在展厅及馆方是否将其作为中世纪宗教艺术重点作品。
missing.en: It is missing whether the work is displayed at the MFA, where, and whether the museum treats it as a highlight of medieval religious art.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是Goodhart Master归属及年代的权威核实，以及匿名作品在MFA中世纪宗教画收藏中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are authoritative verification of the Goodhart Master attribution and date, and the work's relative representativeness among the MFA's medieval religious paintings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号29.725、Goswin van der Weyden作者归属、作品年代、正式标题及媒材的核实。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 29.725, the Goswin van der Weyden attribution, date, formal title, and medium.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对该作是否为Goswin van der Weyden的确定归属、其在作者作品群中的代表性及艺术质量判断。
missing.en: An authoritative assessment is missing of the certainty of the Goswin van der Weyden attribution, the work's representativeness within his oeuvre, and its artistic quality.

missing.zh: 缺该作与MFA早期尼德兰宗教画、尤其同类降下十字架题材的比较位置，以及馆方是否将其列为该板块重点作品。
missing.en: Its comparative position among the MFA's early Netherlandish religious paintings, especially comparable Deposition subjects, and whether the museum treats it as a highlight of that area are missing.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸、图像和保存状态，无法核实其叙事规模、细节表现和实际视觉冲击。
missing.en: Dimensions, image, and conservation condition are missing, preventing verification of its narrative scale, detail, and actual visual impact.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是作者归属、作品代表性与馆方重点程度的权威核实。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are authoritative verification of attribution, representativeness, and curatorial prominence.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号48.1028、Guercino作者归属、1624年年代、作品标题及媒材的核实。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 48.1028, the Guercino attribution, 1624 date, title, and medium.

missing.zh: 缺权威图录对该作是否为Guercino具有代表性的历史画、画面质量及其在作者作品群中的位置判断。
missing.en: An authoritative catalogue assessment is missing of whether this is a representative Guercino history painting, its quality, and its position within the artist's oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺该作与MFA其他意大利巴洛克历史画及馆内Guercino作品的比较位置，无法核实其虽重要但仅属补充的判断。
missing.en: Its comparative position among the MFA's other Italian Baroque history paintings and Guercino holdings is missing, so the claim that it is important but merely supplementary cannot be verified.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在MFA展厅中的实际状态、展厅位置和馆方重点程度。
missing.en: Its actual MFA display status, gallery location, and degree of curatorial prominence are missing.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是作品作为Guercino历史画的代表性与质量，以及其相对于MFA同类和Guercino作品的比较位置。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are the work's representativeness and quality as a Guercino history painting, and its comparative position among related MFA holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对馆藏号1986.61、Guercino作者归属、正式标题、创作年代和媒材的核实；尤其缺年代，无法确定其在Guercino创作生涯中的位置。
missing.en: The MFA's official record has not been checked for accession no. 1986.61, the Guercino attribution, formal title, date, and medium; the missing date is especially important for locating it within Guercino's career.

missing.zh: 缺权威来源对《Primavera》的题材辨识、寓意内容、创作语境及其在Guercino作品群中的代表性判断。
missing.en: An authoritative assessment is missing of the subject identification, allegorical content, production context, and representativeness of Primavera within Guercino's oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺该作与MFA另一件Guercino作品及馆内意大利巴洛克寓意画的具体比较，无法核实作品重复性是否确实降低其不可替代性。
missing.en: A specific comparison with the MFA's other Guercino work and its Italian Baroque allegorical paintings is missing, so it cannot be verified that redundancy materially lowers this work's distinctiveness.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在MFA是否展出、所在展厅及馆方重点程度。
missing.en: Its MFA display status, gallery location, and degree of curatorial prominence are missing.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是作品年代、寓意题材与Guercino作品群中的代表性，以及与馆内另一件Guercino作品的实际比较。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are the date, allegorical subject, and representativeness within Guercino's oeuvre, together with an actual comparison to the MFA's other Guercino work.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏页对作者归属、作品年代（是确切 1480 年还是约 1480 年）及媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品的艺术史定位和 Tier 依据可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official collection record confirming the attribution, date (whether precisely 1480 or circa 1480), and medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the work’s art-historical positioning and Tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 意大利文艺复兴绘画馆藏中的比较位置，以及其是否被馆方作为代表性或重点展品呈现的资料；该位置若不同，会直接影响不可替代性判断。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for this work’s comparative position within MFA’s Italian Renaissance painting holdings and whether MFA presents it as a representative or highlighted work; a different position would directly affect its irreplaceability assessment.

top_missing_zh: MFA 官方对作品归属、年代和馆藏代表性位置的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA confirmation of the attribution, date, and representative position within its collection.

missing.en: An MFA collection record or scholarly catalogue confirming the attribution, date, and medium is missing; different information would alter the work’s art-historical period and Tier basis.

missing.en: Evidence is missing for this still life’s comparative position, display status, or curatorial interpretation within MFA’s Monet and French Impressionist holdings; if it is more representative within the artist’s or MFA’s collection, the Tier basis would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 法国印象派馆藏中的比较地位与馆方解读。
top_missing_en: The work’s comparative position and curatorial interpretation within MFA’s French Impressionist holdings are missing.

missing.en: MFA documentation confirming the Courbet attribution, date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the work’s realist context and Tier basis.

missing.en: Evidence is missing for this landscape’s comparative position within MFA’s Courbet and French Realist holdings and for any highlighted display or scholarly interpretation by MFA; different information would affect its representativeness and irreplaceability.

top_missing_en: Evidence of the work’s comparative position and representative status within MFA’s Courbet holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对库尔贝归属、1872 年年代及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品的艺术史定位可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Courbet attribution, 1872 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the work’s art-historical positioning.

missing.zh: 缺该花卉静物在 MFA 库尔贝及法国现实主义馆藏中的比较地位，以及馆方是否将其作为库尔贝代表性静物或重点展品；答案不同会影响 Tier。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for this floral still life’s comparative position within MFA’s Courbet and French Realist holdings and for whether MFA treats it as a representative Courbet still life or highlighted work; a different answer would affect the Tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 库尔贝静物馆藏中的比较地位与馆方代表性确认。
top_missing_en: The work’s comparative position and representative status within MFA’s Courbet still-life holdings are missing.

missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Courbet attribution, the circa-1840 date, and the medium is missing; especially the medium and date precision could alter the work’s period and Tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该裸体画在 MFA 库尔贝作品中的艺术史定位、同类馆藏比较位置及馆方展陈解读；若其被证实具有更高代表性，Tier 依据会改变。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for this nude’s art-historical position within Courbet’s oeuvre, its comparative position among MFA holdings, and MFA’s display or curatorial interpretation; evidence of greater representativeness would change the Tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品媒材、年代精度及其在库尔贝馆藏中的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the medium, date precision, and representative status within Courbet’s holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对库尔贝归属、1857 年年代及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品作为库尔贝现实主义作品的定级依据可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Courbet attribution, 1857 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the Tier basis for treating it as a Courbet realist work.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术目录对《The Quarry》在库尔贝创作谱系中的具体地位，以及其在 MFA 法国现实主义馆藏中的展陈和比较位置的确认；这些事实直接支撑其组内代表性和不可替代性。
missing.en: MFA or scholarly catalogue evidence is missing for The Quarry’s specific position within Courbet’s oeuvre and its display and comparative position within MFA’s French Realist holdings; these facts directly support its representativeness and irreplaceability.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认《The Quarry》的库尔贝作品史地位及其 MFA 馆藏代表性。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence of The Quarry’s position in Courbet’s oeuvre and its representative status at MFA is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对库尔贝归属、1862 年年代及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品的艺术史定位可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Courbet attribution, 1862 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the work’s art-historical positioning.

missing.zh: 缺该森林风景在 MFA 库尔贝馆藏中的比较位置及馆方展陈、收藏史或学术解读证据；若其馆藏角色并非普通补充性作品，Tier 依据会改变。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for this forest landscape’s comparative position within MFA’s Courbet holdings and for MFA display, collection-history, or scholarly interpretation; if its role in the collection is not merely supplementary, the Tier basis would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 库尔贝馆藏中的比较位置与馆方收藏角色证据。
top_missing_en: The work’s comparative position and curatorial role within MFA’s Courbet holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对多雷归属、1865 年年代及油彩媒材的确认；若作者归属或媒材不同，作品所属叙事和 Tier 依据可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Doré attribution, 1865 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or medium could change the work’s narrative context and Tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该油画在 MFA 19 世纪法国绘画馆藏中的比较位置，以及 MFA 是否将其作为多雷绘画实践或法国叙事绘画的代表性对象；答案不同会影响不可替代性。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for this painting’s comparative position within MFA’s nineteenth-century French holdings and whether MFA treats it as representative of Doré’s painting practice or French narrative painting; a different answer would affect irreplaceability.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对该作作者归属及其在法国绘画馆藏中代表性地位的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA confirmation of the attribution and representative status within its French painting holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 Loiseau 归属、1904 年年代及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品的后印象派定位和 Tier 依据可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Loiseau attribution, 1904 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the work’s post-Impressionist positioning and Tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 法国后印象派风景画馆藏中的比较位置，以及馆方是否赋予其 Loiseau 或该风景类型以代表性；这会直接影响当前 Tier 的不可替代性依据。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for this work’s comparative position within MFA’s French Post-Impressionist landscape holdings and whether MFA assigns it representative status for Loiseau or this landscape type; this directly affects the current Tier’s irreplaceability basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 后印象派风景馆藏中的比较位置与馆方代表性证据。
top_missing_en: The work’s comparative position and representative status within MFA’s Post-Impressionist landscape holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 Loiseau 归属、1900 年年代及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品的艺术史阶段和 Tier 依据可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Loiseau attribution, 1900 date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the work’s period and Tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该冬景与 898 号作品在 MFA 馆藏中的具体比较关系，以及馆方是否将其视为 Loiseau 河岸风景系列中的关键作品；答案不同会改变其可替代性判断。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for the specific comparative relationship between this winter scene and object 898 within MFA’s holdings, and for whether MFA treats it as a key work in Loiseau’s Eure-bank landscape series; a different answer would change its substitutability assessment.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作与同馆 Loiseau 河岸风景作品的权威比较及系列地位确认。
top_missing_en: Authoritative comparison with MFA’s other Loiseau Eure-bank landscapes and confirmation of its status within the series are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对梅姆林归属、创作年代及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品在早期尼德兰绘画中的定位和 Tier 依据可能改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record confirming the Memling attribution, date, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the work’s position in Early Netherlandish painting and its Tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 早期尼德兰绘画馆藏中的比较位置、馆方展陈地位及学术目录对其艺术史重要性的评价；这些事实直接支撑当前 B Tier 的代表性与不可替代性判断。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for this work’s comparative position and display status within MFA’s Early Netherlandish holdings, as well as scholarly-catalogue assessment of its art-historical importance; these facts directly support the current B Tier’s representativeness and irreplaceability assessment.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认梅姆林归属及该作在 MFA 早期尼德兰馆藏中的代表性地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the Memling attribution and the work’s representative position within MFA’s Early Netherlandish holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录对作者归属的确认，尤其是汉斯·梅姆林本人作品还是工作坊/追随者作品；该答案会直接改变作品的艺术史地位与定级依据。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official attribution, especially whether this is an autograph work by Hans Memling or a workshop/follower work; the answer would directly affect its art-historical status and tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 北欧文艺复兴绘画馆藏中的比较位置，以及馆方是否将其作为该板块的代表性作品；这会影响其不可替代性判断。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within MFA’s Northern Renaissance painting holdings and whether the museum treats it as representative of the area; this affects its irreplaceability assessment.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅页或部门页确认其当前馆藏状态与展出位置；这会影响现场可见性及其作为馆方叙事节点的判断。
missing.en: Missing an MFA gallery or department page confirming its current collection status and display location; this affects judgments of visibility and its role in the museum’s narrative.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对“梅姆林本人作品”还是“工作坊作品”的官方归属确认。
top_missing_en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of whether the work is by Memling himself or by his workshop.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录确认作者、作品标题、年代与媒材；现有 Wikidata 来源不足以排除作者归属或作品信息差异，而这些差异会影响定级。
missing.en: Missing an MFA official object record confirming the artist, title, date, and medium; the current Wikidata source does not exclude differences in attribution or object data, which would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 北欧矫饰主义及更广泛欧洲绘画馆藏中的比较位置，以及馆方对其代表性和独特性的判断；这是现有定级的重要依据。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within MFA’s Northern Mannerist and broader European painting holdings, including the museum’s assessment of its representativeness and distinctiveness; this is an important basis of the current tier.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅或部门资料确认其是否展出及其所在叙事单元；该事实会影响现场可见性对定级的作用。
missing.en: Missing MFA gallery or department documentation confirming whether it is displayed and in which narrative unit; this affects the role of visibility in the tier assessment.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对该作品在北欧矫饰主义馆藏中代表性与独特性的官方比较判断。
top_missing_en: Missing MFA’s official comparative assessment of the work’s representativeness and distinctiveness within its Northern Mannerist holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认标题、作者归属、绝对年代与媒材；目前仅有作者和藏品号，作者归属或年代变化会改变作品的艺术史定位。
missing.en: Missing an MFA official record confirming the title, attribution, absolute date, and medium; only the artist and accession number are present, and a change in attribution or date would affect the work’s art-historical positioning.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 北欧文艺复兴肖像画馆藏中的比较位置，以及馆方是否将其视为汉斯·沃汀格或德国文艺复兴肖像传统的代表作；这会影响当前 B 级依据。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within MFA’s Northern Renaissance portrait holdings and whether the museum regards it as representative of Hans Wertinger or German Renaissance portraiture; this affects the basis of the current tier.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅或部门资料确认其展出状态与展示语境；该事实会影响现场可见性和馆藏叙事作用。
missing.en: Missing MFA gallery or department documentation confirming its display status and presentation context; this affects visibility and its narrative role in the collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方作者归属、年代和媒材记录，现有字段不足以确认作品身份。
top_missing_en: Missing official attribution, date, and medium records; the existing fields are insufficient to confirm the object’s identity.

missing.zh: 缺该作品的 MFA 藏品号及官方对象页，因而无法核验《Beech Wood》的标题、作者归属、年代、媒材和馆藏身份；这些身份信息若不同会影响定级。
missing.en: Missing the MFA accession number and official object page, so the title, attribution, date, medium, and collection identity of Beech Wood cannot be verified; differences in these identity facts would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺 Harold Gilman 在 MFA 英国现代主义馆藏中的实际代表性，以及该作在其创作生涯中的位置；现有判断称其为卡姆登镇艺术圈重要画家，但没有外部资料支撑。
missing.en: Missing evidence of Harold Gilman’s actual representativeness within MFA’s British modernist holdings and of this work’s place in his career; the current claim about his importance in the Camden Town Group is unsupported by an external source.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏中同类英国后印象派与现代主义作品的数量及比较结果；“组内唯一”若不成立，会直接改变其不可替代性依据。
missing.en: Missing the number and comparative results of comparable British Post-Impressionist and modernist works in MFA’s collection; if it is not actually the sole example in the group, the basis for its irreplaceability changes.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录，当前连作品身份与馆藏存在都未得到官网核验。
top_missing_en: Missing an MFA official object record; the work’s identity and collection presence have not yet been verified on the museum’s website.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录确认作者归属、标题、年代与媒材；现有资料没有提供绝对年代，且仅凭 Wikidata 不足以排除归属或作品信息差异。
missing.en: Missing an MFA official object record confirming attribution, title, date, and medium; no absolute date is provided, and Wikidata alone does not exclude differences in attribution or object data.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰黄金时代绘画馆藏中的比较位置，特别是其相对于同类教堂内景画及馆内更重要荷兰作品的代表性；这是当前 B 级的重要依据。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within MFA’s Dutch Golden Age holdings, especially its representativeness relative to comparable church interiors and more important Dutch works in the museum; this is an important basis of the current tier.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅资料确认其是否在展及其展示语境；该事实会影响现场可见性与叙事价值。
missing.en: Missing MFA gallery documentation confirming whether it is on view and its presentation context; this affects visibility and narrative value.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰黄金时代馆藏中的官方比较位置。
top_missing_en: Missing the work’s official comparative position within MFA’s Dutch Golden Age holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录确认作者归属、标题、年代与媒材；现有资料没有绝对年代，且作者或题材归属变化会影响作品的历史定位。
missing.en: Missing an MFA official object record confirming attribution, title, date, and medium; no absolute date is provided, and a change in attribution or subject classification would affect the work’s historical positioning.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰黄金时代绘画馆藏中相对于其他 vanitas 和风俗画的比较位置；其代表性与重复度判断目前只有 AI 文字，没有馆方或学术来源。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position among MFA’s Dutch Golden Age vanitas and genre paintings; its representativeness and degree of repetition are currently supported only by AI-written text, not museum or scholarly sources.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅或部门资料确认其是否展出及其解释语境；这会影响现场可见性和馆藏叙事作用。
missing.en: Missing MFA gallery or department documentation confirming whether it is displayed and its interpretive context; this affects visibility and its narrative role in the collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作相对于 MFA 同类 vanitas 与风俗画的官方比较证据。
top_missing_en: Missing official comparative evidence for the work against MFA’s comparable vanitas and genre paintings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录确认霍尔奇尼斯的作者归属、标题、年代与媒材；这些信息若发生变化会影响其作为北欧矫饰主义代表作的定级依据。
missing.en: Missing an MFA official object record confirming Goltzius’s attribution, title, date, and medium; changes in these facts would affect the basis for treating it as representative of Northern Mannerism.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 北欧矫饰主义馆藏中的比较位置，以及馆方是否将其视为霍尔奇尼斯或该流派的代表性作品；现有“组内排名第1”没有外部证据。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within MFA’s Northern Mannerist holdings and whether the museum regards it as representative of Goltzius or the movement; the stated number-one group ranking has no external evidence.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅或部门资料确认其当前展出状态与叙事单元；这会影响现场可见性对定级的作用。
missing.en: Missing MFA gallery or department documentation confirming its current display status and narrative unit; this affects the role of visibility in the tier assessment.

top_missing_zh: 缺“组内排名第1”所依据的 MFA 同类馆藏比较证据。
top_missing_en: Missing the MFA comparative evidence supporting the claim that it ranks first among comparable works.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录确认标题、作者归属、年代与媒材；现有 Wikidata 资料不能充分证明该作确属 Hendrick ten Oever，归属变化会影响其低替代性判断。
missing.en: Missing an MFA official object record confirming the title, attribution, date, and medium; the current Wikidata data does not sufficiently establish that the work is by Hendrick ten Oever, and a change in attribution would affect its replaceability assessment.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰黄金时代绘画馆藏中相对于牧牛风景和动物画的实际比较位置及存世替代数量；“常规、重复度最高”若不成立，会直接影响当前 C 级依据。
missing.en: Missing the work’s actual comparative position among MFA’s Dutch Golden Age pastoral and animal paintings and the number of available substitutes; if the claims of conventionality and highest repetition are untrue, the basis of the current tier changes directly.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方资料确认其是否展出及是否被纳入荷兰黄金时代展厅叙事；该事实会影响其馆藏价值和现场可见性判断。
missing.en: Missing MFA documentation confirming whether it is displayed and included in the Dutch Golden Age gallery narrative; this affects judgments of collection value and visibility.
