missing.zh: 缺 MFA 法国现代绘画馆藏中弗拉曼克同类作品的可核对数量、代表性排序及本作相对于《Paysage de Banlieue》的比较依据；该比较直接支撑其仅属优秀而非核心作品的判断。
missing.en: Missing a verifiable comparison of the number and relative importance of comparable Vlaminck works in MFA’s French modern collection, including the basis for ranking this work against Paysage de Banlieue; this comparison directly supports its classification as good rather than core.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 或权威图录对作品归属、年代、艺术史定位及其在馆内同类作品中相对位置的证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence is missing from MFA or an authoritative catalogue for the attribution, date, art-historical status, and relative position among comparable MFA holdings.

missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the 1905 date, Vlaminck attribution, and whether the work belongs to his early Fauvist period; a different date or attribution would change the early-Fauvism basis for the tier.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 弗拉曼克及法国现代绘画馆藏中的相对代表性、展览或图录地位证据；若馆方将其视为普通或核心作品，当前 Tier 依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing evidence of this work’s relative representative status and exhibition or catalogue position within MFA’s Vlaminck and French modern holdings; a different curatorial assessment as ordinary or core would affect the tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认其 1905 年早期野兽派定位，以及它在 MFA 同类馆藏中的代表性位置。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for its 1905 early-Fauvist status and representative position among comparable MFA holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认《The Philosopher's Tower》的准确创作年代、郁特里罗归属及其在艺术家创作阶段中的位置；若并非 1920 年成熟期作品，当前代表性依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the exact date, Utrillo attribution, and position within the artist’s career; if it is not a 1920 mature-period work, the basis for its representativeness would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 郁特里罗城市风景馆藏中的相对地位及与其他同作者作品的比较证据；这是“组内代表性最高”判断的直接依据。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s relative standing within MFA’s Utrillo cityscape holdings and comparison with other works by the artist; this directly supports the claim that it is the group’s most representative work.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认其创作阶段，并缺其在 MFA 郁特里罗馆藏中的相对代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for its career-period placement and relative representativeness within MFA’s Utrillo holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认作品的创作年代、郁特里罗归属及具体题材/风格阶段；仅有题名和艺术家不足以证明其在郁特里罗街景作品中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the work’s date, Utrillo attribution, and precise subject/style period; title and artist alone do not establish its representativeness among Utrillo street scenes.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 同组郁特里罗城市风景作品的可核对比较，包括艺术史地位、质量或馆方展示/图录地位；其相对位置直接关系到当前 B 级判断。
missing.en: Missing a verifiable comparison with MFA’s other Utrillo cityscapes, including art-historical importance, quality, or curatorial catalogue/display status; its relative position directly bears on the current B-tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品断代与归属的权威确认，以及其在 MFA 同类郁特里罗作品中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation is missing for the date and attribution, as well as the work’s relative position among comparable Utrillo works at MFA.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认 1935 年断代、郁特里罗归属及其创作阶段；若并非晚期作品，关于其晚期、常见题材和有限突破性的判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the 1935 date, Utrillo attribution, and career period; if it is not a late-period work, the assessment of it as a late, conventional subject with limited innovation would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 同类城市风景中的相对代表性、质量和馆方定位证据；其是否属于重复性最高、补充性馆藏直接影响当前 C 级依据。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s relative representativeness, quality, and curatorial position among MFA’s comparable cityscapes; whether it is the most repetitive and supplementary holding directly affects the current C-tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认其晚期创作定位，以及其在 MFA 同类馆藏中的最低相对代表性。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for its late-period positioning and lowest relative representativeness among comparable MFA holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认《The Tempest》的贝克曼归属、1949 年断代及其在战后创作中的具体位置；若归属或年代不同，战后重要作品的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the Beckmann attribution, 1949 date, and precise position within his postwar work; a different attribution or date would change the basis for treating it as an important postwar work.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 贝克曼及现代欧洲绘画馆藏中的权威比较依据，包括展览、图录或策展定位；“组内综合代表性最高”尚无外部证据支撑。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparative evidence within MFA’s Beckmann and modern European holdings, such as exhibition, catalogue, or curatorial positioning; the claim that it is the group’s most representative work lacks external support.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认其战后创作定位，以及其在 MFA 贝克曼馆藏中的核心代表性。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for its postwar positioning and core representativeness within MFA’s Beckmann holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认《Still Life with Three Skulls》的贝克曼归属、1945 年断代及其与战后死亡主题的关系；若作品身份或年代不同，当前艺术史价值依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the Beckmann attribution, 1945 date, and relationship to postwar themes of mortality; a different identity or date would change the basis for its art-historical value.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他贝克曼作品的权威比较，尤其是其相对于《The Tempest》的代表性和馆藏优先级；该比较直接支撑当前 B 级而非更高等级的依据。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparison with MFA’s other Beckmann works, especially its representativeness and priority relative to The Tempest; this directly supports the current B-tier rather than a higher-tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认其战后主题定位，以及它相对于 MFA 其他贝克曼作品的代表性。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for its postwar thematic position and representativeness relative to MFA’s other Beckmann works.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认《Double Portrait》的贝克曼归属、1946 年断代及其在成熟期肖像创作中的位置；若归属或年代不同，当前艺术史价值判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the Beckmann attribution, 1946 date, and position within his mature portraiture; a different attribution or date would change the current art-historical assessment.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他贝克曼作品的相对比较证据，尤其是其题材辨识度、视觉影响和馆方定位是否确实最低；这些事实直接支撑当前 B 级依据。
missing.en: Missing comparative evidence against MFA’s other Beckmann works, especially whether its subject has the lowest distinctiveness, visual impact, and curatorial priority; these facts directly support the current B-tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认作品身份与成熟期肖像定位，以及其在 MFA 贝克曼馆藏中的相对优先级。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for the work’s identity and mature-portrait position, as well as its relative priority within MFA’s Beckmann holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆史资料或权威来源确认肖像人物 Perry T. Rathbone 的身份、其与 MFA 的具体关系，以及这件肖像是否具有馆史叙事地位；若人物并非该馆关键人物，当前 IU 与馆史价值依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA institutional-history documentation or an authoritative source confirming Perry T. Rathbone’s identity, his specific relationship to MFA, and whether the portrait has institutional-narrative significance; if he was not a key museum figure, the current IU and museum-history basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认贝克曼归属、1948 年断代及该肖像在其创作中的位置。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the Beckmann attribution, 1948 date, and the portrait’s position within his oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺该作相对于 MFA 其他贝克曼作品的比较证据，尤其是馆史补位价值与艺术家代表性之间的权威定位。
missing.en: Missing comparative evidence against MFA’s other Beckmann works, especially an authoritative assessment balancing its institutional-history value against its representativeness of the artist.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源证明 Rathbone 的 MFA 馆史身份及该肖像的馆史地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for Rathbone’s institutional role at MFA and the portrait’s museum-history significance.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认 Rudolf Schramm-Zittau 的艺术家身份、作品归属、年代与艺术史地位；若艺术家身份或归属不同，当前低艺术史影响和低 Tier 依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of Rudolf Schramm-Zittau’s identity, the work’s attribution, date, and art-historical standing; a different artist identity or attribution would change the basis for its low art-historical impact and tier.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏中德国动物题材油画的可核对范围，以及本作确为该组唯一对象的证据；若存在未纳入的同类核心作品，组内代表性判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing a verifiable accounting of MFA’s German animal-subject paintings and evidence that this is truly the only object in that group; an omitted comparable core work would change the group-representativeness assessment.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认艺术家与作品身份，并缺证据证明它在 MFA 同类馆藏中确属唯一且艺术史影响有限。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation is missing for the artist and work identity, along with evidence that it is truly unique among MFA’s comparable holdings and has limited art-historical impact.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认 Maxime Maufra 的艺术史定位、作品归属与 1900 年断代，以及其是否属于法国后印象派海景绘画；若艺术家归属、年代或风格分类不同，当前 Tier 依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of Maxime Maufra’s art-historical standing, the work’s attribution and 1900 date, and its classification as a French Post-Impressionist seascape; a different attribution, date, or classification would change the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 法国绘画馆藏中同类海景作品的可核对数量与比较证据，尤其是本作是否确为该组唯一对象及其相对代表性。
missing.en: Missing a verifiable count and comparison of comparable seascapes in MFA’s French painting holdings, especially evidence that this is truly the only object in the group and documentation of its relative representativeness.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认 Maufra 及作品的风格定位，并缺其在 MFA 同类海景馆藏中的唯一性与相对代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for Maufra’s and the work’s stylistic positioning, as well as its uniqueness and relative representativeness among MFA’s comparable seascapes.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认 Melchior d'Hondecoeter 的艺术家定位、作品归属与 1665 年断代，以及其在荷兰黄金时代动物画中的代表性；若归属或年代不同，当前艺术史依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of Melchior d'Hondecoeter’s artistic standing, the work’s attribution and 1665 date, and its representativeness within Dutch Golden Age animal painting; a different attribution or date would change the current art-historical basis.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏中荷兰黄金时代动物画的可核对范围与比较证据，尤其是本作是否确为该组唯一对象，以及其相对于同类作品的馆方优先级。
missing.en: Missing a verifiable accounting and comparison of Dutch Golden Age animal paintings in MFA’s holdings, especially evidence that this is truly the only object in the group and its curatorial priority relative to comparable works.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认作品的艺术史定位，并缺证据证明它在 MFA 荷兰黄金时代动物画中确属唯一且具有相应代表性。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence is missing for the work’s art-historical position and for whether it is truly unique and appropriately representative among MFA’s Dutch Golden Age animal paintings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对艺术家归属、作品标题及 2002 年创作信息的确认；若实际归属为工作室、学生或其他艺术家，作品的艺术史地位与 Tier 依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the artist attribution, title, and 2002 creation date is missing; if the work is attributed to a studio, student, or another artist, its art-historical significance and Tier basis could change.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 当代艺术收藏中的策展定位，以及是否为馆方重点展示或重点叙事对象的资料；这会直接影响其在馆内的不可替代性与可见性判断。
missing.en: The work’s curatorial position within MFA’s contemporary-art collection, including whether MFA treats or displays it as a focal object, is missing; this directly affects judgments of in-museum distinctiveness and visibility.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 同类当代欧洲具象绘画的完整比较范围，无法核实该作在馆内同类中的相对位置。
missing.en: The complete MFA comparison set for contemporary European figurative painting is missing, so the work’s relative position among comparable holdings cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作品归属及其在当代艺术收藏中策展地位的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and the work’s curatorial position in its contemporary-art collection is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对范米勒费尔特归属、标题及 1616 年创作日期的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品在17世纪荷兰肖像史中的位置会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the van Mierevelt attribution, title, and 1616 date is missing; a different attribution or date would change the work’s position in seventeenth-century Dutch portrait history.

missing.zh: 缺该肖像所描绘人物 Adriana van Ijlen 的身份、社会背景及其与画家或委托体系的关系；这些信息可能决定作品是否具有超出常规肖像的历史叙事价值。
missing.en: The identity, social background, and relationship to the artist or commissioning network of the sitter, Adriana van Ijlen, are missing; these facts could determine whether the portrait has historical significance beyond a conventional portrait.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰绘画收藏中的策展定位、展陈状态及与同类肖像的比较资料。
missing.en: The work’s curatorial position, display status, and comparison with similar Dutch portraits in MFA’s collection are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺被描绘人物的身份与历史背景，以及 MFA 对该作策展地位的确认。
top_missing_en: The sitter’s identity and historical context, together with MFA’s confirmation of the work’s curatorial position, are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对该作是否确为范米勒费尔特作品、以及其“普林森霍夫藏本半身肖像版本”关系的确认；若并非明确的版本关系，作品的重复性与独特性判断会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation that the work is by van Mierevelt and is a version of the Prinsenhof half-length portrait is missing; if that relationship is not established, judgments of repetition and distinctiveness could change.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 对该作与代尔夫特普林森霍夫相关藏本之间构图、人物及制作关系的图录或学术说明。
missing.en: A catalogue or scholarly account from MFA documenting the compositional, sitter, and production relationship to the Prinsenhof, Delft, version is missing.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 17世纪荷兰肖像收藏中的展陈与策展定位，以及同类作品比较范围。
missing.en: The work’s display and curatorial position within MFA’s seventeenth-century Dutch portrait holdings, as well as the comparison set of similar works, are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对其与普林森霍夫藏本关系及重复性判断的官方或学术确认。
top_missing_en: MFA’s official or scholarly confirmation of its relationship to the Prinsenhof version and the resulting degree of repetition is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对艺术家归属、标题及 1948 年日期的确认；若作品并非卡斯特本人或年代不同，其艺术史价值与区域代表性会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the artist attribution, title, and 1948 date is missing; if the work is not by Castel or has a different date, its art-historical and regional significance could change.

missing.zh: 缺该作在卡斯特创作生涯中的位置，以及其与以色列现代艺术、宗教主题或战后文化语境的具体关系。
missing.en: The work’s position within Castel’s career and its specific relationship to Israeli modernism, religious subject matter, or the postwar cultural context are missing.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 现代艺术或相关地域艺术收藏中的策展定位、展陈状态及同类作品比较资料。
missing.en: The work’s curatorial position, display status, and comparison with related works in MFA’s modern or regional-art holdings are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在卡斯特创作生涯及以色列现代艺术史中的具体定位。
top_missing_en: The work’s specific position in Castel’s career and in the history of Israeli modern art is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对 Naddo Ceccarelli 归属及作品标题的确认；若实际归属为工作室、追随者或其他画家，作品的历史重要性会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the Naddo Ceccarelli attribution and title is missing; if the work is instead by a studio, follower, or another artist, its historical significance could change.

missing.zh: 缺作品的确切年代、媒材及技术资料，无法核实其在14世纪意大利宗教绘画发展中的位置。
missing.en: The precise date, medium, and technical documentation are missing, preventing verification of its position in the development of fourteenth-century Italian religious painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作是否曾被 MFA 作为中世纪意大利绘画或馆内核心宗教艺术叙事中的代表作品展示的资料。
missing.en: Evidence is missing as to whether MFA presents the work as representative of Italian medieval painting or as part of a core institutional narrative of religious art.

top_missing_zh: 缺对 Naddo Ceccarelli 归属及确切年代的 MFA 官方确认。
top_missing_en: MFA’s official confirmation of the Naddo Ceccarelli attribution and precise date is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对艺术家归属、标题及作品主题的确认；若标题或归属不同，关于巴比松派与东方主义题材的判断会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the artist attribution, title, and subject is missing; a different title or attribution would change the assessment of its Barbizon and Orientalist significance.

missing.zh: 缺该作的确切创作年代与媒材资料，无法核实其在迪亚斯创作及19世纪法国风景画语境中的位置。
missing.en: The precise date and medium are missing, preventing verification of its position in Diaz’s career and in the context of nineteenth-century French landscape painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 法国绘画收藏中的展陈状态、策展定位及与其他迪亚斯作品的比较资料。
missing.en: The work’s display status, curatorial position within MFA’s French painting collection, and comparison with other Diaz works are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作的确切年代、媒材及 MFA 在法国绘画收藏中的策展定位。
top_missing_en: The precise date, medium, and MFA’s curatorial positioning of the work within its French painting collection are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作品标题、艺术家归属及 1847 年日期的确认；若“Venus and Cupid (II)”的编号或归属不成立，作品的重复性判断会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the title, artist attribution, and 1847 date is missing; if the “Venus and Cupid (II)” designation or attribution is not established, the assessment of repetition could change.

missing.zh: 缺该作与其他《Venus and Cupid》版本之间的构图、尺寸、制作时间及来源比较，无法确认其是否确属高度重复的一组作品。
missing.en: Comparative information on composition, dimensions, production dates, and provenance among the different Venus and Cupid versions is missing, so their degree of repetition cannot be confirmed.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 法国绘画收藏中的展陈与策展定位。
missing.en: The work’s display and curatorial position within MFA’s French painting collection are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺不同《Venus and Cupid》版本之间的可核查比较，无法支撑其重复性判断。
top_missing_en: Verifiable comparison among the different Venus and Cupid versions is missing, so the repetition assessment cannot be supported.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对艺术家归属、标题及 1867 年日期的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品在巴比松风景画中的代表性会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the artist attribution, title, and 1867 date is missing; a different attribution or date would change the work’s representativeness within Barbizon landscape painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作在迪亚斯创作生涯及巴比松画派发展中的具体位置，以及其是否被学术图录视为代表性风景作品的资料。
missing.en: The work’s specific position in Diaz’s career and in the development of the Barbizon school, including whether scholarly catalogues treat it as a representative landscape, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 法国绘画收藏中的展陈状态、策展定位及与馆内其他巴比松作品的比较范围。
missing.en: The work’s display status, curatorial position within MFA’s French painting collection, and comparison set with other Barbizon works in the museum are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在迪亚斯生涯和巴比松画派中的学术定位，以及 MFA 的策展确认。
top_missing_en: The work’s scholarly position in Diaz’s career and the Barbizon school, together with MFA’s curatorial confirmation, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对艺术家归属、标题及 1847 年日期的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品的风格和历史位置会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official confirmation of the artist attribution, title, and 1847 date is missing; a different attribution or date would change the work’s stylistic and historical position.

missing.zh: 缺该作与迪亚斯其他女性沐浴题材作品的构图、尺寸、年代及制作关系比较，无法核实其主题重复程度。
missing.en: Comparative data on composition, dimensions, dates, and production relationships between this work and Diaz’s other bathing-women subjects are missing, so thematic repetition cannot be verified.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 法国绘画收藏中的展陈状态与策展定位。
missing.en: The work’s display status and curatorial position within MFA’s French painting collection are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作与同题材迪亚斯作品的可核查比较，无法支撑其“常规且可替代”的判断。
top_missing_en: Verifiable comparison with Diaz’s works on the same subject is missing, so the judgment that it is conventional and replaceable cannot be supported.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作品标题、艺术家归属、1847 年日期及油彩媒材的确认；若“Venus and Cupid (I)”的编号或归属不成立，作品的重复性判断会改变。

missing.en: A verifiable comparison with the MFA’s nineteenth-century French Romantic landscape holdings is missing, needed to establish that this work has a distinctive supplementary role in that category.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对象记录或学术资料确认作者归属、1871 年断代及媒材；若作者或作品身份不同，其作为比利时海景画代表的判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA object record or scholarly source confirming the attribution, 1871 date, and medium is missing; a different attribution or object identity would change the assessment of it as a representative Belgian marine painting.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 馆藏中 19 世纪比利时海景画的可核实比较，以确认该作是否确为该类别中唯一或最具代表性的对象。
missing.en: A verifiable comparison with the MFA’s nineteenth-century Belgian marine paintings is missing, needed to confirm whether this work is actually unique or the most representative object in that category.

missing.en: An MFA object record or scholarly source confirming the attribution, 1882 date, medium, and the Franco-Prussian War scene identified by the title is missing; a different object identity or subject would change its historical-narrative value and present classification.

missing.en: Scholarly evidence concerning Paul Grolleron’s position in nineteenth-century French war painting and the relative importance of this work is missing; a substantially different assessment of his significance would change the basis for the current C tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认作品的普法战争题材及 Paul Grolleron 的艺术史地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the Franco-Prussian War subject and Paul Grolleron’s art-historical standing is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对象记录或学术资料确认作者归属、1880 年断代及作品题名与图像内容的一致性；若作品身份不同，当前关于其常规战争题材和重复性的判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA object record or scholarly source confirming the attribution, 1880 date, and consistency between the title and depicted subject is missing; a different object identity would change the assessment of its conventionality and redundancy.

missing.en: A verifiable ranking or comparison with the MFA’s other war-subject works by the same artist is missing, needed to support the claim that its narrative quality is second within the group rather than merely repetitive.

top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the battlefield scene identified by the title and the work’s relative representativeness among the MFA’s holdings by the same artist is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对象记录或学术资料确认作品的具体创作年代、媒材及题名所指的雪地士兵场景；若作品身份或媒材不同，当前艺术史定位可能改变。
missing.en: An MFA object record or scholarly source confirming the work’s specific date, medium, and the snowbound-soldier scene identified by the title is missing; a different object identity or medium could change its art-historical positioning.

missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the work’s attribution, date, and medium; if it is not by Signac himself, its art-historical standing and the basis for the current tier would change.

missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the work’s attribution, date, and medium; a different attribution or date would change its historical representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA西涅克藏品中的相对地位，以及馆方是否将其作为法国新印象主义或西涅克的重要展品。
missing.en: Missing the work’s relative position within MFA’s Signac holdings and whether the museum treats it as a significant Neo-Impressionist or Signac display.

missing.zh: 缺与其他西涅克及同类新印象主义风景画的馆藏比较，尤其缺该作是否与馆内已有作品高度重复的证据。
missing.en: Missing comparison with MFA’s other Signac and comparable Neo-Impressionist landscapes, especially evidence of whether the work is highly redundant within the collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在MFA西涅克藏品中的相对位置及与同类作品的馆藏比较。

missing.zh: 缺该艺术家在艺术史中的可核实地位，以及该作品在其创作生涯中的位置。

top_missing_zh: 首先缺“Paul Vernon”具体身份及作者归属的馆方确认；当前连艺术家和作品的基本归类都未被可靠资料支撑。
top_missing_en: The primary gap is MFA confirmation of the specific identity and attribution of Paul Vernon; the basic classification of both artist and work is not reliably supported.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认该画确为Paulus Moreelse本人作品，而非工作室、追随者或后来的归属；归属不同会改变其艺术史与馆藏代表性。

top_missing_zh: 缺作者归属的馆方确认及该作在MFA荷兰黄金时代肖像藏品中的相对位置。

missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of Pavel Tchelitchew’s identity, the work’s attribution, and its date; a different artist, workshop attribution, or date would change the art-historical assessment.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作的馆方归属确认，以及其在Tchelitchew创作和MFA现代主义肖像藏品中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: Missing MFA attribution confirmation and the work’s relative position within Tchelitchew’s career and MFA’s modernist portrait holdings.

missing.en: Missing the work’s place within the artist’s career and within the development of fifteenth-century Italian religious painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA早期意大利绘画藏品中的展陈地位、馆方代表性及同类比较位置。
missing.en: Missing the work’s display status, curatorial representativeness, and comparative position within MFA’s early Italian painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 首先缺“Peregrinus”的具体身份和作者归属确认；这决定该作是否能支撑现有的早期文艺复兴代表性判断。
top_missing_en: The primary gap is identification of “Peregrinus” and confirmation of the attribution, which determines whether the work supports the current claim of early Renaissance representativeness.

missing.en: Missing MFA or scholarly confirmation of the attribution “Pensionante del Saraceni” and its relationship to Carlo Saraceni’s workshop or followers; a different attribution would change the work’s art-historical importance.

missing.en: Missing the work’s specific position within Caravaggesque religious painting and its representativeness relative to major masters and comparable works.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA意大利巴洛克绘画藏品中的馆方定位和同类比较位置。
missing.en: Missing the museum’s curatorial positioning of the work and its comparative place within MFA’s Italian Baroque holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作归属“Pensionante del Saraceni”的学术确认及其在MFA意大利巴洛克藏品中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: Missing scholarly confirmation of the “Pensionante del Saraceni” attribution and the work’s relative position within MFA’s Italian Baroque holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认该作的创作年代、作者归属和媒材；若归属不是Petr Brandl本人，现有艺术家重要性依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the work’s date, attribution, and medium; if it is not by Petr Brandl himself, the current basis concerning the artist’s importance would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作在Petr Brandl创作生涯及中欧巴洛克宗教绘画中的具体位置。
missing.en: Missing the work’s specific place within Petr Brandl’s career and within Central European Baroque religious painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA中欧绘画藏品中的馆方代表性、展陈地位及同类比较位置。
missing.en: Missing the work’s curatorial representativeness, display status, and comparative position within MFA’s Central European painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺作者归属和作品年代的馆方确认，以及该作在MFA中欧巴洛克绘画板块中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: Missing MFA confirmation of attribution and date, as well as the work’s relative position within the museum’s Central European Baroque holdings.

missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation that the work is by Peter Candid himself, together with confirmation of date and medium; a different attribution would change its art-historical representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA北方文艺复兴与矫饰主义绘画藏品中的馆方定位及同类比较位置。

top_missing_zh: 缺Candid本人归属的馆方确认，以及该作在MFA北方矫饰主义绘画藏品中的相对位置。

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认Peter De Wint的作者身份、作品归属、创作年代和媒材；这些信息若不同，会改变其艺术史与馆藏分类。

missing.zh: 缺该作在De Wint创作生涯及英国浪漫主义风景画史中的位置。
missing.en: Missing the work’s place within De Wint’s career and the history of British Romantic landscape painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA英国风景画藏品中的相对位置，以及与透纳、康斯特勃及其他同类作品的具体比较。
missing.en: Missing the work’s relative position within MFA’s British landscape holdings and concrete comparison with Turner, Constable, and other comparable works.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品归属与年代的馆方确认，以及它在MFA英国风景画藏品中的比较位置。

missing.en: Missing MFA identification of the specific artist Peter Kaiser and confirmation of attribution, date, and medium; a different identity or attribution would change the current art-historical assessment.

missing.zh: 缺该作在MFA现代艺术藏品中的展陈地位、馆方代表性及同类比较位置。
missing.en: Missing the work’s display status, curatorial representativeness, and comparative position within MFA’s modern-art holdings.

top_missing_zh: 首先缺Peter Kaiser的具体身份和作品归属确认；当前无法核验其是否具有足以支撑现有判断的艺术史地位。
top_missing_en: The primary gap is identification of Peter Kaiser and confirmation of the work’s attribution; its art-historical standing cannot currently be verified.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否有特殊委托、船主或航运史背景，以及这些背景是否使其超出常规海事画；现有资料未提供此事实。
missing.en: Missing whether the work has a distinctive commission, owner, or shipping-history context that would elevate it beyond a routine maritime painting; the existing material does not provide this fact.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是该船舶肖像是否具有已确认的特殊航运史背景，而非仅为常规海事题材。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether the ship portrait has a documented distinctive shipping-history context rather than being a routine maritime subject.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作者归属及“船厂火灾”事件识别的确认，以及馆方对该件在 Salmon 海事绘画中的代表性评价。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and identification of the shipyard-fire event, together with its assessment of the work’s representativeness among Salmon’s maritime paintings.

missing.zh: 缺该火灾是否对应可考的地方工业史事件、是否有展览史或馆方重点展示地位；现有来源未确认这些事实。
missing.en: Missing whether the fire corresponds to a documented local industrial-history event and whether the work has exhibition history or featured curatorial status; the existing source does not confirm these facts.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是“火灾”是否为可考的具体历史事件，以及馆方是否据此赋予作品超出常规海事画的地位。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether the depicted fire is a documented historical event and whether MFA consequently treats the work as more than a routine maritime painting.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作者归属和作品识别的确认，以及馆方对其在 Robert Salmon 船岸题材和美国海事绘画中的相对地位评价。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and object identification, together with its assessment of the work’s relative position among Robert Salmon’s shore-and-ship subjects and American maritime paintings.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否具有未记录的具体地点、事件、委托或收藏史，从而使其超出一般船岸风景；现有资料未提供这些事实。
missing.en: Missing whether the work has an undocumented specific location, event, commission, or collecting history that would distinguish it from a generic shore-and-ship view; the existing material provides none of these facts.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是是否存在能改变其常规船岸风景性质的具体地点或历史背景。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether a specific location or historical context exists that would change its status from a routine shore-and-ship view.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作者归属和作品识别的确认，以及馆方对人物、海岸与船只组合在 Salmon 美国海事绘画中的代表性评价。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and object identification, together with its assessment of the representativeness of the figures, shore, and vessel composition within Salmon’s American maritime paintings.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否具有可识别的地方社会史、人物身份或具体地点背景；现有资料未确认这些可能改变其叙事价值的事实。
missing.en: Missing whether the work has an identifiable local social-history context, identifiable figures, or a specific location; the existing material does not confirm facts that could alter its narrative significance.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是人物与地点是否具有可考的具体身份或社会史背景。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether the figures or location have a documented identity or social-history context.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作者归属的确认，以及馆方对该件在 Salmon 风暴海景和美国海事绘画中的相对代表性评价。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and its assessment of the work’s relative representativeness among Salmon’s storm seascapes and American maritime paintings.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否具有特殊委托、航难或具体船舶史背景，以及是否因展览史或馆方叙事成为重点展品；现有来源未确认这些事实。
missing.en: Missing whether the work has a distinctive commission, shipwreck, or vessel-history context, and whether exhibition history or curatorial narrative has made it a featured object; the existing source does not confirm these facts.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是风暴场景是否对应可考的具体航海事件或船舶背景，而不只是一般性的戏剧化构图。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether the storm scene corresponds to a documented maritime event or vessel history rather than being only a generally dramatic composition.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作者归属的确认，以及学术或馆方资料对该件在 Roelandt Savery 风景画创作中的位置和质量的评价。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and scholarly or curatorial assessment of the work’s position and quality within Roelandt Savery’s landscape production.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否被馆方纳入荷兰与佛兰德早期风景画的重点展示或教学叙事；现有来源未确认展厅与在展状态。
missing.en: Missing whether the work is included in a featured display or teaching narrative on early Dutch and Flemish landscape painting; the existing source does not confirm gallery placement or on-view status.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是学术或馆方对该件在 Savery 风景画创作中的具体艺术史位置评价。
top_missing_en: The key gap is scholarly or curatorial assessment of the work’s specific art-historical position within Savery’s landscape production.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作者归属的确认，以及学术或馆方资料对该件在 Roelandt Savery 风景画创作中的地位、质量和代表性的评价。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and scholarly or curatorial assessment of the work’s position, quality, and representativeness within Roelandt Savery’s landscape production.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否因岩石地貌与动物组合、展览史或馆方叙事而被列为 Savery 或早期荷兰风景画的重点展品；现有来源未确认这一点。
missing.en: Missing whether the work is treated as a featured Savery or early Dutch landscape object because of its rocky-animal composition, exhibition history, or curatorial narrative; the existing source does not confirm this.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是馆方或学术资料是否确认其为 Savery 风景画中具有突出代表性的作品。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether curatorial or scholarly sources identify it as an especially representative work within Savery’s landscapes.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方对作者归属的确认，以及馆方或学术资料对 Roland Oudot 在法国现代具象绘画中的历史地位和该件作品质量的评价。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official confirmation of the attribution and curatorial or scholarly assessment of Roland Oudot’s historical position in French modern figurative painting and of this work’s quality.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否具有特殊展览史、创作系列背景或馆方叙事功能，从而使其不只是法国现代具象绘画中的一般样本；现有资料未确认这些事实。
missing.en: Missing whether the work has a distinctive exhibition history, series context, or curatorial role that would make it more than a routine sample of French modern figurative painting; the existing material does not confirm these facts.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是馆方或学术资料对 Oudot 及该件作品是否具有超出常规样本的艺术史地位评价。
top_missing_en: The key gap is curatorial or scholarly assessment of whether Oudot and this work have art-historical significance beyond that of a routine example.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方馆藏记录或权威图录对艺术家归属、作品题名与1992年创作年代的确认；若归属并非罗斯玛丽·特罗克尔，或年代与战后德国当代艺术定位不符，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA collection record or authoritative catalogue confirming the artist attribution, title, and 1992 date is missing; if the work is not by Rosemarie Trockel or does not belong to the stated postwar German contemporary context, the Tier judgment could change.

missing.zh: 缺MFA策展或图录对该作在特罗克尔创作生涯及MFA战后德国艺术收藏中的代表性定位，无法支撑其作为该同类组唯一对象的实际重要性。
missing.en: MFA curatorial or catalogue placement of the work within Trockel’s career and the museum’s postwar German art holdings is missing, so its actual representativeness as the sole object in this peer group is unsupported.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官网确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态，无法核实其是否具有对游客可见的观赏与参观优先价值。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing, so the work’s visitor-facing viewing and priority value cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认该作的艺术家归属及其在MFA战后德国艺术收藏中的代表性；这两项直接支撑当前B级。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the attribution and the work’s representativeness within MFA’s postwar German art holdings is missing; both directly support the current Tier B.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认Rueland Frueauf the Elder的艺术家归属、题名及1506年年代；若实际归属、年代或作品性质不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming the attribution to Rueland Frueauf the Elder, the title, and the 1506 date is missing; a different attribution, date, or object identity could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该作在弗吕奥夫长老创作生涯、德国文艺复兴宗教绘画及MFA北方文艺复兴收藏中的具体代表性。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence placing the work within Frueauf’s career, German Renaissance religious painting, and MFA’s Northern Renaissance holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态，无法核实其实际参观可见性。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing, so its actual visitor visibility cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认作品归属及其在MFA北方文艺复兴收藏中的代表性。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the attribution and the work’s representativeness within MFA’s Northern Renaissance holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认Salomon Koninck的艺术家归属、题名、年代及作品是否为独立肖像画；若归属为更重要画家或作品性质不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming the attribution to Salomon Koninck, title, date, and whether this is an independent portrait painting is missing; a different attribution or object identity could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺MFA策展或图录对该作在荷兰黄金时代肖像画及MFA同类收藏中的相对地位，现有资料不足以支撑其为常规、重复性较高的对象。
missing.en: MFA curatorial or catalogue assessment of the work’s relative position among Dutch Golden Age portraits and within MFA’s holdings is missing; the claim that it is a routine, highly repetitive object is unsupported.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态，无法核实其游客可见性。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing, so visitor visibility cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威归属确认及其在MFA荷兰黄金时代肖像收藏中的相对地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative attribution confirmation and evidence of the work’s relative position within MFA’s Dutch Golden Age portrait holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认Salomon van Ruysdael、1646年及油彩媒材；若艺术家归属或年代不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming Salomon van Ruysdael, the 1646 date, and the oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该作在萨洛蒙·范勒伊斯达尔创作生涯及MFA荷兰黄金时代风景画收藏中的相对排名，尤其缺少与雅各布·范勒伊斯达尔等馆藏作品的直接比较。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence of the work’s relative position within Salomon van Ruysdael’s career and MFA’s Dutch Golden Age landscape holdings is missing, especially direct comparison with works by Jacob van Ruisdael and other holdings.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态，无法核实其参观优先价值。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing, so its visitor-priority value cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在MFA荷兰黄金时代风景画收藏中的相对排名及与馆藏同类作品的比较证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the work’s relative rank within MFA’s Dutch Golden Age landscape holdings and comparison with related works in the collection is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认Samuel Peploe的艺术家归属、玫瑰静物题名及油彩媒材；若归属或作品身份不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming Samuel Peploe’s attribution, the rose still-life title, and the oil medium is missing; a different attribution or object identity could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该作在Peploe创作生涯、苏格兰色彩派及MFA现代欧洲艺术收藏中的代表性，尤其缺少其是否为艺术家公认代表作的证据。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence of the work’s representativeness within Peploe’s career, the Scottish Colourists, and MFA’s modern European holdings is missing, particularly evidence that it is a recognized representative work by the artist.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态，无法核实其实际观赏优先级。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing, so its actual viewing priority cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认该作是否为Peploe的代表性作品，以及其在MFA现代欧洲艺术收藏中的地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence that this is a representative Peploe work and of its position within MFA’s modern European holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认该件为Sano di Pietro的完整三联画中央面板、1470年年代及蛋彩媒材；若其并非完整三联画组成部分，代表性判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming that this is the central panel of a complete triptych by Sano di Pietro, dated 1470 and executed in tempera, is missing; if it is not part of a complete triptych, its representativeness could change.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料确认07.515a、07.515b、07.515c三件是否同属一组三联画，以及MFA如何共同编目和陈列它们；这直接关系到完整三联画的稀缺性与观赏价值。
missing.en: Authoritative confirmation that 07.515a, 07.515b, and 07.515c belong to one triptych, and of how MFA catalogues and displays them together, is missing; this directly affects the rarity and viewing value of the complete triptych.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态，无法核实完整三联画是否可供现场观看。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing, so it cannot be verified whether the complete triptych is available for on-site viewing.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认07.515a-c是否组成并被馆方作为一组三联画共同展示；这是当前B级代表性与不可替代性判断的核心依据。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation that 07.515a-c form and are displayed by MFA as one triptych is missing; this is central to the current Tier B judgment of representativeness and uniqueness.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认该件为Sano di Pietro三联画的07.515c侧翼、圣凯瑟琳题名及约1450年年代；若不是该三联画组成部分，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming that this is the 07.515c wing of a Sano di Pietro triptych, titled Saint Catherine of Siena and dated around 1450, is missing; if it is not part of that triptych, the Tier judgment could change.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该侧翼是否与07.515a、07.515b共同保存、编目及陈列，以及其作为单独面板还是完整三联画一部分面向观众；这直接影响其代表性。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence of whether this wing is preserved, catalogued, and displayed with 07.515a and 07.515b, and whether it is presented as an individual panel or part of a complete triptych, is missing; this directly affects its representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认该面板与07.515a-b的完整三联画关系及馆方陈列方式。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of this panel’s relationship to 07.515a-b as a complete triptych and of MFA’s display treatment is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认该件为Sano di Pietro三联画的07.515a侧翼、圣杰罗姆题名、1470年年代及蛋彩媒材；若作品身份不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming that this is the 07.515a wing of a Sano di Pietro triptych, titled Saint Jerome, dated 1470, and executed in tempera is missing; a different object identity could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料确认07.515a-c是否组成同一完整三联画及其共同编目、陈列方式；这直接关系到该面板相对于完整三联画的重复性和代表性。
missing.en: Authoritative confirmation that 07.515a-c form one complete triptych, together with their joint cataloguing and display treatment, is missing; this directly affects the panel’s repetition and representativeness relative to the complete triptych.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认07.515a-c的三联画关系及该面板的馆方编目、陈列方式。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the 07.515a-c triptych relationship and MFA’s cataloguing and display treatment of this panel is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认该件为Sano di Pietro、1470年、蛋彩及97.229对应的独立圣母子画；若归属或作品身份不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming the attribution to Sano di Pietro, the 1470 date, tempera medium, and that 97.229 is an independent Madonna and Child painting is missing; a different attribution or object identity could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该作在Sano di Pietro作品及MFA锡耶纳宗教绘画收藏中的相对地位，无法支撑其为重复性较高、补位价值较低的对象。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence of the work’s relative position within Sano di Pietro’s oeuvre and MFA’s Sienese religious painting holdings is missing; the claim that it is highly repetitive and of low supplementary value is unsupported.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认该作归属及其相对于MFA其他锡耶纳宗教画的地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the attribution and the work’s position relative to MFA’s other Sienese religious paintings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认Scarsellino的艺术家归属、题名及油彩媒材；若归属为其他艺术家或作品性质不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming the attribution to Scarsellino, the title, and the oil medium is missing; a different attribution or object identity could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该作在斯卡塞利诺作品、费拉拉晚期文艺复兴及MFA相关收藏中的相对代表性，无法支撑其为该组排名第一。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence of the work’s relative representativeness within Scarsellino’s oeuvre, late Ferrarese Renaissance painting, and MFA’s related holdings is missing; the claim that it ranks first in the peer group is unsupported.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料支撑该作在MFA费拉拉绘画收藏中的相对代表性及其与同艺术家作品的比较。
top_missing_en: Authoritative evidence of the work’s relative representativeness within MFA’s Ferrarese holdings and comparison with other works by the same artist is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认Scarsellino、约1550年及油彩媒材；若艺术家归属或年代不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming Scarsellino, the circa-1550 date, and the oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该作在斯卡塞利诺早期或费拉拉宗教绘画中的艺术史位置，以及其与1982.211《Christ on Calvary》的直接比较；现有资料不足以支撑其组内第二位及较低独特性。
missing.en: Authoritative evidence of the work’s position in Scarsellino’s early career or Ferrarese religious painting, and direct comparison with 1982.211, Christ on Calvary, is missing; the claims that it ranks second and has lower uniqueness are unsupported.

missing.zh: 缺MFA确认的展厅位置与当前在展状态。
missing.en: The MFA-confirmed gallery location and current display status are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作与MFA另一件斯卡塞利诺作品的权威比较及其在艺术家创作中的定位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative comparison with MFA’s other Scarsellino work and placement within the artist’s career are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录或权威图录确认Scipio Goltzius、1577年、油彩及《Fruit and Vegetable Vendors》的作品身份；若归属或作品性质不同，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record or authoritative catalogue confirming Scipio Goltzius, the 1577 date, oil medium, and the identity of Fruit and Vegetable Vendors is missing; a different attribution or object identity could change the Tier judgment.

missing.zh: 缺该作的绝对年代或创作阶段；若不属于现有19世纪分组，其艺术史定位可能改变。
missing.en: The absolute date or production phase is missing; if it does not belong in the current 19th-century grouping, its art-historical position could change.

missing.zh: 缺该作与布朗其他沼泽或波士顿地区景观作品的比较，以及馆方是否认为其具有地方艺术史代表性。
missing.en: Comparative evidence against Brown’s other marsh or Boston-area landscape works, and documentation of whether the MFA regards it as representative of local art history, are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺创作年代、作品代表性及其相对于布朗同类作品的比较证据。
top_missing_en: The date, evidence of representativeness, and comparison with Brown’s similar works are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认 64.455 的题名、George Loring Brown 归属、1866 年断代和油彩媒材。
missing.en: The MFA’s official collection record is missing confirmation of the title, attribution to George Loring Brown, 1866 date, and oil medium for accession 64.455.

missing.zh: 缺该作在布朗意大利景观作品中的具体位置，以及馆方或学术资料是否将其视为代表作。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for the work’s specific place among Brown’s Italian landscapes and for whether the MFA or scholarship regards it as representative.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他意大利海岸、那不勒斯及旅行风景画的比较资料，以支持其可替代性判断。
missing.en: Comparative evidence against the MFA’s other Italian-coast, Naples, and travel-landscape paintings is missing to support the assessment of substitutability.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在布朗意大利景观作品中的代表性及其与 MFA 同类作品的比较证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence is missing for the work’s representativeness among Brown’s Italian landscapes and its comparability with similar MFA holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认 69.67 的完整题名、George Loring Brown 归属、1883 年断代和油彩媒材。
missing.en: The MFA’s official collection record is missing confirmation of the full title, attribution to George Loring Brown, 1883 date, and oil medium for accession 69.67.

missing.zh: 缺该作在布朗作品中的具体地位，以及其是否代表美国19世纪旅行风景画而非一般欧洲城市景观的证据。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for the work’s specific standing in Brown’s oeuvre and for whether it represents 19th-century American travel landscape painting rather than being a routine European city view.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 美国艺术收藏中的相对位置、展陈状态和馆方解说资料。
missing.en: Its relative position in the MFA’s American art collection, display status, and curatorial interpretation are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品在布朗创作及 MFA 美国艺术收藏中的相对地位，以及支持其高于普通欧洲旅行景观的资料。
top_missing_en: Evidence is missing for the work’s standing in Brown’s oeuvre and the MFA’s American art collection, including support for treating it as more than an ordinary European travel view.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认 1989.225 的真实艺术家身份；现有 artist 值仅为 Q21480064，未提供可读的艺术家姓名。
missing.en: The MFA’s official collection record is missing confirmation of the actual artist identity for accession 1989.225; the existing artist value is only Q21480064 and does not provide a readable artist name.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对题名、1984 年断代和油彩媒材的确认，并缺少确认该对象确为绘画而非其他藏品类型的资料。
missing.en: The MFA’s official record is missing confirmation of the title, 1984 date, and oil medium, as well as documentation confirming that the object is a painting rather than another object type.

missing.zh: 在艺术家身份未解决的情况下，缺该作在其创作生涯、美国汽车题材绘画史及 MFA 同类藏品中的代表性和相对排名。
missing.en: Because the artist identity is unresolved, evidence is missing for the work’s representativeness and relative rank in the artist’s career, the history of American automotive painting, and the MFA’s comparable holdings.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是 Q21480064 对应的真实艺术家身份，以及由此产生的作品艺术史地位和同类排名证据。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the actual artist identity represented by Q21480064, together with evidence of the work’s art-historical standing and rank among comparable works.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品题名、艺术家 Jack Weine、1974 年创作时间及馆藏号 1978.1 的逐项确认；若作者归属或作品身份不同，会改变其在美国汽车题材绘画中的历史与代表性判断。
missing.en: Missing item-level confirmation from the MFA collection record of the title, artist Jack Weine, 1974 date, and accession number 1978.1; a different attribution or object identity would change its historical and representative standing within American automotive-themed painting.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 Jack Weine 创作生涯及 MFA 美国艺术收藏中的具体位置，以及与馆内同类汽车题材作品的比较依据。
missing.en: Missing the work’s specific place in Jack Weine’s career and in the MFA’s American art collection, together with a comparison against the MFA’s other automotive-themed works.

missing.zh: 缺当前展厅或可公开观展状态的 MFA 官方确认；该信息会影响其实际可见性判断。
missing.en: Missing official MFA confirmation of its current gallery or public-display status; this would affect its actual visibility assessment.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录及策展/馆藏比较证据，以确认该作品身份并判断其在馆内同类中的代表性。
top_missing_en: Missing official MFA documentation and curatorial/collection-comparison evidence to confirm the object and assess its representative standing among the MFA’s comparable works.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、George Peter Alexander Healy、1863 年及馆藏号 95.1368 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, George Peter Alexander Healy attribution, 1863 date, and accession number 95.1368.

missing.zh: 缺 Orestes A. Brownson 作为被画者在该肖像中的身份与历史重要性，以及该作品在海利肖像创作中的具体地位的权威说明。
missing.en: Missing authoritative documentation of Orestes A. Brownson’s identity and historical importance as sitter, and of this portrait’s specific position in Healy’s portrait oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 馆藏其他海利肖像及美国19世纪肖像画的馆内比较依据，无法核实其是否属于同类中的突出作品。
missing.en: Missing an in-museum comparison with the MFA’s other Healy portraits and nineteenth-century American portraits, so its distinction within the category cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺该肖像在海利作品及 MFA 美国肖像收藏中的权威定位和同类比较证据。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative positioning and category-level comparison for the portrait within Healy’s oeuvre and the MFA’s American portrait collection.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、被画者 Thomas Kemper Davis、海利归属及馆藏号 07.516 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the title, sitter Thomas Kemper Davis, Healy attribution, and accession number 07.516.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材及作品在海利肖像创作序列中的位置；这些事实可能区分普通肖像与具有较高艺术史价值的作品。
missing.en: Missing the date, medium, and the work’s place in Healy’s portrait sequence; these facts could distinguish a conventional portrait from one of greater art-historical significance.

missing.zh: 缺 Thomas Kemper Davis 的身份及其社会、政治或文化关联的权威资料。
missing.en: Missing authoritative information on Thomas Kemper Davis’s identity and social, political, or cultural significance.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品身份、创作年代和被画者背景，无法确认其在海利肖像及 MFA 同类收藏中的地位。
top_missing_en: Missing the object identity, date, and sitter context needed to establish its standing among Healy portraits and comparable MFA holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、George Peter Alexander Healy 归属、馆藏号 RES.17.106 及媒材的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, George Peter Alexander Healy attribution, accession number RES.17.106, and medium.

missing.zh: 缺该作的创作年代及其在海利丹尼尔·韦伯斯特肖像、美国政治人物肖像和美国肖像史中的具体位置。
missing.en: Missing the work’s date and its specific position within Healy’s Daniel Webster portraits, portraits of American political figures, and nineteenth-century American portraiture.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 馆藏其他海利作品及同类政治人物肖像的权威比较，无法核实其作为本组代表作的依据。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparison with the MFA’s other Healy works and comparable portraits of political figures, so its basis for being representative of the group cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方记录及同类比较资料，以确认这件韦伯斯特肖像的身份和在馆内同类中的代表性。
top_missing_en: Missing official documentation and category comparison needed to confirm the portrait and its representative standing among comparable MFA holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、人物身份、海利归属、1855 年及馆藏号 21.2232 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, sitter identity, Healy attribution, 1855 date, and accession number 21.2232.

missing.zh: 缺 Anna Chadbourne（后为 Mrs. David E. Hughes）的身份、社会背景及其被画者意义的权威资料。
missing.en: Missing authoritative information on Anna Chadbourne, later Mrs. David E. Hughes, including her identity, social background, and significance as sitter.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他海利女性肖像及19世纪美国肖像画的比较依据，以确认其是否确属较常规、可替代的作品。
missing.en: Missing comparison with the MFA’s other Healy portraits of women and nineteenth-century American portraits, needed to verify whether it is indeed a conventional and replaceable work.

top_missing_zh: 缺人物身份与馆内同类比较证据，无法支撑其作为常规女性肖像的定位。
top_missing_en: Missing sitter documentation and in-museum comparison needed to support its positioning as a conventional female portrait.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、海利归属、富兰克林·皮尔斯身份及馆藏号 47.1156 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, Healy attribution, Franklin Pierce identification, and accession number 47.1156.

missing.zh: 缺该作的创作年代、尺寸及其在海利总统肖像和美国政治人物肖像中的具体地位。
missing.en: Missing the date, dimensions, and specific position of the work among Healy’s presidential portraits and portraits of American political figures.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他总统肖像及海利作品的权威比较，以核实其馆内代表性是否确实低于《Daniel Webster》。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparison with the MFA’s other presidential portraits and Healy works to verify whether its in-museum representativeness is actually lower than Daniel Webster.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方身份确认和与同类总统、海利肖像的馆内比较证据。
top_missing_en: Missing official identity confirmation and in-museum comparison with comparable presidential and Healy portraits.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认作者字段 Q22002487 所对应的具体艺术家，或确认该作确实为作者不明；当前仅有实体编号，不能确定作者归属。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the specific artist represented by Q22002487, or confirmation that the work is anonymous; the entity identifier alone does not establish attribution.

missing.zh: 缺该作的创作年代、题名及馆藏号 62.279 的官方逐项核对，以及对画面所描绘地点确为萨克拉门托的证据。
missing.en: Missing item-level official verification of the date, title, and accession number 62.279, as well as evidence that the depicted location is Sacramento.

missing.zh: 缺该景观在19世纪美国西部风景画和 MFA 美国艺术收藏中的具体历史或艺术史地位，以及与馆内相关作品的比较。
missing.en: Missing the landscape’s specific historical or art-historical standing within nineteenth-century American western landscape painting and the MFA’s American art collection, together with comparison to related holdings.

top_missing_zh: 作者身份目前只有实体编号且未被官方核实；作者与地点归属的不确定会直接影响其代表性判断。
top_missing_en: The artist is represented only by an unverified entity identifier; uncertainty about attribution and place directly affects the work’s representative standing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、George Bellows 归属、1923 年、媒材及馆藏号 25.105 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, George Bellows attribution, 1923 date, medium, and accession number 25.105.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 Bellows 创作生涯、Emma 系列及美国现代主义绘画中的权威定位，以确认其是否为成熟且具有较高代表性的作品。
missing.en: Missing authoritative positioning within Bellows’s career, the Emma series, and American modernist painting, needed to confirm whether it is a mature and highly representative work.

missing.zh: 缺与 MFA 其他 Bellows 人物及家庭题材作品的比较依据，以及当前展出状态的官方确认。
missing.en: Missing comparison with the MFA’s other Bellows works on figures and family subjects, as well as official confirmation of current display status.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 Bellows 创作及 MFA 美国现代主义收藏中的权威定位和同类比较证据。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative positioning and category comparison within Bellows’s oeuvre and the MFA’s American modernist holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、George Bellows 归属、1919 年、媒材及馆藏号 48.518 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, George Bellows attribution, 1919 date, medium, and accession number 48.518.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 Bellows 的 Emma 肖像创作及美国现代主义人物画中的具体位置，以及其与同系列作品的关系。
missing.en: Missing the work’s specific position within Bellows’s Emma portraits and American modernist portraiture, and its relationship to the other works in the series.

missing.zh: 缺与 MFA 其他 Bellows 肖像及同一 Emma/家庭题材作品的权威比较，以支撑其组内排名和代表性。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparison with the MFA’s other Bellows portraits and Emma/family-themed works to support its group ranking and representativeness.

top_missing_zh: 缺系列定位及馆内同类比较证据，无法支撑其在 Bellows 家庭与人物肖像中的代表性。
top_missing_en: Missing series-level positioning and in-museum comparison needed to support its representativeness among Bellows’s family and figure portraits.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、George Bellows 归属、1917 年、媒材及馆藏号 63.261 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, George Bellows attribution, 1917 date, medium, and accession number 63.261.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料确认该作究竟是研究稿、未完成作品还是独立完成的油画，以及它与《Emma and Her Children》的创作关系。
missing.en: Missing authoritative confirmation of whether this is a study, unfinished work, or independently completed oil painting, and of its relationship to Emma and Her Children.

missing.zh: 缺该研究稿在 Bellows 研究和 MFA 馆藏中的具体学术价值，以及与同组成品的馆内比较依据。
missing.en: Missing the study’s specific scholarly value within Bellows studies and the MFA collection, together with an in-museum comparison to the finished works in the group.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品性质及其与成作的关系；这直接决定其研究价值和在同组中的代表性。
top_missing_en: Missing the work’s status and relationship to the finished painting; these directly determine its research value and representativeness within the group.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、Georgia O’Keeffe 归属、1953 年、媒材及馆藏号 1972.62 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, Georgia O’Keeffe attribution, 1953 date, medium, and accession number 1972.62.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 O’Keeffe 阿比丘系列、其成熟期创作及 MFA 美国现代主义收藏中的具体定位，以确认其是否足以支撑当前较高等级。
missing.en: Missing the work’s specific position within O’Keeffe’s Abiquiu series, mature practice, and the MFA’s American modernist collection, needed to support its current higher tier.

missing.zh: 缺与 MFA 其他 O’Keeffe 作品及同类自然物象绘画的权威比较，以及当前展出状态的官方确认。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparison with the MFA’s other O’Keeffe works and comparable natural-subject paintings, as well as official confirmation of current display status.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方记录和馆内比较证据，以证明这件阿比丘树木作品在 O’Keeffe 及 MFA 美国现代主义收藏中的具体重要性。
top_missing_en: Missing official documentation and collection comparison to establish the work’s specific importance within O’Keeffe’s oeuvre and the MFA’s American modernist holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对题名、Georgia O’Keeffe 归属、1926 年、媒材及馆藏号 1987.535 的逐项确认。
missing.en: Missing item-level MFA confirmation of the title, Georgia O’Keeffe attribution, 1926 date, medium, and accession number 1987.535.

missing.zh: 缺该作在《Shell and Old Shingle》系列、O’Keeffe 创作生涯及 MFA 美国现代主义收藏中的具体地位。
missing.en: Missing the work’s specific position within the Shell and Old Shingle series, O’Keeffe’s career, and the MFA’s American modernist collection.

missing.zh: 缺与 MFA 其他 O’Keeffe 作品及同系列作品的权威比较，以确认其系列首件身份、典范性和重复度判断。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparison with the MFA’s other O’Keeffe works and works from the same series to verify its status as the first in the series, its canonical quality, and the assessment of thematic repetition.

top_missing_zh: 缺系列谱系及 MFA 馆内比较证据，无法支撑其作为该系列典范作品的定位。
top_missing_en: Missing series genealogy and MFA collection comparison needed to support its positioning as a canonical work in the series.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对作品题名、欧姬芙归属、1926 年创作年代及媒材的直接确认；若官方记录将其归为工作室、复制品或采用不同年代，这会改变作品的艺术史分值。
missing.en: Direct confirmation from the MFA record is missing for the title, O'Keeffe attribution, 1926 date, and medium; if the official record identifies it as a workshop work, reproduction, or assigns a different date, the art-historical assessment would change.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及 MFA 当前展陈状态；尺寸会影响视觉冲击判断，是否被纳入美国艺术展厅核心叙事会影响现场价值与馆藏代表性判断。
missing.en: The work's dimensions and current MFA display status are missing; scale affects visual-impact assessment, while inclusion in the core American-art narrative affects on-site value and collection representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在 MFA 欧姬芙藏品及《Shell and Old Shingle》系列中的可核实相对位置，包括同系列现存件数及馆方是否将其作为系列重点作品。
missing.en: A verifiable comparison is missing for this work's position among the MFA's O'Keeffe holdings and within the Shell and Old Shingle series, including the number of surviving works and whether the MFA treats it as a series highlight.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对作品身份与尺寸、展陈及其在欧姬芙馆藏中的相对地位的直接证据。
top_missing_en: Direct evidence is missing for the MFA's identification of the work, its dimensions and display status, and its relative position within the O'Keeffe holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对作品题名、欧姬芙归属、1926 年创作年代及媒材的直接确认；若官方记录显示归属或年代不同，会改变艺术史与代表性判断。
missing.en: Direct confirmation from the MFA record is missing for the title, O'Keeffe attribution, 1926 date, and medium; a different attribution or date would change the art-historical and representational assessment.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及当前是否在 MFA 展出；该信息会影响对画面视觉吸引力和公众可见性的判断。
missing.en: The work's dimensions and current MFA display status are missing; these affect assessment of visual appeal and public visibility.

missing.zh: 缺该作品相对于《Shell and Old Shingle》系列其他作品及 MFA 同类欧姬芙作品的可核实排名依据，尤其缺馆方是否把它视为系列中的关键成员。
missing.en: Verifiable evidence is missing for this work's position relative to other Shell and Old Shingle works and comparable O'Keeffe works at the MFA, especially whether the museum treats it as a key series member.

top_missing_zh: 缺系列内相对地位、尺寸及展陈状态的可核实证据。
top_missing_en: Verifiable evidence is missing for its position within the series, dimensions, and display status.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对作品题名、欧姬芙归属、1926 年创作年代及媒材的直接确认；若其身份或年代被官方资料改写，当前艺术史分值可能改变。
missing.en: Direct confirmation from the MFA record is missing for the title, O'Keeffe attribution, 1926 date, and medium; an official change to its identity or date could alter the art-historical assessment.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及当前展陈状态；作为系列成员，其实际尺度和是否展出会影响视觉价值与现场优先级判断。
missing.en: The work's dimensions and current display status are missing; its actual scale and whether it is exhibited affect visual value and on-site priority.

missing.zh: 缺同系列存世件数、各件在 MFA 馆藏中的差异以及馆方对 No. IV 的独立代表性评价；这些资料直接关系到其相对于前三件的不可替代性。
missing.en: The number of surviving works in the series, the distinctions among MFA holdings, and the MFA's assessment of No. IV's independent significance are missing; these directly bear on its distinctiveness relative to the first three works.

top_missing_zh: 缺对该对象确为拉莫斯墓题材的现代再现画及其馆内同类相对地位的直接证据。

missing.en: Missing institutional or scholarly verification of Ramose's tomb no. 55, the Eighteenth-Dynasty mourning-women scene, and its representativeness in ancient Egyptian art history.

missing.zh: 缺MFA同类拉莫斯墓及埃及墓葬复制画的完整数量、展陈状态和策展优先级资料，以支撑其组内首位及当前Tier。
missing.en: Missing the number, display status, and curatorial priority of comparable Ramose-tomb and Egyptian funerary-copy paintings at the MFA, needed to support its top position in the group and current Tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺对拉莫斯墓哀悼场景的历史代表性及该画在MFA同类收藏中相对位置的证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the historical representativeness of the Ramose-tomb mourning scene and this work's comparative standing in the MFA collection is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官网或馆方图录对馆藏号14.923、标题、作者及“绘画／现代复制画”属性的直接核验。
missing.en: Missing direct MFA or catalogue verification of accession no. 14.923, title, artist, and the object's status as a painting/modern copy.

missing.zh: 缺MFA同类古埃及墓葬复制画的数量及相对代表性资料，以判断该单一人物墓像是否具有足以改变Tier的独特位置。
missing.en: Missing data on the number and comparative representativeness of comparable Egyptian tomb-copy paintings at the MFA, needed to determine whether this single-figure tomb image has a distinctive position affecting Tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺对Khunera墓及该图像考古来源的直接核验。
top_missing_en: Direct verification of the Khunera-tomb subject and the archaeological source of the image is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官网或馆方图录对馆藏号14.921、标题、作者及“绘画／现代复制画”属性的直接核验。
missing.en: Missing direct MFA or catalogue verification of accession no. 14.921, title, artist, and the object's status as a painting/modern copy.

missing.en: Missing institutional or scholarly verification of the Saqqara Old Kingdom tomb context, the procession-with-animals scene, and its specific image source.

missing.en: Missing data on the number and comparative representativeness of comparable Saqqara and Egyptian tomb-copy paintings at the MFA, needed to support its position within the group.

top_missing_zh: 缺对萨卡拉动物 procession 场景来源及其在MFA同类收藏中相对地位的证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the source of the Saqqara animal-procession scene and its comparative standing among MFA peers is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官网或馆方图录对馆藏号14.920、标题、作者及“绘画／现代复制画”属性的直接核验。
missing.en: Missing direct MFA or catalogue verification of accession no. 14.920, title, artist, and the object's status as a painting/modern copy.
