missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official object description needed to verify its conceptual expression, visual quality, and individual representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺Liliana Porter在该类当代拉丁美洲艺术中的具体艺术史地位，以及该作在MFA同类收藏中的比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of Liliana Porter’s specific art-historical standing in this category and of the work’s comparative position among MFA’s comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺馆方展厅或重点展陈记录；目前在展状态为未知。
missing.en: Missing official gallery or highlighted-display information; the current on-view status is unknown.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品层面的图像、馆方说明及MFA同类收藏比较资料，无法支持其单件代表性和独特性。
top_missing_en: Missing work-level imagery, official interpretation, and comparison with MFA’s comparable holdings needed to support its individual representativeness and distinctiveness.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.1的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.1.

missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方作品说明，无法判断该件在陆俨少山水画中的代表性和完成质量。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official object description needed to assess the work’s representativeness and quality within Lu Yanshao’s landscape paintings.

missing.zh: 缺该件在MFA中国绘画收藏及陆俨少同类作品中的比较排名，以及馆方是否将其作为核心或重点藏品的资料。
missing.en: Missing comparative evidence of the work’s position among MFA’s Chinese paintings and comparable Lu Yanshao works, including whether the museum treats it as a core or highlighted holding.

top_missing_zh: 缺能证明该件作品代表性、质量及其在MFA同类收藏中核心地位的馆方与作品层面资料。
top_missing_en: Missing museum and work-level evidence demonstrating the work’s representativeness, quality, and core position among comparable MFA holdings.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.2的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.2.

missing.zh: 缺该件的图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方说明，无法判断其与1986.127组画其他分件的质量差异及单件代表性。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official description needed to assess this panel’s quality and individual representativeness relative to the other components of the 1986.127 series.

missing.zh: 缺馆方对1986.127.2是否属于连续组画、组画整体关系及单件展陈意义的说明。
missing.en: Missing official information on whether 1986.127.2 belongs to a continuous series, the series’ internal relationship, and the individual panel’s display significance.

top_missing_zh: 缺该分件的作品层面质量资料及其在1986.127组画中的单件代表性、展陈意义。
top_missing_en: Missing work-level quality evidence and the panel’s individual representativeness and display significance within the 1986.127 series.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.3的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.3.

missing.zh: 缺该件的图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方说明，无法判断其与同组分件相比的画面质量和单件代表性。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official description needed to assess its visual quality and individual representativeness relative to the other panels in the series.

missing.zh: 缺馆方对1986.127组画的组藏关系及该分件是否具有独立展陈或教育价值的资料。
missing.en: Missing official evidence concerning the 1986.127 series and whether this panel has independent display or educational significance.

top_missing_zh: 缺该分件相对于同组作品的质量、独特性及独立展陈价值资料。
top_missing_en: Missing evidence of this panel’s quality, distinctiveness, and independent display value relative to the other works in the series.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.4的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.4.

missing.zh: 缺该件的图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方说明，无法判断其是否为该系列中的代表性精品。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official description needed to determine whether it is a representative or outstanding example within the series.

missing.zh: 缺该件与MFA同类中国山水画及1986.127系列其他分件的比较资料。
missing.en: Missing comparative evidence against MFA’s comparable Chinese landscapes and the other panels in the 1986.127 series.

top_missing_zh: 缺证明该件在组画及MFA同类中国山水画中相对位置的作品图像、馆方说明和比较资料。
top_missing_en: Missing imagery, official interpretation, and comparative evidence establishing the work’s position within the series and among MFA’s comparable Chinese landscapes.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.5的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.5.

missing.zh: 缺该件的图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方说明，无法判断其视觉质量和在陆俨少唐诗山水系列中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official description needed to assess its visual quality and representativeness within Lu Yanshao’s Tang-poem landscape series.

missing.zh: 缺该件在MFA中国绘画同类收藏中的比较位置及馆方展陈重要性资料。
missing.en: Missing evidence of its comparative position among MFA’s Chinese paintings and its curatorial or display importance.

top_missing_zh: 缺该件的视觉与代表性证据，以及其在系列和MFA同类收藏中的比较位置。
top_missing_en: Missing evidence of the work’s visual quality and representativeness, and of its comparative position within the series and MFA’s comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.6的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.6.

missing.zh: 缺该件的图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方说明，无法判断其作为系列常规成员或独立代表作的依据。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official description needed to determine whether it is merely a regular series member or an independently representative work.

missing.zh: 缺该件与1986.127系列其他分件及MFA中国山水画收藏的比较资料。
missing.en: Missing comparative evidence against the other panels in the 1986.127 series and MFA’s Chinese landscape collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺该分件相对于系列其他作品和MFA中国山水画收藏的质量、独特性比较资料。
top_missing_en: Missing comparative evidence of this panel’s quality and distinctiveness relative to the series and MFA’s Chinese landscape collection.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.7的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.7.

missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方说明，无法验证其陶渊明诗意主题在画面中的具体呈现及作品质量。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official description needed to verify how the Tao Yuanming-poem theme is realized and to assess the work’s quality.

missing.zh: 缺该件在陆俨少相关作品及MFA中国山水画收藏中的比较代表性资料。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s comparative representativeness among Lu Yanshao’s relevant works and MFA’s Chinese landscape holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺能验证陶渊明主题具体呈现、作品质量及其在MFA同类中代表性的作品资料。
top_missing_en: Missing work-level evidence verifying the Tao Yuanming theme, quality, and representativeness among MFA’s comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、陆俨少归属及馆藏号1986.127.8的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Lu Yanshao, and accession number 1986.127.8.

missing.zh: 缺作品图像、尺寸、媒材及馆方说明，无法验证刘永诗意在画面中的具体转化及作品质量。
missing.en: Missing an image, dimensions, medium, and official description needed to verify how the Liu Yong-poem theme is translated into the image and to assess the work’s quality.

missing.zh: 缺该件在陆俨少诗意山水及MFA中国山水画收藏中的比较位置和代表性资料。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s comparative position and representativeness among Lu Yanshao’s poetic landscapes and MFA’s Chinese landscape holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺能验证刘永诗意主题、作品质量及其相对于同类收藏代表性的作品层面资料。
top_missing_en: Missing work-level evidence verifying the Liu Yong-poem theme, quality, and representativeness relative to comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、馬駘归属及馆藏号1980.411的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Ma Tai, and accession number 1980.411.

missing.zh: 缺作品年代、尺寸、媒材、图像及馆方作品说明，无法判断其艺术史位置、画面质量和仕女题材的具体特征。
missing.en: Missing the date, dimensions, medium, image, and official object description needed to assess its art-historical position, visual quality, and specific features as a lady figure subject.

missing.zh: 缺MFA中国近现代人物画同类藏品的完整比较，以及该件是否确为该类别唯一或具有独立补位价值的资料。
missing.en: Missing a complete comparison with MFA’s modern Chinese figure paintings and evidence establishing whether this is truly unique within that category or has independent collection significance.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品基本记录、画面资料及其在MFA中国近现代人物画中的实际比较位置。
top_missing_en: Missing basic object records, visual evidence, and the work’s actual comparative position among MFA’s modern Chinese figure paintings.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对作品身份、村上華岳归属及馆藏号58.824的确认。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the object identity, attribution to Murakami Kagaku, and accession number 58.824.

missing.zh: 缺作品年代、尺寸、媒材、图像及馆方说明，无法判断其在村上華岳山水画中的代表性和视觉质量。
missing.en: Missing the date, dimensions, medium, image, and official description needed to assess its representativeness and visual quality within Murakami Kagaku’s landscapes.

missing.zh: 缺该件在MFA日本近现代绘画收藏中的比较位置，以及馆方是否将其作为重点展品或代表性藏品的资料。
missing.en: Missing evidence of its comparative position within MFA’s modern Japanese painting collection and whether the museum treats it as a highlighted or representative holding.

missing.zh: 缺馆方展厅或在展记录；当前在展状态为未知。
missing.en: Missing official gallery or on-view information; the current display status is unknown.

top_missing_zh: 缺能证明该件为村上華岳代表性作品并在MFA日本画收藏中具有突出位置的馆方与作品资料。
top_missing_en: Missing museum and work-level evidence showing that this is a representative Murakami Kagaku work with a prominent position in MFA’s Japanese painting collection.

missing.zh: 缺美国波士顿美术馆官方记录对作品题名、作者归属和创作年份的确认；若并非纳比尔·纳哈斯的2010年绘画，当前关于艺术家地位和作品类型的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing confirmation from the MFA’s official record of the title, attribution, and 2010 date; if it is not a 2010 painting by Nabil Nahas, the current tier rationale based on artist significance and object type would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在MFA同类藏品中的实际稀缺性与代表性信息，包括馆藏中其他纳比尔·纳哈斯作品及现代阿拉伯裔美国抽象绘画的数量和定位。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s actual scarcity and representativeness within MFA holdings, including the number and status of other works by Nabil Nahas and of modern Arab American abstract painting.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方记录确认作品归属及其在MFA同类馆藏中的代表性。
top_missing_en: Official confirmation of the attribution and of the work’s representativeness within MFA’s comparable holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对《Bodhidharma》的作者归属、题名、媒材、尺寸和创作年代的确认；若作者或作品类型不同，当前关于中村不折及日本近现代人物画的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the attribution, title, medium, dimensions, and date of Bodhidharma; if the attribution or object type differs, the current tier rationale based on Nakamura Fusetsu and modern Japanese figure painting would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作是否为中村不折或MFA日本近现代绘画收藏中具有代表性的作品，以及其在同类馆藏中的比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of whether this is a representative work by Nakamura Fusetsu or within MFA’s modern Japanese painting holdings, and of its comparative position among similar works.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方归属资料及其在MFA日本近现代绘画收藏中的代表性定位。
top_missing_en: Official attribution data and its representative position within MFA’s modern Japanese painting holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对题名、作者归属、媒材、尺寸和创作日期的确认；若并非南达拉·玻色的该件作品，当前以其艺术史地位为基础的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the title, attribution, medium, dimensions, and date; if it is not this work by Nandalal Bose, the current tier rationale based on his art-historical significance would change.

missing.zh: 缺该件是否为南达拉·玻色具有代表性的作品，以及其在MFA印度现代绘画馆藏中的比较位置；仅凭组内唯一不能证明其单件优先级。
missing.en: Missing evidence that this is a representative work by Nandalal Bose and of its comparative position within MFA’s modern Indian painting holdings; being the only item in the working group does not by itself establish single-object priority.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品官方归属及其在MFA印度现代绘画馆藏中的单件代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official attribution and evidence of single-object representativeness within MFA’s modern Indian painting holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对题名、作者归属、媒材、尺寸和创作日期的确认；若作品并非南达拉·玻色的纸本绘画，当前定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the title, attribution, medium, dimensions, and date; if the object is not a work on paper by Nandalal Bose, the current tier rationale would change.

missing.zh: 缺该瀑布题材作品在南达拉·玻色作品群及MFA印度现代绘画馆藏中的代表性、稀缺性和比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of this waterfall subject’s representativeness and scarcity within Nandalal Bose’s oeuvre and its comparative position in MFA’s modern Indian painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在艺术家作品群和MFA同类馆藏中的代表性比较资料。
top_missing_en: Comparative evidence of the work’s representativeness within the artist’s oeuvre and MFA’s comparable holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对题名、作者归属、媒材、尺寸和创作日期的确认；若作品属性不同，当前基于南达拉·玻色和鱼群题材的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the title, attribution, medium, dimensions, and date; if the object’s attribution or other properties differ, the current tier rationale based on Nandalal Bose and the fish subject would change.

missing.zh: 缺该件在南达拉·玻色动物或题材作品中的代表性，以及与MFA同类馆藏相比是否具有足够稀缺性或独特性。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s representativeness among Nandalal Bose’s animal- or subject-based works and whether it has sufficient scarcity or distinctiveness relative to MFA’s comparable holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品归属确认及其相对于南达拉·玻色同类作品和MFA馆藏的独特性证据。
top_missing_en: Attribution confirmation and evidence of distinctiveness relative to comparable Nandalal Bose works and MFA holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对题名、作者归属、媒材、尺寸和创作日期的确认；若作品属性不同，当前定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the title, attribution, medium, dimensions, and date; if the object’s properties differ, the current tier rationale would change.

missing.zh: 缺该四只野猪题材作品在南达拉·玻色作品群及MFA印度现代绘画馆藏中的代表性和比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the representativeness and comparative position of this four-boar subject within Nandalal Bose’s oeuvre and MFA’s modern Indian painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在艺术家作品群及MFA同类馆藏中的代表性定位。
top_missing_en: The work’s representative position within the artist’s oeuvre and MFA’s comparable holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对题名、作者归属、媒材、尺寸和创作日期的确认；若作品属性不同，当前定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the title, attribution, medium, dimensions, and date; if the object’s properties differ, the current tier rationale would change.

missing.zh: 缺该湿稻田题材作品在南达拉·玻色作品群及MFA印度现代绘画馆藏中的代表性、稀缺性和实际比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the representativeness, scarcity, and actual comparative position of this wet-paddy-field subject within Nandalal Bose’s oeuvre and MFA’s modern Indian painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺支撑其被视为该组首要代表的艺术家作品史和MFA馆藏比较证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence from the artist’s oeuvre and MFA collection comparisons supporting its leading representative position in the group is missing.

missing.zh: 库中缺作者字段，且缺MFA官方记录对作者阮思严、题名、媒材、尺寸和创作年代的确认；若作者归属或对象类型不同，当前越南现代绘画的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: The catalog lacks an artist field, and MFA official confirmation of the attribution to Nguyễn Tư Nghiêm, title, medium, dimensions, and date is missing; if the attribution or object type differs, the current rationale for modern Vietnamese painting would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在阮思严作品群及MFA越南现代绘画馆藏中的代表性、稀缺性和比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s representativeness and comparative scarcity within Nguyễn Tư Nghiêm’s oeuvre and MFA’s modern Vietnamese painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺作者归属的正式确认，以及该作在MFA越南现代绘画馆藏中的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Formal attribution confirmation and evidence of the work’s representativeness within MFA’s modern Vietnamese painting holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对题名、作者归属、媒材、尺寸和创作日期的确认；尤其需要确认现有“油彩”和2005年信息是否为馆方数据。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the title, attribution, medium, dimensions, and date; in particular, it is necessary to verify whether the existing oil-paint and 2005 data are official MFA data.

missing.zh: 缺该作是否为Norbert Schwontkowski具有代表性的作品，以及其在MFA德国当代绘画馆藏中的比较位置；作品代表性若成立或不成立，均可能影响当前接近阈值的定级依据。
missing.en: Missing evidence of whether this is a representative work by Norbert Schwontkowski and of its comparative position within MFA’s contemporary German painting holdings; establishing or disproving that representativeness could affect the current near-threshold tier rationale.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方作品数据及其代表性证据；当前记录距离分级阈值很近。
top_missing_en: Official object data and evidence of representativeness are missing; the current record is close to the tier threshold.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认作者确为潘公凯、题名中“Chen Ying”的语法关系、媒材、尺寸和创作年代；现有英文名称本身不能充分排除题名与作者归属混淆。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation that the artist is Pan Gongkai, clarification of the grammatical relationship of “Chen Ying” in the title, and confirmation of medium, dimensions, and date; the current English name alone does not fully exclude confusion between title and attribution.

missing.zh: 缺该作在潘公凯作品群及MFA中国现代绘画馆藏中的代表性、稀缺性和比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s representativeness and comparative scarcity within Pan Gongkai’s oeuvre and MFA’s modern Chinese painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺题名—作者关系及官方归属确认，并缺其在MFA中国现代绘画馆藏中的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Clarification of the title–artist relationship, official attribution, and representativeness within MFA’s modern Chinese painting holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对作者、题名、创作年份、媒材和尺寸的确认；若并非Peter Brooke的2008年绘画，当前定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the artist, title, 2008 date, medium, and dimensions; if it is not a 2008 painting by Peter Brooke, the current tier rationale would change.

missing.zh: 缺Peter Brooke的艺术史地位、该作在其作品群中的代表性，以及其在MFA英国及英联邦现代风景画馆藏中的比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of Peter Brooke’s art-historical significance, the work’s representativeness within his oeuvre, and its comparative position within MFA’s British and Commonwealth modern landscape holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺作者地位及作品在其作品群和MFA同类馆藏中的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the artist’s significance and the work’s representativeness within the artist’s oeuvre and MFA’s comparable holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对作者、题名、创作年代、媒材、尺寸和作品图像的确认；若“Necessity 8 (Schreber)”的对象属性或作者归属不同，当前定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the artist, title, date, medium, dimensions, and image of Necessity 8 (Schreber); if the object’s attribution or other properties differ, the current tier rationale would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作与Schreber主题的确切内容关联、在Peter M. Sacks作品群中的代表性，以及其在MFA当代叙事绘画馆藏中的比较位置。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the work’s precise relation to the Schreber subject, its representativeness within Peter M. Sacks’s oeuvre, and its comparative position within MFA’s contemporary narrative-painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象数据及其与Schreber主题、艺术家作品群和MFA同类馆藏的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official object data and evidence of representativeness in relation to the Schreber subject, the artist’s oeuvre, and MFA’s comparable holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属“Pu Qin”、馆藏号 1978.416 的确认；若作者或对象对应错误，Tier 的艺术史判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, the attribution to Pu Qin, and accession no. 1978.416; a different attribution or object identity would change the art-historical basis for the Tier.

missing.zh: 缺该作品的创作年代、媒材、尺寸及艺术家生涯位置，无法判断它是否为 Pu Qin 的代表性作品。
missing.en: Missing the work's date, medium, dimensions, and position in Pu Qin's career, preventing assessment of whether it is a representative work.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 中国绘画馆藏中同类作品的比较资料，包括 Pu Qin 作品数量及本件的相对排名。
missing.en: Missing comparison with MFA's holdings of related Chinese paintings, including the number of Pu Qin works and this work's relative standing among them.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是 MFA 官方身份确认，以及本件在 Pu Qin 作品序列和 MFA 同类馆藏中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are official MFA identity confirmation and the work's relative representativeness within Pu Qin's oeuvre and MFA's related holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作者归属、作品身份及馆藏号 1977.185 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the attribution, object identity, and accession no. 1977.185.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等个案信息，无法判断这件向八大山人致敬的作品是否属于溥心畬的代表性创作。
missing.en: Missing object-specific information such as date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, so it cannot be determined whether this homage to Bada Shanren is representative of Pu Xinyu's work.

missing.zh: 缺该题材在溥心畬作品中的艺术史位置，以及 MFA 中国绘画馆藏中同类作品的数量和本件相对地位。
missing.en: Missing the art-historical position of this subject within Pu Xinyu's oeuvre, and the number and relative standing of comparable works in MFA's Chinese painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是该件是否为溥心畬具有代表性的八大山人致敬作品，以及它在 MFA 同类馆藏中的相对地位。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether this is a representative Pu Xinyu homage to Bada Shanren and how it ranks among MFA's comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 56.492 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 56.492.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断该山水画在溥心畬作品序列中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of the landscape's representativeness within Pu Xinyu's oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 中国山水画及溥心畬作品的同类比较，包括本件与其他溥心畬山水画的相对重要性。
missing.en: Missing comparison with MFA's Chinese landscapes and Pu Xinyu holdings, including this work's relative importance among Pu Xinyu landscapes.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是本件在溥心畬山水画及 MFA 同类馆藏中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the work's relative representativeness within Pu Xinyu's landscapes and MFA's comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 1986.756 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 1986.756.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或相关文字说明，无法判断“台湾原住民婚礼”主题在溥心畬创作中的特殊性和代表性。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or related object documentation, preventing assessment of the distinctiveness and representativeness of the Taiwanese Indigenous marriage subject within Pu Xinyu's work.

missing.zh: 缺该题材在 MFA 中国绘画馆藏中的稀缺性及与其他溥心畬、台湾原住民题材作品的比较。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the subject's rarity in MFA's Chinese painting holdings and comparison with other Pu Xinyu works and works depicting Taiwan's Indigenous peoples.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是该台湾原住民婚礼题材是否确属本件的特殊代表性，以及它在 MFA 同类馆藏中的稀缺程度。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether the Taiwanese Indigenous marriage subject gives this work distinctive representative value and how rare it is among MFA's comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 48.227 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 48.227.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断该紫藤作品在齐白石花卉画中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of the wisteria painting's representativeness within Qi Baishi's flower paintings.

missing.zh: 缺该件在 MFA 齐白石花卉作品中的相对排名，以及与同类紫藤作品的比较。
missing.en: Missing this work's relative standing among MFA's Qi Baishi flower paintings and comparison with other wisteria works of the same type.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是本件在齐白石花卉画及 MFA 齐白石藏品中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the work's relative representativeness within Qi Baishi's flower paintings and MFA's Qi Baishi holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 48.1328 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 48.1328.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断该棕榈与鸟构图在齐白石花鸟画中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of the representativeness of the palm-and-bird composition within Qi Baishi's bird-and-flower paintings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 齐白石花鸟作品的数量、题材分布及本件相对地位，无法核实其是否只是重复性较高的常规作品。
missing.en: Missing the number and subject distribution of MFA's Qi Baishi bird-and-flower works and this work's relative standing, so its status as a potentially repetitive standard example cannot be assessed.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是本件相对于 MFA 齐白石花鸟藏品的代表性与重复程度。
top_missing_en: The key gap is this work's representativeness and degree of repetition relative to MFA's Qi Baishi bird-and-flower holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 50.1469 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 50.1469.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断“螃蟹与芦苇”是否属于齐白石具有代表性的水族题材作品。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of whether Crabs and reeds is a representative Qi Baishi aquatic-subject work.

missing.zh: 缺该件与 MFA 其他齐白石水族、花鸟作品的比较及其馆藏相对排名。
missing.en: Missing comparison with MFA's other Qi Baishi aquatic and bird-and-flower works and this work's relative standing in the collection.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是该螃蟹与芦苇作品在齐白石水族画及 MFA 同类藏品中的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the work's relative representativeness among Qi Baishi aquatic paintings and MFA's comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 50.1470 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 50.1470.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断该葡萄与果实作品在齐白石果蔬画中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of the work's representativeness within Qi Baishi's fruit-and-vegetable paintings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 齐白石果蔬、花鸟作品的同类数量和本件相对地位，以判断其是否为常见重复题材。
missing.en: Missing the number of comparable Qi Baishi fruit-and-vegetable and bird-and-flower works at MFA and this work's relative standing, needed to assess whether the subject is a common repetition.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是本件在齐白石果蔬画及 MFA 同类馆藏中的相对代表性和重复程度。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the work's relative representativeness and degree of repetition within Qi Baishi's fruit-and-vegetable paintings and MFA's comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 50.1471 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 50.1471.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断紫藤与蜜蜂是否代表齐白石成熟花鸟画的重要面貌。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of whether Wisteria and bees represents an important aspect of Qi Baishi's mature bird-and-flower painting.

missing.zh: 缺该件与 MFA 其他齐白石紫藤、昆虫及花鸟作品的比较和相对排名。
missing.en: Missing comparison with MFA's other Qi Baishi wisteria, insect, and bird-and-flower works and its relative standing among them.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是本件是否代表齐白石成熟花鸟画，以及它在 MFA 同类作品中的相对地位。
top_missing_en: The key gap is whether this represents Qi Baishi's mature bird-and-flower painting and how it ranks among MFA's comparable works.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 50.1472 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 50.1472.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断植物与蚱蜢题材在齐白石草虫画中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of the representativeness of the plant-and-grasshopper subject within Qi Baishi's insect paintings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 齐白石草虫及花鸟作品的数量、题材分布和本件相对地位。
missing.en: Missing the number and subject distribution of MFA's Qi Baishi insect and bird-and-flower works and this work's relative standing.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是该件在齐白石草虫画及 MFA 同类藏品中的代表性与相对排名。
top_missing_en: The key gap is this work's representativeness and relative ranking among Qi Baishi insect paintings and MFA's comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 50.3632 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 50.3632.

missing.zh: 缺完整题名、创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法确定作品主题及其在齐白石作品序列中的代表性。
missing.en: Missing the complete title, date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing determination of the subject and its representativeness within Qi Baishi's oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 齐白石植物、花卉及花鸟作品的同类比较，以判断该题名过于概括的对象是否具有独特馆藏价值。
missing.en: Missing comparison with MFA's Qi Baishi plant, flower, and bird-and-flower works to determine whether this broadly titled object has distinctive collection value.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是对象的完整身份与题名，以及它在 MFA 齐白石同类藏品中的相对独特性。
top_missing_en: The key gaps are the object's complete identity and title, and its relative distinctiveness among MFA's comparable Qi Baishi holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品身份、作者归属及馆藏号 1980.103 的确认。
missing.en: Missing MFA official confirmation of the object identity, attribution, and accession no. 1980.103.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒材、尺寸、题款或印章等资料，无法判断蚕食桑叶是否为齐白石花鸟画中具有较高典范性的作品。
missing.en: Missing date, medium, dimensions, inscriptions, or seals, preventing assessment of whether Silkworms eating mulberry leaves is a highly canonical Qi Baishi bird-and-flower work.

missing.zh: 缺该件与 MFA 其他齐白石昆虫、桑蚕及花鸟作品的比较，以及其在同类馆藏中的相对排名。
missing.en: Missing comparison with MFA's other Qi Baishi insect, silkworm, and bird-and-flower works and its relative standing among comparable holdings.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是该件在齐白石昆虫及花鸟画中的典范性，以及其在 MFA 同类藏品中的相对排名。
top_missing_en: The key gap is the work's canonical significance among Qi Baishi insect and bird-and-flower paintings and its relative ranking within MFA's comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对馆藏号 1980.104、作者归属为齐白石、作品题名及媒材的逐项确认；还缺该作在齐白石人物画及 MFA 中国画馆藏中的相对地位证据。前者若不成立会改变对象身份，后者若显示其并非馆内同类中的重要代表，会改变 Tier 判断。
missing.en: Missing item-level confirmation from the MFA for accession 1980.104, including attribution to Qi Baishi, title, and medium; also missing evidence of the work’s standing among Qi Baishi’s figure paintings and MFA’s Chinese painting holdings. If the former fails, the object identity changes; if the latter shows it is not an important representative work in the collection, the Tier basis changes.

top_missing_zh: MFA 官方记录及作品在齐白石人物画、MFA 中国画馆藏中的相对地位尚未核实。
top_missing_en: The MFA record and the work’s comparative standing among Qi Baishi figure paintings and the MFA’s Chinese holdings are unverified.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对馆藏号 1987.471、作者钱瘦铁、题名及媒材的确认；还缺钱瘦铁在近现代中国山水画中的艺术史地位及该作在 MFA 同类馆藏中的相对代表性证据。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of accession 1987.471, artist Qian Shoutie, title, and medium; also missing evidence of Qian Shoutie’s art-historical standing in modern Chinese landscape painting and this work’s comparative representativeness within the MFA holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方身份核验，以及钱瘦铁和该作在相关馆藏中的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official identity verification and evidence of the artist’s and work’s representativeness in the relevant holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认馆藏号 2012.564 对应的具体册页、艺术家、题名、年代、媒材和尺寸；缺该册页的图像以及“Civilization Landscape Series”系列在秦風创作中的位置和 MFA 当代中国艺术馆藏中的相对重要性证据。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation that accession 2012.564 corresponds to this specific album leaf, including artist, title, date, medium, and dimensions; missing an image of the leaf and evidence of the series’ place in Qin Feng’s practice and its comparative importance within the MFA’s contemporary Chinese art holdings.

top_missing_zh: 具体册页的官方身份、图像及其在秦風创作和 MFA 馆藏中的地位尚未核实。
top_missing_en: The specific leaf’s official identity, image, and standing in Qin Feng’s practice and the MFA collection are unverified.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认馆藏号 2012.565 对应的具体册页及其作者、题名、年代、媒材和尺寸；缺该页与 2012.564、2012.566 的图像和内容差异，以及该系列在 MFA 当代中国绘画馆藏中的代表性证据。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation that accession 2012.565 corresponds to this specific leaf, including artist, title, date, medium, and dimensions; missing images and documented content differences from 2012.564 and 2012.566, plus evidence of the series’ representativeness within the MFA’s contemporary Chinese painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象核验，以及与同系列册页的实际差异和单件代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official object verification and evidence of this leaf’s distinctiveness and individual representativeness within the series are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认馆藏号 2012.566 对应的具体册页及其作者、题名、年代、媒材和尺寸；缺该页与同系列其他册页的图像和内容差异，以及它在 MFA 当代中国绘画馆藏中的单件代表性证据。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation that accession 2012.566 corresponds to this specific leaf, including artist, title, date, medium, and dimensions; missing images and documented content differences from the other leaves in the series, plus evidence of this leaf’s individual representativeness within the MFA’s contemporary Chinese painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象核验，以及该页相对同系列其他册页的独特性和代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official object verification and evidence of this leaf’s distinctiveness and representativeness relative to the other leaves are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认馆藏号 2005.648、作者仇德树、题名、年代、媒材和尺寸；缺仇德树在中国当代抽象绘画中的艺术史地位，以及该作在 MFA 中国当代艺术馆藏中的相对代表性证据。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of accession 2005.648, artist Qiu Deshu, title, date, medium, and dimensions; also missing evidence of Qiu Deshu’s art-historical standing in contemporary Chinese abstraction and this work’s comparative representativeness within the MFA’s contemporary Chinese art holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象核验，以及仇德树和该作在 MFA 当代中国艺术馆藏中的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official object verification and evidence of the artist’s and work’s representativeness in the MFA’s contemporary Chinese holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认馆藏号 2010.774 对应的作品、作者邱挺、题名、年代、媒材和尺寸；缺邱挺的艺术家身份与艺术史地位，以及该作在 MFA 中国现代与当代绘画馆藏中的相对位置证据。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation that accession 2010.774 corresponds to this work, including artist Qiu Ting, title, date, medium, and dimensions; missing evidence establishing Qiu Ting’s artistic identity and art-historical standing, and the work’s comparative position within the MFA’s modern and contemporary Chinese painting holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方作品与作者核验，以及邱挺和该作在相关馆藏中的相对位置证据。
top_missing_en: Official work and artist verification, together with evidence of their comparative position in the relevant holdings, are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对馆藏号 2010.611、作者、题名、2009 年年代、油彩媒材和尺寸的确认；缺作品图像及其是否确实涉及 Philip Guston、该题名的具体语境；还缺 Richard Bosman 在相关当代绘画史和 MFA 馆藏中的代表性证据。上述信息若不同，会直接影响作品的历史解释和相对地位判断。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of accession 2010.611, artist, title, 2009 date, oil medium, and dimensions; missing an image and documentation of whether and how the work actually relates to Philip Guston; also missing evidence of Richard Bosman’s representativeness in the relevant contemporary painting history and MFA holdings. Different answers would directly affect the work’s historical interpretation and comparative standing.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象核验、作品与 Philip Guston 的实际关系及 Bosman 的馆藏代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official object verification, the work’s actual relation to Philip Guston, and evidence of Bosman’s representativeness in the MFA holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录确认馆藏号 2009.4342、题名、作者、2001 年年代、媒材和尺寸；缺 Rick Rivet 的原住民社群归属、作品具体文化语境及其在北美原住民当代艺术中的艺术史地位和 MFA 馆藏中的代表性证据。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of accession 2009.4342, title, artist, 2001 date, medium, and dimensions; missing documentation of Rick Rivet’s Indigenous community affiliation, the work’s specific cultural context, and the artist’s art-historical standing and representativeness within contemporary Indigenous North American art and the MFA holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方对象核验、作品的具体原住民文化语境及其在相关馆藏中的代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Official object verification, the work’s specific Indigenous cultural context, and evidence of its representativeness in the relevant holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方馆藏记录，以核实作品身份、彼得·克拉斯作者归属、1627年断代、油彩媒材及馆藏号TR2014.15826.13；若其中任一项不同，会改变定级依据。
missing.en: The official MFA collection record is missing to verify the object identity, Pieter Claesz attribution, 1627 date, oil medium, and accession number TR2014.15826.13; a different answer on any of these could change the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆藏中17世纪荷兰/佛兰德静物画的完整同类清单及比较排序，无法核实该作确实是组内综合品质和典范程度最高的作品。
missing.en: A complete MFA list and comparative ranking of comparable seventeenth-century Dutch/Flemish still lifes are missing, so the claim that this is the group's highest work in overall quality and canonical representativeness cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方记录和同类作品比较排序，无法支撑克拉斯归属及其组内最高的相对代表性。
top_missing_en: The official record and comparative ranking within the still-life holdings are missing, leaving the Claesz attribution and claimed top group position unsubstantiated.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录对作品标题、卡雷尔·杜雅尔丹归属、1660 年断代及油彩媒材的确认；若馆方归为工作室、仿作或不同年代，作品的艺术史与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA object record confirming the title, attribution to Karel Dujardin, the 1660 date, and the oil medium is missing; an attribution to the workshop, a copy, or a different date would change the work's art-historical and quality basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 十七世纪荷兰风景画收藏中的相对位置，包括杜雅尔丹作品的同类数量、质量与该作是否为代表性例作；这直接关系不可替代性和类别代表性。
missing.en: The work's comparative position within MFA's seventeenth-century Dutch landscape holdings is missing, including the number and quality of comparable Dujardin works and whether this is a representative example; this directly bears on irreplaceability and category representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 当前展厅或线上重点展示状态，以及具体展厅位置；这会影响游客现场价值和其在本馆叙事中的权重。
missing.en: MFA display or featured-online status and a specific gallery location are missing; these would affect visitor value and the work's weight in the museum's narrative.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录及其对作品归属、馆内相对位置和展示状态的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA confirmation of the attribution, comparative position in the collection, and display status is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录对标题、扬·波赛利斯归属、1631 年断代及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，艺术史价值与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA object record confirming the title, attribution to Jan Porcellis, the 1631 date, and the oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date would change the art-historical and quality basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰海景画及十七世纪风景画收藏中的相对位置，包括波赛利斯同类作品数量、质量及其是否为馆内代表性例作；这直接关系不可替代性。
missing.en: The work's comparative position within MFA's Dutch seascape and seventeenth-century landscape holdings is missing, including the number and quality of comparable Porcellis works and whether this is a representative MFA example; this directly bears on irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 展示状态和展厅位置，尤其缺是否被纳入荷兰风景画核心展示；这会影响现场价值及馆内身份权重。
missing.en: Its MFA display status and gallery location are missing, especially whether it is included in a core Dutch landscape presentation; this would affect on-site value and institutional weight.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对波赛利斯归属及其在馆内荷兰海景画收藏中相对位置的确认。
top_missing_en: MFA confirmation of the Porcellis attribution and the work's comparative position among the museum's Dutch seascapes is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对扬·范霍延归属、1637 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，作品的艺术史地位与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Jan van Goyen, the 1637 date, title, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date would change the work's art-historical standing and quality basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他范霍延作品及同类结冰河景的比较资料，无法确认其是否确为馆内该题材的代表性例作；这直接关系类别代表性与不可替代性。
missing.en: Comparative evidence against MFA's other Van Goyen works and comparable frozen-river scenes is missing, so it cannot be established whether this is a representative MFA example of the subject; this directly bears on category representativeness and irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 当前展厅位置及核心展示状态；即使藏品身份无误，展示与否也会影响游客现场价值。
missing.en: The current MFA gallery location and core-display status are missing; even if the object identity is correct, display status would affect visitor value.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 范霍延及结冰河景作品中的相对代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the work's comparative representativeness among MFA's Van Goyen and frozen-river pictures is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方藏品记录对完整标题、赫拉德·范洪特霍斯特归属、1636 年断代及油彩媒材的确认；目前未提供馆藏号或可核对的馆方对象记录，若作品归属、标题或年代不同，定级依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA object record confirming the full title, attribution to Gerard van Honthorst, the 1636 date, and the oil medium is missing; no accession number or verifiable MFA object record is supplied, and a different attribution, title, or date would change the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰与佛兰德斯十七世纪历史画、寓意画收藏中的相对位置，以及其是否为范洪特霍斯特的代表性作品；这直接关系艺术史价值和不可替代性。
missing.en: The work's comparative position within MFA's seventeenth-century Dutch and Flemish history and allegory holdings is missing, as is evidence that it is a representative Honthorst work; this directly bears on art-historical value and irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 展示状态、展厅位置及是否作为冬季女王或乌得勒支卡拉瓦乔主义叙事中的重点作品；这会影响现场价值和馆内叙事权重。
missing.en: Its MFA display status, gallery location, and whether it is featured in a narrative about the Winter Queen or Utrecht Caravaggism are missing; these would affect visitor value and narrative weight.

top_missing_zh: 该对象尤其缺 MFA 可核对的对象记录，以及其馆内历史寓意画收藏位置。
top_missing_en: This object especially lacks a verifiable MFA object record and evidence of its position within the museum's history-and-allegory holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对老扬·勃鲁盖尔归属、1609 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；若归属为工作室或年代不同，质量与艺术史依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Jan Brueghel the Elder, the 1609 date, title, and oil medium is missing; a workshop attribution or different date would change the quality and art-historical basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他老扬·勃鲁盖尔及佛兰德斯乡村风景的比较资料，无法确认其在馆内是否具有代表性或稀缺性；这直接关系不可替代性。
missing.en: Comparative evidence against MFA's other Jan Brueghel the Elder works and Flemish rural landscapes is missing, so its representativeness or rarity within the museum cannot be established; this directly bears on irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 展厅位置和当前展示状态；这会影响其作为佛兰德斯风景画例作的现场价值。
missing.en: The MFA gallery location and current display status are missing; these would affect its on-site value as an example of Flemish landscape painting.

top_missing_zh: 缺该作在 MFA 老扬·勃鲁盖尔及佛兰德斯风景画收藏中的比较位置。
top_missing_en: Its comparative position among MFA's Jan Brueghel the Elder and Flemish landscape holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对扬·阿瑟莱恩归属、1650 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；若年代、归属或作品性质不同，艺术史与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Jan Asselijn, the 1650 date, title, and oil medium is missing; a different date, attribution, or object status would change the art-historical and quality basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作所描绘的里昂地点是否经馆方或学术资料确认，以及其在阿瑟莱恩城市与河流风景作品中的代表性；这直接关系题材历史价值和类别代表性。
missing.en: Confirmation by the museum or scholarship that the depicted Lyon locations are correctly identified, and evidence of the work's representativeness among Asselijn's urban and river landscapes, are missing; this directly bears on historical value and category representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰风景画收藏中的相对位置、展示状态及展厅位置；这些资料会影响不可替代性和现场价值。
missing.en: Its comparative position within MFA's Dutch landscape holdings, display status, and gallery location are missing; these would affect irreplaceability and visitor value.

top_missing_zh: 缺阿瑟莱恩归属及里昂地标识别的馆方确认，也缺其在馆内同类收藏中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: MFA confirmation of the Asselijn attribution and Lyon landmark identification, as well as the work's comparative position in the collection, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对阿尔特·范德内尔归属、1655 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，艺术史价值与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Aert van der Neer, the 1655 date, title, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date would change the art-historical and quality basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 范德内尔暮色水景收藏中的相对位置，包括同类作品数量、质量及本作是否为代表性例作；这直接关系不可替代性。
missing.en: The work's comparative position among MFA's twilight-water landscapes by Van der Neer is missing, including the number and quality of comparable works and whether this is a representative example; this directly bears on irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 当前展厅位置和展示状态；这会影响以光氛围为主要价值依据的现场观赏价值。
missing.en: The current MFA gallery location and display status are missing; these would affect on-site value when atmospheric effect is a principal basis of appreciation.

top_missing_zh: 缺本作在 MFA 范德内尔暮色水景作品中的相对代表性及展示状态。
top_missing_en: The work's comparative representativeness among MFA's Van der Neer twilight landscapes and its display status are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对小戴维·泰尼尔斯归属、1650 年断代、标题及“铜上油画”媒材的确认；若作品并非该艺术家或并非铜上油画，艺术史与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to David Teniers the Younger, the 1650 date, title, and oil on copper medium is missing; if it is not by this artist or not an oil-on-copper painting, the art-historical and quality basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸及其在 MFA 小幅铜板绘画、泰尼尔斯风俗画收藏中的相对位置；尺寸和同类比较会影响视觉价值、代表性与不可替代性。
missing.en: The dimensions and comparative position within MFA's small copper paintings and Teniers genre holdings are missing; scale and comparison with related works would affect visual value, representativeness, and irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 展示状态和展厅位置，尤其缺是否作为佛兰德斯风俗画或铜板绘画的代表作展示；这会影响现场价值。
missing.en: Its MFA display status and gallery location are missing, especially whether it is presented as a representative Flemish genre or copper painting; this would affect visitor value.

top_missing_zh: 缺“铜上油画”的馆方确认、尺寸及其在泰尼尔斯和铜板绘画收藏中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: MFA confirmation of the oil-on-copper medium, the dimensions, and the work's comparative position among Teniers and copper paintings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对保卢斯·波特归属、1647 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；若标题、副标题、归属或年代不同，作品的典范性与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Paulus Potter, the 1647 date, title, and oil medium is missing; a different title, attribution, or date would change the work's canonical and quality basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 其他波特作品及荷兰动物—乡野景观的比较资料，无法确认其是否确为馆内该专题的核心代表；这直接关系不可替代性。
missing.en: Comparative evidence against MFA's other Potter works and Dutch animal-and-rural landscapes is missing, so its status as a core MFA example of the subject cannot be established; this directly bears on irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 当前展厅位置和重点展示状态；作品是否作为波特或荷兰动物画的重点展品会影响现场价值与馆内权重。
missing.en: The current MFA gallery location and featured-display status are missing; whether it is highlighted as a Potter or Dutch animal-painting work would affect visitor value and institutional weight.

top_missing_zh: 缺本作在 MFA 波特及荷兰动物画收藏中的核心代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the work's core representativeness among MFA's Potter and Dutch animal-painting holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对约阿希姆·于特瓦尔归属、1603 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；若归属或年代不同，矫饰主义艺术史依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Joachim Wtewael, the 1603 date, title, and oil medium is missing; a different attribution or date would change the basis for its Mannerist art-historical significance.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 于特瓦尔及北方矫饰主义收藏中的相对位置，包括同类作品数量、质量及本作是否为代表性例作；这直接关系类别代表性和不可替代性。
missing.en: The work's comparative position within MFA's Wtewael and Northern Mannerist holdings is missing, including the number and quality of comparable works and whether this is a representative example; this directly bears on category representativeness and irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 展示状态和展厅位置；这会影响其作为北方矫饰主义与古典牧歌题材例作的现场价值。
missing.en: Its MFA display status and gallery location are missing; these would affect its on-site value as an example of Northern Mannerism and classical pastoral imagery.

top_missing_zh: 缺于特瓦尔归属及其在 MFA 北方矫饰主义收藏中的相对代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the Wtewael attribution and the work's comparative representativeness within MFA's Northern Mannerist holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对威廉·科内利斯·杜伊斯特归属、1630 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；若馆方将其归为工作室、不同艺术家或不同年代，当前艺术史与质量依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Willem Cornelisz Duyster, the 1630 date, title, and oil medium is missing; if the museum attributes it to a workshop, another artist, or a different date, the current art-historical and quality basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 荷兰军旅与室内风俗画收藏中的相对位置，以及杜伊斯特作品的馆内数量和代表性；这直接关系其是否足以支撑当前层级。
missing.en: The work's comparative position within MFA's Dutch military and interior genre holdings, including the number and representativeness of Duyster works at the museum, is missing; this directly bears on whether it supports the current tier.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸、MFA 展示状态及展厅位置；这些资料会影响其视觉吸引力、现场价值和与其他风俗画的可替代性判断。
missing.en: The dimensions, MFA display status, and gallery location are missing; these would affect visual appeal, visitor value, and its substitutability relative to other genre paintings.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方归属确认及其在 MFA 杜伊斯特和荷兰风俗画收藏中的相对位置。
top_missing_en: MFA attribution confirmation and the work's comparative position among Duyster and Dutch genre holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对尼古拉斯·彼得松·贝尔赫姆归属、1660 年断代、标题及油彩媒材的确认；现有“高可信度”只是既有评分说明，不是外部馆方证据。若归属或年代不同，质量与艺术史依据会改变。
missing.en: An MFA record confirming the attribution to Nicolaes Pietersz. Berchem, the 1660 date, title, and oil medium is missing; the existing “high confidence” is only a prior scoring statement, not external museum evidence. A different attribution or date would change the quality and art-historical basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作在 MFA 贝尔赫姆及荷兰意大利化风景画收藏中的相对位置，包括同类作品数量、质量和本作是否为代表性例作；这直接关系不可替代性。
missing.en: The work's comparative position within MFA's Berchem and Dutch Italianate landscape holdings is missing, including the number and quality of comparable works and whether this is a representative example; this directly bears on irreplaceability.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 展示状态和展厅位置；若未展出或不属于相关核心叙事，游客现场价值与馆内权重可能不同。
missing.en: Its MFA display status and gallery location are missing; if it is not displayed or is outside the relevant core narrative, visitor value and institutional weight may differ.

top_missing_zh: 缺外部馆方证据确认贝尔赫姆归属，并缺其在 MFA 意大利化风景画收藏中的比较位置。
top_missing_en: External museum evidence confirming the Berchem attribution and the work's comparative position among MFA's Italianate landscapes is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录或权威图录对该件确为范戴克自画像、具体创作年代及其在范戴克自画像作品中的艺术史地位的确认；这些事实直接支撑其名家重要性与A档依据。
missing.en: Missing a museum record or authoritative catalogue confirming that this object is by Van Dyck, is specifically a self-portrait, its dating, and its art-historical importance among Van Dyck’s self-portraits; these facts directly support the A-tier rationale.

missing.zh: 缺该件在MFA现有荷兰与佛兰德斯绘画中的相对地位及当前展陈状态的馆方证据。
missing.en: Missing museum evidence for this object’s relative standing within MFA’s Dutch and Flemish painting holdings and its current display status.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方或权威图录对作品归属、题材身份及其在范戴克自画像中的重要性的确认。
top_missing_en: Museum or authoritative catalogue confirmation of the attribution, subject identity, and importance within Van Dyck’s self-portraits is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认该件的具体版本、制作年份、尺寸、铸造或复制关系及其为达林重要作品的依据；仅有艺术家、年份和青铜材质不足以证明其代表性。
missing.en: Missing an MFA record confirming the specific version, date, dimensions, casting or reproduction relationship, and the basis for regarding it as an important Dallin work; artist, date, and bronze alone do not establish representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺权威美国艺术史或馆方资料说明该件在美国公共雕塑及MFA美国艺术收藏中的相对地位。
missing.en: Missing authoritative American-art or museum evidence for its relative standing in American public sculpture and within MFA’s American-art collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺该件具体版本及其在达林作品和MFA美国艺术收藏中的相对地位证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the specific version and its relative standing in Dallin’s oeuvre and MFA’s American-art collection is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或权威图录确认该件的归属、确切创作年代、尺寸及其作为罗塞蒂成熟女性形象和前拉斐尔派转向唯美主义重要作品的地位。
missing.en: Missing museum or authoritative catalogue confirmation of the attribution, precise date, dimensions, and importance as a key Rossetti image of mature female figures and of the Pre-Raphaelite turn toward Aestheticism.

missing.zh: 缺该件在MFA英国艺术收藏及同馆前拉斐尔派作品中的相对不可替代性证据。
missing.en: Missing evidence of this object’s relative distinctiveness within MFA’s British-art and Pre-Raphaelite holdings.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威资料确认其作品归属及其在罗塞蒂和MFA前拉斐尔派收藏中的代表性。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of its attribution and representativeness in Rossetti’s oeuvre and MFA’s Pre-Raphaelite holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录确认题名、巴克赫伊森归属、1666年断代、尺寸及作品是否为完整原作而非工作室或后世版本；这些事实会直接改变名家重要性与作品评价。
missing.en: Missing a museum record confirming the title, Backhuysen attribution, 1666 dating, dimensions, and whether this is a complete original rather than a studio or later version; these facts would directly affect the artist-importance and object-quality assessment.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料比较该件与MFA荷兰海景画收藏及巴克赫伊森同类作品的相对地位。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparative evidence for its standing within MFA’s Dutch marine-painting holdings and among comparable works by Backhuysen.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对归属、版本和在MFA荷兰海景画收藏中相对地位的确认。
top_missing_en: Museum confirmation of the attribution, version status, and relative standing within MFA’s Dutch marine-painting holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认该件确为弗朗茨·马克的《The Blue Rider》彩色木刻，并提供确切年代、版次或版本信息、尺寸与技法。
missing.en: Missing an MFA record confirming that this is Franz Marc’s color woodcut The Blue Rider, together with its precise date, edition or version information, dimensions, and technique.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该木刻相对于马克同题材绘画及MFA德国表现主义版画收藏的艺术史和馆藏地位。
missing.en: Missing authoritative evidence of the woodcut’s art-historical and collection significance relative to Marc’s paintings of the subject and MFA’s German Expressionist prints.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品身份、版本及其相对于马克核心绘画的地位证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the object’s identity, version, and standing relative to Marc’s canonical paintings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认该页的确切对象类型、题名、制作年代、材质和来源文化语境，并解释艺术家字段所对应的匿名或具体制作者。
missing.en: Missing an MFA record confirming the precise object type, title, date, material, cultural context, and whether the artist field denotes an anonymous maker or a specific artist.

missing.zh: 缺权威波斯艺术图录说明该页在专辑、巴赫拉姆·古尔图像传统及MFA伊斯兰艺术收藏中的相对重要性。
missing.en: Missing authoritative Persian-art catalogue evidence for the folio’s significance within album production, the Bahram Gur image tradition, and MFA’s Islamic-art holdings.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸及保存状态等能判断其视觉呈现和游客可见价值的资料。
missing.en: Missing dimensions and condition information relevant to judging its visual presentation and visitor-facing value.

top_missing_zh: 缺该页的确切归属、制作语境及其在MFA波斯艺术收藏中的相对重要性。
top_missing_en: The folio’s precise attribution, production context, and relative importance within MFA’s Persian-art holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录确认题名、哈尔斯归属、约1630年断代、尺寸及是否为本人作品而非工作室或归属作品。
missing.en: Missing a museum record confirming the title, Hals attribution, circa-1630 dating, dimensions, and whether it is by Hals himself rather than a studio or attributed work.

missing.zh: 缺权威比较资料说明该肖像在MFA荷兰黄金时代肖像画收藏及哈尔斯肖像画中的相对地位。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparative evidence for its standing within MFA’s Dutch Golden Age portrait holdings and among Hals’s portraits.

top_missing_zh: 缺归属和相对地位证据，尤其缺少本人作品与工作室作品的区分。
top_missing_en: Attribution and comparative-standing evidence is missing, especially confirmation that it is by Hals himself rather than his studio.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录确认题名、埃赫隆·范德内尔归属、1678年断代、尺寸及版本或工作室关系。
missing.en: Missing a museum record confirming the title, Eglon van der Neer attribution, 1678 dating, dimensions, and any version or studio relationship.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该件在MFA荷兰黄金时代室内风俗画收藏中的相对代表性，而不是仅凭同类组内唯一作出判断。
missing.en: Missing authoritative evidence of its relative representativeness within MFA’s Dutch Golden Age interior genre paintings, rather than relying only on its being the sole item in the comparison group.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品归属、版本和馆藏相对代表性的权威确认。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the attribution, version, and relative representativeness within the collection is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认该件的完整题名、溪斋英泉归属、系列位置、创作年代、版画技法、尺寸和版次。
missing.en: Missing an MFA record confirming the complete title, Keisai Eisen attribution, position in the series, date, print technique, dimensions, and edition information.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料比较该件与MFA日本浮世绘美人画收藏及同系列其他作品的代表性和重复度。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparative evidence for its representativeness and redundancy relative to MFA’s ukiyo-e bijin-ga holdings and other works in the series.

top_missing_zh: 缺系列位置、版本技法及其在MFA日本版画收藏中的相对代表性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for its series position, edition and technique, and relative representativeness within MFA’s Japanese print holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认《Narcissus》的制作年代范围、制作地点、织造者或工作坊、尺寸、技法及丝绸材质；现有艺术家字段仍是未解析的Wikidata实体。
missing.en: Missing an MFA record confirming the dating range, place of production, maker or workshop, dimensions, technique, and silk material of Narcissus; the artist field remains an unresolved Wikidata entity.

missing.zh: 缺权威壁毯或装饰艺术图录说明其在欧洲文艺复兴壁毯中的稀有性、质量和相对地位。
missing.en: Missing authoritative tapestry or decorative-arts catalogue evidence for its rarity, quality, and relative standing among Renaissance European tapestries.

top_missing_zh: 缺制作者、产地、尺寸和权威质量评估，无法支撑其作为高价值文艺复兴壁毯的判断。
top_missing_en: Maker, origin, dimensions, and authoritative quality assessment are missing, so its status as a significant Renaissance tapestry is not supported.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录确认题名、扬·范霍延归属、1648年断代、尺寸、版本及当前展陈状态。
missing.en: Missing a museum record confirming the title, Jan van Goyen attribution, 1648 dating, dimensions, version status, and current display status.

missing.zh: 缺权威比较资料说明该件在MFA荷兰黄金时代风景画收藏及范霍延河景画中的相对地位。
missing.en: Missing authoritative comparative evidence for its standing within MFA’s Dutch Golden Age landscape holdings and among van Goyen’s river landscapes.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品归属、版本和在MFA荷兰风景画收藏中的相对地位证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence for the attribution, version status, and relative standing within MFA’s Dutch landscape holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方对象记录确认“波士顿绿头”的馆藏号、具体雕像身份、确切年代、材质和古埃及归属；现有资料只有未经官网确认的Wikidata日期。
missing.en: Missing an MFA object record confirming the accession number, precise sculptural identity, dating, material, and ancient-Egyptian attribution of the Boston Green Head; the current evidence is only an unconfirmed Wikidata date.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或权威埃及艺术资料证明该件具有专名、独立辨识度及MFA核心展品地位，并支持其S级“错过明显可惜”的判断。
missing.en: Missing museum or authoritative Egyptological evidence that this object has a recognized name, independent recognizability, and core-display status at MFA, supporting the S-tier claim that it is conspicuously regrettable to miss.

missing.zh: 缺该件具体考古出土或收藏语境的资料，以确认其在MFA埃及艺术叙事中的特殊身份价值。
missing.en: Missing the object-specific archaeological or collecting context needed to establish its special identity value within MFA’s Egyptian-art narrative.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方确认该件身份及其核心展品、馆藏象征地位的证据。
top_missing_en: Museum confirmation of the object’s identity and its status as a core, identity-bearing MFA exhibit is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式记录对该作品作者归属（扬·斯滕本人、工作坊或其他归属）的确认；归属不同会改变其作为扬·斯滕作品的定级依据。
missing.en: Missing official museum confirmation of the attribution—Jan Steen himself, his workshop, or another attribution; a different attribution would change the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法确认该对象是否为MFA正式收藏中的该件作品；馆藏身份不同会改变定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the official MFA collection record and accession number, so it is not confirmed that this is the stated object in the MFA collection; collection status would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在扬·斯滕作品序列及MFA荷兰黄金时代风俗画收藏中的比较位置；若为罕见代表作而非普通可替代作品，Tier判断依据会不同。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within Jan Steen’s oeuvre and MFA’s Dutch Golden Age genre-painting holdings; whether it is an unusually important work or a replaceable example would affect the tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对作者归属和正式馆藏身份的确认。
top_missing_en: Official confirmation of the attribution and collection identity is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录对《Hope》的具体版本、作者归属及作品身份的直接确认；若并非伯恩-琼斯本人作品或并非该馆藏编号对应对象，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing direct official confirmation of the specific version, attribution, and object identity of Hope; if it is not by Burne-Jones himself or not the object corresponding to this accession number, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在伯恩-琼斯作品序列及MFA英国前拉斐尔派与象征主义收藏中的比较位置；其是否为关键代表作会影响定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within Burne-Jones’s oeuvre and MFA’s Pre-Raphaelite and Symbolist holdings; whether it is a key representative work would affect the tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对该馆藏编号所对应具体作品及其作者归属的直接确认。
top_missing_en: Direct official confirmation of the specific object and attribution corresponding to the accession number is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法确认该肖像是否为MFA收藏中的该件作品；馆藏身份不同会改变定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the official MFA collection record and accession number, so the object’s identity as an MFA-held work is unconfirmed; collection status would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺作者归属、创作年代和媒介的馆方确认；这些信息若不同，将影响其作为萨拉·古德里奇美国肖像微型画的代表性判断。
missing.en: Missing official confirmation of attribution, date, and medium; different answers would affect its status as a representative miniature portrait by Sarah Goodridge.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在古德里奇作品序列及MFA美国肖像微型画收藏中的比较位置；若为关键代表作而非普通例作，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within Goodridge’s oeuvre and MFA’s American miniature-portrait holdings; whether it is a key example rather than a routine work would affect the tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录、作品媒介与创作年代。
top_missing_en: The official collection record, medium, and date are missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方页面对馆藏编号49.1304、作品标题、作者及对象身份的直接核对；若编号对应的不是所述肖像，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing direct official verification that accession number 49.1304 corresponds to the stated title, artist, and object; if it identifies a different portrait, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒介和尺寸；若作品属于古德里奇创作中的特殊类型或重要时期，而非普通肖像，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the date, medium, and dimensions; if the work belongs to a distinctive or important phase or type in Goodridge’s practice rather than being a routine portrait, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在古德里奇作品序列及MFA同类美国肖像中的比较位置；这决定其是否只是可替代的地方社会史例证。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within Goodridge’s oeuvre and MFA’s American portrait holdings; this determines whether it is merely a replaceable local-social-history example.

top_missing_zh: 缺对馆藏编号49.1304所对应对象的馆方核验，以及创作年代和媒介。
top_missing_en: Official verification of the object corresponding to accession 49.1304, along with its date and medium, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法确认该对象是否为MFA收藏中的正式作品；若馆藏身份不成立，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the official MFA collection record and accession number, so it is unconfirmed that this is a formally held MFA object; if the collection identity is not established, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺作者归属；若作者并非萨拉·古德里奇，或属于另一位具有更高艺术史地位的作者，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the attribution; if the artist is not Sarah Goodridge, or is an artist of substantially different art-historical importance, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺媒介、创作年代、尺寸及作品性质；这些信息可能区分普通肖像、微型画或具有特殊收藏价值的对象，从而影响定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the medium, date, dimensions, and object type; these facts could distinguish an ordinary portrait from a miniature or another object of special significance, affecting the tier basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方馆藏身份和作者归属，这是该对象当前定级几乎没有事实支撑的主要缺口。
top_missing_en: Official collection identity and attribution are missing; these are the main factual gaps supporting the current tier.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法确认该对象是否为MFA收藏中的正式作品；馆藏身份不同会改变定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the official MFA collection record and accession number, so the object’s identity as a formally held MFA work is unconfirmed; collection status would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺作者归属的馆方确认；若并非萨拉·古德里奇作品，当前关于美国19世纪肖像传统的定级依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing official confirmation of the attribution; if it is not by Sarah Goodridge, the current tier basis in the context of nineteenth-century American portraiture would change.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒介、尺寸以及在古德里奇作品序列中的位置；若其为特殊时期或代表性作品，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the date, medium, dimensions, and position within Goodridge’s oeuvre; if it is a work from a distinctive period or a representative example, the tier basis would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方馆藏记录及作者归属确认。
top_missing_en: The official collection record and attribution confirmation are missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方页面对馆藏编号46.706所对应对象的直接核验，包括标题、人物身份、作者和对象类型；若编号对应不同对象，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing direct official verification of the title, sitter, artist, and object type corresponding to accession number 46.706; if the number refers to another object, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺媒介、尺寸及作品在古德里奇肖像创作中的比较位置；这些信息若显示其为特殊类型或关键代表作，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the medium, dimensions, and comparative position within Goodridge’s portrait practice; if these show it to be a distinctive type or key representative work, the tier basis would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对馆藏编号46.706所对应具体对象的直接核验，以及媒介信息。
top_missing_en: Direct official verification of the object corresponding to accession 46.706 and its medium is missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法确认该肖像是否为MFA收藏中的正式对象；馆藏身份不同会改变定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the official MFA collection record and accession number, so it is unconfirmed that this portrait is a formally held MFA object; collection status would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺作者归属、创作年代、媒介和尺寸；若作品并非古德里奇本人所作，或属于微型画等特殊类型，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the attribution, date, medium, and dimensions; if it is not by Goodridge or belongs to a distinctive type such as a miniature, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作品是否具有特殊委托、家族来源或其他独特历史背景的资料；若存在此类背景，其不可替代性判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing evidence of any special commission, family provenance, or other distinctive historical context; such context would affect the assessment of substitutability underlying the tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方馆藏身份、作者归属及媒介确认。
top_missing_en: Collection identity, attribution, and medium are missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法确认该对象是否为MFA收藏中的正式作品；馆藏身份不同会改变定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the official MFA collection record and accession number, so the object’s identity as a formally held MFA work is unconfirmed; collection status would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺作者归属、创作年代、媒介和尺寸；这些事实若不同，可能改变其在美国人物肖像史及古德里奇作品中的定位。
missing.en: Missing the attribution, date, medium, and dimensions; different facts could change its position in the history of American portraiture and within Goodridge’s oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在古德里奇作品序列及MFA同类收藏中的比较位置；若其为重要代表作而非常规男性肖像，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within Goodridge’s oeuvre and MFA’s comparable holdings; if it is a major representative work rather than a routine male portrait, the tier basis would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方馆藏记录、作者归属及作品基本属性。
top_missing_en: The official collection record, attribution, and basic object facts are missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式馆藏记录及馆藏编号，无法确认该对象是否为MFA收藏中的正式作品；馆藏身份不同会改变定级依据。
missing.en: Missing the official MFA collection record and accession number, so the object’s identity as a formally held MFA work is unconfirmed; collection status would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺创作年代、媒介和尺寸；若作品具有特殊时期、形式或微型画属性，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the date, medium, and dimensions; if the work belongs to a distinctive period or format, or is a miniature, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该作品在古德里奇作品序列及MFA同类美国肖像中的比较位置；其是否为关键代表作仍无外部资料支撑。
missing.en: Missing the work’s comparative position within Goodridge’s oeuvre and MFA’s comparable American portrait holdings; there is no external evidence establishing whether it is a key representative work.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方馆藏身份、创作年代和媒介。
top_missing_en: Collection identity, date, and medium are missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方正式记录、馆藏编号及对象身份核验，无法确认“Golshan Album”具体指哪一件册页；对象身份不同会改变Tier判断依据。
missing.en: Missing the official record, accession number, and object-identity verification, so it is unclear which specific muraqqa is meant by Golshan Album; object identity would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺册页的具体构成，包括所含绘画、书法、艺术家、页数及是否为完整册页；若包含重要名家作品或为完整历史册页，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the album’s contents, including paintings, calligraphers, artists, folio count, and whether it is complete; important named works or a complete historical album would affect the tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺来源与流传记录，尤其是制作地域、宫廷或收藏背景及入藏经过；若存在明确而重要的历史语境，其不可替代性判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing provenance and transmission history, especially the place of production, court or collecting context, and acquisition history; a documented important historical context would affect the assessment of substitutability underlying the tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺该册页的具体构成和馆方对象身份确认。
top_missing_en: The album’s specific contents and official object-identity confirmation are missing.

missing.zh: 缺馆方页面对馆藏编号1995.156.1所对应对象的直接核验，包括标题、对象类型、作者关联和完整性；若编号对应不同或不完整的物件，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing direct official verification of the title, object type, artist association, and completeness corresponding to accession number 1995.156.1; if it refers to a different or incomplete object, the tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺绘画盒与Caroline Schetky Richardson的具体关联证据，包括是否为本人使用、制作年代及使用情境；若关联强度不同，其艺术家工作室史价值会改变。
missing.en: Missing evidence of the specific connection between the paint box and Caroline Schetky Richardson, including whether she used it, its date, and its use context; differing strength of association would change its studio-history significance.

missing.zh: 缺绘画盒的材质、尺寸、保存状况及内部物件信息；若为罕见、完整或具有特殊功能的工作室实物，Tier判断依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing the paint box’s materials, dimensions, condition, and information about its contents; if it is rare, complete, or functionally distinctive, the tier basis would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方对馆藏编号1995.156.1及其与Caroline Schetky Richardson关联的直接核验。
top_missing_en: Direct official verification of accession number 1995.156.1 and its connection to Caroline Schetky Richardson is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品题名、作者归属及其为约翰·科普利本人作品的确认；若归属改为工作坊、追随者或其他艺术家，Tier 依据会改变。
