missing.zh: 缺该幅与 MFA 同系列及同类日本版画的比较资料，无法核实其组内最低代表性、重复度及有限不可替代性的判断。
missing.en: Comparative evidence is missing for this print against MFA’s other works in the series and comparable Japanese prints, so its claimed lowest group representativeness, high redundancy, and limited substitutability cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方馆藏与作品归属核验，以及证明其在同系列和 MFA 同类藏品中代表性最低的比较资料。
top_missing_en: Official collection and attribution verification is missing, along with comparative evidence for its lowest representativeness among the series and MFA’s comparable holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认《The Regata》的馆藏号、正式题名、范赖瑟尔贝赫归属、1892年断代及油彩媒材；其中任何一项不同都会影响作品的艺术史定位和 Tier 依据。
missing.en: An official MFA record is missing to confirm the accession number, official title, attribution to Théo van Rysselberghe, 1892 date, and oil-paint medium of The Regata; a difference in any of these would affect its art-historical positioning and Tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 或学术来源确认该作确实体现范赖瑟尔贝赫的点彩或新印象主义实践，并说明其在艺术家创作生涯中的位置。
missing.en: MFA or scholarly confirmation is missing that the work represents van Rysselberghe’s pointillist or Neo-Impressionist practice, together with its place in the artist’s career.

missing.zh: 缺该作与 MFA 比利时新印象主义及法国印象派相关藏品的比较资料，无法核实其作为组内唯一对象的独特性及其非核心定位。
missing.en: Comparative evidence is missing against MFA’s Belgian Neo-Impressionist and related French Impressionist holdings, so its claimed uniqueness within the group and non-core institutional position cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方馆藏及学术资料确认作品身份、范赖瑟尔贝赫归属和点彩语境，也缺其在 MFA 相关藏品中的比较位置。
top_missing_en: Official collection and scholarly confirmation of the object’s identity, van Rysselberghe attribution, and pointillist context is missing, as is comparative placement within MFA’s related holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏页或学术图录确认30.461的正式题名、图像、艺术家归属、年代、媒材及尺寸；Wikidata 条目本身不足以支撑这些关键识别。
missing.en: An MFA collection page or scholarly catalogue is missing to confirm the official title, image, attribution, date, medium, and dimensions of accession 30.461; the Wikidata entry alone is insufficient for these key identifications.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明该作的黄居寀归属是确定归属、传派归属还是后世归属，并说明其在黄居寀传世花鸟画中的艺术史地位。
missing.en: Authoritative documentation is missing to establish whether the Huang Jucai attribution is secure, workshop-related, or otherwise qualified, and to state the work’s art-historical position among surviving flower-and-bird paintings associated with Huang Jucai.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 中国绘画馆藏比较及策展资料证明该作在馆内具有所称的独特补位价值，并足以支撑 A Tier。
missing.en: Comparative and curatorial documentation from MFA’s Chinese painting holdings is missing to demonstrate the work’s claimed unique institutional role and to support Tier A.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录和学术资料确认黄居寀归属、作品年代与艺术史地位，以及其在馆内中国绘画收藏中的独特位置。
top_missing_en: MFA and scholarly documentation is missing for the Huang Jucai attribution, dating, art-historical status, and distinctive position within the museum’s Chinese painting holdings.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏页确认45.892的正式题名、图像、艺术家真实身份、年代及油彩媒材；当前 artist 值只是 Wikidata 生成的 genid，不能作为艺术家身份。
missing.en: An MFA collection page is missing to confirm the official title, image, actual artist identity, date, and oil medium of accession 45.892; the current artist value is only a Wikidata-generated genid and does not establish an artist identity.

missing.zh: 缺作品的艺术家归属或无名归属、创作地区和具体风格信息；这些答案会直接改变其在十九世纪风景油画中的历史与叙事定位。
missing.en: The artist attribution or anonymous status, place of production, and specific stylistic information are missing; these answers would directly change the work’s historical and narrative position among nineteenth-century landscape paintings.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、图像和展示记录，无法核实其现场视觉吸引力及作为该组唯一对象的实际观赏意义。
missing.en: Dimensions, image documentation, and display records are missing, so the work’s actual visual impact and viewing significance as the sole object in the group cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是艺术家真实身份及创作地区、风格；当前 genid 不是可用的艺术家资料，且缺官方馆藏页核对作品身份。
top_missing_en: The critical gap is the actual artist identity, place of production, and style; the current genid is not usable artist documentation, and an official MFA record is also missing to verify the object.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认该件卷涡器的馆藏号、正式题名、图像、年代、尺寸及 Hoppin Painter 归属；Wikidata 条目不足以确认这些关键属性。
missing.en: An MFA collection record is missing to confirm the accession number, official title, image, date, dimensions, and Hoppin Painter attribution of this volute krater; the Wikidata entry is insufficient to establish these key attributes.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料说明 Hoppin Painter 归属的确定程度、画家活动年代及该器在其作品中的位置；若归属或年代不同，其艺术史代表性会改变。
missing.en: Authoritative documentation is missing on the certainty of the Hoppin Painter attribution, the painter’s active period, and the vessel’s place within the painter’s oeuvre; a different attribution or date would change its art-historical representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺器物图像、尺寸和图像主题资料，无法核实其大型器形、装饰质量及仪式与神话叙事价值。
missing.en: Image, dimensions, and iconographic documentation are missing, so the claims about its large format, decorative quality, and ritual and mythological narrative value cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方馆藏与学术资料核实 Hoppin Painter 归属、年代、器形尺寸和图像主题，这些正是其 B Tier 依据的主要事实。
top_missing_en: Official collection and scholarly documentation is missing for the Hoppin Painter attribution, date, vessel dimensions, and iconography, which are the main factual bases for its Tier B position.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录确认该件长颈高瓶的馆藏号、正式题名、图像、年代、尺寸及 White Saccos Painter 归属。
missing.en: An MFA collection record is missing to confirm the accession number, official title, image, date, dimensions, and White Saccos Painter attribution of this loutrophoros.

missing.zh: 缺权威资料确认 White Saccos Painter 归属的确定程度、画家活动年代及该瓶的具体生产地区；这些信息会影响其在阿普利亚红绘陶器中的代表性。
missing.en: Authoritative documentation is missing on the certainty of the White Saccos Painter attribution, the painter’s active period, and the vessel’s precise production region; these facts would affect its representativeness within Apulian red-figure pottery.

missing.zh: 缺图像学资料确认该器确与婚礼、葬仪或其他仪式功能相关；若仪式语境不同，其教育和叙事价值会改变。
missing.en: Iconographic documentation is missing to confirm whether the vessel is associated with wedding, funerary, or another ritual function; a different ritual context would change its educational and narrative value.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方馆藏核验、White Saccos Painter 归属及仪式图像学证据，尤其缺足以支持其组内第二位置的比较依据。
top_missing_en: Official collection verification, the White Saccos Painter attribution, and ritual-iconographic evidence are missing, especially comparative evidence sufficient to support its claimed second position in the group.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏页确认58.316的正式题名、图像、真实艺术家或无名状态、年代及陶瓦材质；当前 artist 值只是 Wikidata 生成的 genid，不能作为艺术家身份。
missing.en: An MFA collection page is missing to confirm the official title, image, actual artist or anonymous status, date, and terracotta medium of accession 58.316; the current artist value is only a Wikidata-generated genid and does not establish an artist identity.

missing.zh: 缺作品的文化归属、生产地区和具体年代依据；这些事实会直接改变其在十八世纪陶土神怪头像中的历史定位。
missing.en: The object’s cultural attribution, place of production, and evidence for its specific date are missing; these facts would directly change its historical position among eighteenth-century terracotta demon-head sculptures.

missing.zh: 缺图像学和馆藏比较资料说明“恶魔头像”是正式题名还是描述性标签，并证明其在 MFA 同类雕塑中的实际代表性。
missing.en: Iconographic and collection-comparison documentation is missing to establish whether “Head of a demon” is an official title or a descriptive label, and to demonstrate its actual representativeness among comparable MFA sculptures.

top_missing_zh: 最关键缺口是艺术家或无名状态、文化来源、生产地区与图像学身份；当前 genid 不能支撑作品归属。
top_missing_en: The critical gaps are the artist or anonymous status, cultural origin, production region, and iconographic identity; the current genid does not establish the object’s attribution.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 09.204 的对象身份、门卡乌拉归属及其是否为古王国王室雕像的确认；若归属不同，核心艺术史价值和定级依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the identity of 09.204, its attribution to Menkaura, and whether it is an Old Kingdom royal statue; a different attribution would change its art-historical significance and tier basis.

missing.zh: 缺该雕像的尺寸、完整程度和保存状况；这些事实直接影响其巨像尺度、视觉冲击和作品质量判断。
missing.en: The dimensions, degree of completeness, and condition are missing; these directly affect assessments of monumental scale, visual impact, and quality.

missing.zh: 缺明确的考古出土地、发掘记录或收藏语境，尤其缺其是否与吉萨考古叙事直接相关的资料。
missing.en: The archaeological findspot, excavation record, or collecting context is missing, especially evidence of a direct connection to the Giza archaeological narrative.

missing.zh: 缺该件在 MFA 古埃及古王国王室雕像中的比较排名，以及馆方是否将其列为核心展品或重点藏品的证据。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for its comparative standing among MFA’s Old Kingdom royal sculptures and for whether the museum designates it as a core or highlight object.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 对门卡乌拉归属、巨像尺寸及其在馆内古王国王室雕像中地位的官方确认。
top_missing_en: Official confirmation is missing for the Menkaura attribution, monumental dimensions, and standing among MFA’s Old Kingdom royal sculptures.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 1986.162 的确切身份、中王国年代及女性头像归属的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the exact identity of 1986.162, its Middle Kingdom dating, and the attribution of the female head.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、残缺范围和保存状况；这些事实会改变残件的视觉与作品质量评价。
missing.en: The dimensions, extent of fragmentation, and condition are missing; these could change assessments of visual impact and object quality.

missing.zh: 缺该件与 MFA 其他中王国木雕及女性人物雕像的比较排名，以及馆方陈列或策展重点证据。
missing.en: Its comparative ranking among MFA’s Middle Kingdom wooden sculptures and female figure sculptures, as well as evidence of curatorial or display prominence, is missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该残件在 MFA 中王国木雕中的比较地位，以及馆方对其身份和年代的确认。
top_missing_en: Its comparative standing among MFA’s Middle Kingdom wooden sculptures and the museum’s confirmation of its identity and date are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 63.1495 的文化归属、确切年代、三尊组合身份及象牙材质的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the cultural attribution, precise date, triad identity, and ivory material of 63.1495.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、完整程度和保存状况，尤其缺该件是否为完整的坐佛与胁侍菩萨组合。
missing.en: The dimensions, completeness, and condition are missing, especially whether the object is a complete seated Buddha with attendant bodhisattvas.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 亚洲佛教造像或象牙工艺收藏中的比较排名，以及馆方是否赋予其重点展品地位的证据。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for its comparative standing among MFA’s Buddhist sculpture or ivory holdings and for any museum designation as a highlight object.

top_missing_zh: 缺该象牙三尊像的官方身份、完整程度及其在 MFA 亚洲佛教收藏中的比较地位。
top_missing_en: The object’s official identity, completeness, and comparative standing within MFA’s Buddhist collection are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 1991.968 的奥尔梅克归属、年代和翡翠材质的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the Olmec attribution, date, and jade material of 1991.968.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况、雕刻完整性及考古或来源语境；这些事实会影响其质量、仪式意义和视觉价值判断。
missing.en: The dimensions, condition, carving completeness, and archaeological or provenance context are missing; these affect assessments of quality, ritual significance, and visual value.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 中部美洲玉石面具及相关收藏中的比较排名、稀缺性和馆方策展地位。
missing.en: Its comparative ranking, rarity, and curatorial standing among MFA’s Mesoamerican jade masks and related holdings are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺奥尔梅克归属的官方确认，以及该面具在 MFA 中部美洲收藏中的比较排名和稀缺性。
top_missing_en: Official confirmation of the Olmec attribution and evidence of the mask’s comparative rank and rarity within MFA’s Mesoamerican holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺该“Jaguar effigy vessel”的 MFA 馆藏号及官方记录，无法确认对象身份、文化归属和题名。
missing.en: The MFA accession number and official record for the Jaguar effigy vessel are missing, so its identity, cultural attribution, and title cannot be confirmed.

missing.zh: 缺其确切年代、材质、尺寸、保存状况及彩绘保存程度；这些事实直接影响作品质量和历史价值判断。
missing.en: The precise date, material, dimensions, condition, and preservation of the painted surface are missing; these directly affect assessments of quality and historical value.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 早期中部美洲动物形容器中的比较排名、稀缺性及馆方展陈或策展地位。
missing.en: Its comparative standing, rarity, and display or curatorial status among MFA’s early Mesoamerican animal-effigy vessels are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该器物的官方身份、文化归属和在 MFA 同类中的比较排名。
top_missing_en: The vessel’s official identity, cultural attribution, and comparative standing among MFA’s related objects are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 66.235 的地域归属、确切年代、弥勒身份及银质材料的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the regional attribution, precise date, Maitreya identity, and silver material of 66.235.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况、工艺质量及造像是否有铭文或特殊图像学特征的资料。
missing.en: Information is missing on dimensions, condition, craftsmanship, and whether the sculpture has inscriptions or distinctive iconographic features.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 亚洲金属佛教造像中的比较排名，以及与同组其他弥勒或银质造像的重复程度。
missing.en: Its comparative ranking among MFA’s Asian metal Buddhist sculptures and the degree of overlap with other Maitreya or silver sculptures are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该弥勒银像的地域归属及其在 MFA 亚洲金属佛教造像中的比较排名。
top_missing_en: The regional attribution and comparative ranking of this silver Maitreya within MFA’s Asian metal Buddhist sculptures are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 32.436 的地域归属、确切年代、药师佛身份及青铜材质的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the regional attribution, precise date, Medicine Buddha identity, and bronze material of 32.436.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况、铸造质量及是否有铭文、底座或特殊图像学特征的资料。
missing.en: Information is missing on dimensions, condition, casting quality, and any inscriptions, pedestal, or distinctive iconographic features.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 亚洲金属佛教造像中的比较排名，以及馆方是否将其作为早期佛教或日本艺术板块的重点对象。
missing.en: Its comparative ranking among MFA’s Asian metal Buddhist sculptures and any museum designation as a highlight of the early Buddhist or Japanese art holdings are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该药师佛的地域归属及其在 MFA 亚洲佛教金属造像中的比较排名。
top_missing_en: The regional attribution and comparative ranking of this Medicine Buddha within MFA’s Asian Buddhist metal sculptures are missing.

missing.zh: 缺该阿普利亚红绘陶瓶的 MFA 馆藏号及官方记录，无法核实对象身份和题名。
missing.en: The MFA accession number and official record for the Apulian red-figure vase are missing, so its identity and title cannot be verified.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 对 Darius Painter 归属、年代、阿特柔斯谋杀图像识别及材质的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s confirmation is missing for the Darius Painter attribution, date, identification of the Atreus-murder scene, and material.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况、绘画质量以及该瓶在 MFA 古典地中海陶瓶收藏中的比较排名。
missing.en: The dimensions, condition, painting quality, and comparative ranking within MFA’s classical Mediterranean vase collection are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该瓶的官方馆藏身份、Darius Painter 归属及其在 MFA 阿普利亚红绘陶瓶中的比较排名。
top_missing_en: The vase’s official identity, Darius Painter attribution, and comparative standing among MFA’s Apulian red-figure vases are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 32.144 的确切身份、Earl Howe 舰名对应关系及年代的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the exact identity of 32.144, its relation to the vessel named Earl Howe, and its date.

missing.zh: 缺模型比例或尺寸、制作工艺、保存状况及作者或制造者资料；这些事实直接影响作品质量判断。

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 欧洲舰船模型中的比较排名、稀缺性、来源史及馆方策展地位。
missing.en: Its comparative ranking, rarity, provenance, and curatorial standing among MFA’s European ship models are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该舰船模型的官方身份、作品质量资料及其在 MFA 同类中的比较排名。
top_missing_en: The model’s official identity, quality-related documentation, and comparative standing among MFA’s related ship models are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 2000.973 的埃及地域归属、确切年代、奥西里斯身份及杂砂岩材质的确认。

missing.zh: 缺雕像尺寸、完整程度、保存状况及铭文或图像学细节。
missing.en: The dimensions, completeness, condition, and any inscriptions or iconographic details are missing.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 古埃及神祇石雕或奥西里斯雕像中的比较排名，以及馆方重点展陈或策展定位的证据。
missing.en: Evidence is missing for its comparative ranking among MFA’s Egyptian divine stone sculptures or Osiris statues and for any museum highlight or curatorial designation.

top_missing_zh: 缺其在 MFA 奥西里斯及古埃及神祇石雕中的比较排名，且馆方身份与年代尚未由官方记录确认。
top_missing_en: Its comparative standing among MFA’s Osiris and Egyptian divine stone sculptures is missing, and its identity and date lack official confirmation.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 1990.605 的文化归属、确切年代、家庭神龛及裸体女神图像的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the cultural attribution, precise date, household-shrine identity, and nude-goddess imagery of 1990.605.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况、陶瓦制作质量及神龛内部或附属人物的完整信息。
missing.en: Information is missing on dimensions, condition, terracotta workmanship, and the completeness of the shrine interior or associated figures.

missing.zh: 缺其在 MFA 古代地中海陶质宗教器物中的比较排名、稀缺性及馆方策展地位。
missing.en: Its comparative ranking, rarity, and curatorial standing among MFA’s ancient Mediterranean terracotta religious objects are missing.

top_missing_zh: 缺该家庭神龛的官方文化归属及其在 MFA 古代地中海陶质宗教器物中的比较排名。
top_missing_en: The shrine’s official cultural attribution and comparative standing among MFA’s ancient Mediterranean terracotta religious objects are missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方记录对 66.233 的文化归属、确切年代、狮子形象身份及砂岩材质的确认。
missing.en: MFA’s official record is needed to confirm the cultural attribution, precise date, identity of the lion image, and sandstone material of 66.233.

missing.en: Missing official confirmation of the current gallery and display status at MFA; a different display status would change its on-site viewing priority.

top_missing_zh: 珠网裙的考古语境、构成与保存状况，以及其在埃及和MFA中的实际稀缺性尚无权威来源支持；这些正是当前高等级判断的核心依据。
top_missing_en: Authoritative support is missing for the dress's archaeological context, construction, condition, and actual rarity in Egyptian and MFA holdings; these are central to the current high-tier assessment.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或考古资料确认该坐像的确切年代、人物身份、铭文、墓葬语境及保存完整程度；这些事实若不同，会改变其作为早王朝人物雕塑代表的历史权重。
missing.en: Missing museum or archaeological documentation confirming the statue's precise date, sitter's identity, inscriptions, funerary context, and degree of preservation; different answers would change its historical weight as an Early Dynastic figure sculpture.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方资料比较该像与馆内其他早王朝坐像，证明其早期代表性及相对不可替代性；比较结果不同会改变馆内优先级。
missing.en: Missing MFA documentation comparing it with other Early Dynastic seated figures in the collection and establishing its early representativeness and relative irreplaceability; a different comparison would change institutional priority.

missing.zh: 缺MFA当前展厅及在展状态的官方确认；不同的在展状态会改变现场可见性判断。
missing.en: Missing official confirmation of the current gallery and display status at MFA; a different display status would change the assessment of on-site visibility.

top_missing_zh: 该坐像的确切年代、身份、墓葬语境及其相对于MFA早王朝坐像的代表性尚无权威资料支持。
top_missing_en: Authoritative support is missing for the statue's precise date, identity, funerary context, and representativeness relative to MFA's Early Dynastic seated figures.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或考古资料确认Tjetety的身份、铭文、确切年代、墓葬语境及小像的保存完整程度；这些事实若不同，会改变其早王朝历史重要性。
missing.en: Missing museum or archaeological documentation confirming Tjetety's identity, inscriptions, precise date, funerary context, and the statuette's degree of preservation; different answers would change its Early Dynastic historical significance.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方资料比较该小像与其他早期坐姿人物像，证明其相对于4411等同类对象的独特性或不可替代性；比较结果不同会改变馆内优先级。
missing.en: Missing MFA documentation comparing this statuette with other early seated figures and establishing its distinctiveness or irreplaceability relative to comparable objects such as 4411; a different comparison would change institutional priority.

missing.zh: 缺MFA当前展厅及在展状态的官方确认；不同的在展状态会改变现场可见性判断。
missing.en: Missing official confirmation of the current gallery and display status at MFA; a different display status would change the assessment of on-site visibility.

top_missing_zh: Tjetety的身份、铭文、墓葬语境及其相对于其他早期坐姿人物像的独特性尚无馆方或考古资料支持。
top_missing_en: Museum or archaeological support is missing for Tjetety's identity, inscriptions, funerary context, and distinctiveness relative to other early seated figures.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或考古资料确认青年像的确切年代、人物身份、墓葬语境、木材种类及保存状况；这些事实若不同，会改变其古王国木雕的历史与稀缺性判断。
missing.en: Missing museum or archaeological documentation confirming the statue's precise date, sitter's identity, funerary context, wood species, and condition; different answers would change the assessment of its historical and rarity value as an Old Kingdom wooden sculpture.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方资料比较该木雕与馆内其他古王国人物木雕，证明其题材确属可替代的常见类型；比较结果不同会改变馆内优先级。
missing.en: Missing MFA documentation comparing this wooden figure with other Old Kingdom wooden human sculptures and establishing that its subject is a common, substitutable type; a different comparison would change institutional priority.

missing.zh: 缺MFA当前展厅及在展状态的官方确认；不同的在展状态会改变现场可见性判断。
missing.en: Missing official confirmation of the current gallery and display status at MFA; a different display status would change the assessment of on-site visibility.

top_missing_zh: 该木雕的确切年代、人物身份、墓葬语境、保存状况及其与MFA同类木雕的比较位置尚无权威资料支持。
top_missing_en: Authoritative support is missing for the statue's precise date, identity, funerary context, condition, and comparative position among similar wooden sculptures at MFA.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或学术来源对该残件确为国王登复合雕像面部、而非仅为早王朝人物头像的确认；若人物身份不同，其稀有性与历史地位依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing a museum or scholarly confirmation that this fragment is specifically the face from a composite statue of King Den, rather than merely an Early Dynastic royal or human head; a different identification would change the basis for its rarity and historical importance.

missing.zh: 缺该残件的考古出土地点、组合雕像重建关系及出土语境；这些资料决定其是否能支撑早王朝王权肖像与MFA埃及考古叙事中的高位。
missing.en: Missing the archaeological findspot, reconstruction of its relationship to the composite statue, and excavation context; these determine whether it supports a high position in the Early Dynastic royal-portrait and MFA Egypt narratives.

top_missing_zh: 缺权威来源确认其为国王登复合雕像面部及相关考古语境。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of its identification as the face from a composite statue of King Den and its archaeological context.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录确认该对象是弗朗茨·马克本人创作的《Reconciliation》木版画，而非复制品、后印本或归于其工作室的版本；归属不同会改变其艺术史地位。
missing.en: Missing a museum record confirming that this is Franz Marc’s own woodblock print Reconciliation, rather than a reproduction, later impression, or workshop-related version; a different attribution would change its art-historical standing.

missing.zh: 缺版次、印制状态、尺寸及印数信息；若属于罕见状态或极少存世的版本，其不可替代性判断可能改变。
missing.en: Missing edition, state, dimensions, and surviving-impression information; if it is a rare state or an exceptionally scarce impression, its distinctiveness assessment could change.

top_missing_zh: 缺该版画的权威归属及版次/状态信息。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative attribution and edition/state information for the print.

missing.zh: 缺这件石英岩头像所表现王后的具体身份及馆方/学术归属；若并非中王国王后肖像，其历史地位和同类代表性会改变。
missing.en: Missing the specific identity of the queen depicted and the museum or scholarly attribution; if it is not a Middle Kingdom queen portrait, its historical importance and category representativeness would change.

missing.zh: 缺考古出土地、原属纪念物或墓葬、以及相关发掘语境；这些资料决定其是否具有超出一般残件的考古价值。
missing.en: Missing the archaeological findspot, original monument or tomb association, and excavation context; these determine whether it has archaeological significance beyond that of an ordinary fragment.

top_missing_zh: 缺王后身份与考古语境的权威确认。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of the queen’s identity and archaeological context.

missing.zh: 缺馆方记录确认该作品是1815年特伦布的完成作品，而非复制本、草稿或同题材版本；作品性质不同会直接改变其在美国历史绘画中的地位。
missing.en: Missing a museum record confirming that this is Trumbull’s completed 1815 painting rather than a copy, study, or another version of the subject; the object’s status would directly affect its position in American history painting.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸、收藏史及与特伦布同题材其他版本的关系；这些资料影响其是否为该历史叙事的关键范例。
missing.en: Missing dimensions, provenance, and its relationship to Trumbull’s other versions of the subject; these affect whether it is a key example of this historical narrative.

top_missing_zh: 缺馆方确认作品版本性质及其与特伦布其他版本的关系。
top_missing_en: Missing museum confirmation of the version’s status and its relationship to Trumbull’s other versions.

missing.zh: 缺该挂毯组的作者或作坊、年代、制作地点、材质、尺寸及馆藏号；目前资料不足以确认其是否属于具有相应历史地位的大型欧洲宗教挂毯组。
missing.en: Missing the maker or workshop, date, place of production, materials, dimensions, and accession number; the current record does not establish whether it is a large European religious tapestry group with the historical standing implied by the tier.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或学术来源对该组具体叙事内容、完整性及入藏背景的确认；若对象并非完整或重要的宗教叙事组，其代表性和现场价值依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing museum or scholarly confirmation of the group’s specific narrative content, completeness, and acquisition context; if it is not a complete or historically important religious narrative group, the basis for its representativeness and visual impact would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺作者、年代、制作背景及馆藏记录，无法确认其是否为重要的宗教叙事挂毯组。
top_missing_en: Missing maker, date, production context, and collection documentation needed to establish whether this is an important religious narrative tapestry group.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或考古学来源对头像确为国王卡塞凯姆威的确认，以及其与具体纪念物的关系；若归属不同，其早王朝王室肖像的历史地位会改变。
missing.en: Missing museum or archaeological confirmation that the head depicts King Khasekhemwy and documentation of its association with a specific monument; a different attribution would change its historical standing as an Early Dynastic royal portrait.

missing.zh: 缺出土地、发掘记录及原始组合关系；这些资料决定其是否能支撑高等级的埃及考古叙事价值。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, excavation record, and original assemblage relationship; these determine whether it supports the high level of Egyptological narrative value implied by the tier.

top_missing_zh: 缺卡塞凯姆威身份及考古出土语境的权威确认。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative confirmation of the Khasekhemwy identification and archaeological context.

missing.zh: 缺该罐的考古出土地、年代依据及发掘语境；若不是具有明确前王朝语境的黑顶陶器，其历史解释力和代表性会改变。
missing.en: Missing the archaeological findspot, dating basis, and excavation context; if it lacks a clear Predynastic context, its historical interpretive value and representativeness would change.

missing.zh: 缺公羊形象的馆方或学术鉴定、器物尺寸及保存状态；若图像或器形识别不同，其在前王朝黑顶陶器中的独特性会改变。
missing.en: Missing museum or scholarly identification of the ram figure, along with dimensions and condition; a different reading of the imagery or vessel form would change its distinctiveness among Predynastic black-topped pottery.

top_missing_zh: 缺考古语境及公羊图像鉴定。
top_missing_en: Missing the archaeological context and identification of the ram imagery.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或学术来源确认该画确为提埃坡罗本人1745年的完成作品，而非归属不确定的素描、工作稿或工作室作品；归属和作品性质不同会改变其大师代表性依据。
missing.en: Missing museum or scholarly confirmation that this is a finished work by Tiepolo from 1745, rather than an uncertainly attributed sketch, study, or workshop work; a different attribution or object status would change the basis for its master-level representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、委托或原始收藏背景及作品在提埃坡罗创作中的位置；这些资料影响其是否为具有较高艺术史地位的寓意画。
missing.en: Missing dimensions, commission or original-collection context, and the work’s place in Tiepolo’s oeuvre; these affect whether it is an allegorical painting of substantial art-historical standing.

top_missing_zh: 缺提埃坡罗本人归属及作品在其创作中的位置。
top_missing_en: Missing confirmation of Tiepolo’s authorship and the work’s place in his oeuvre.

missing.zh: 缺馆藏号、标题对应的具体挂毯组、年代、制作地点及材质；目前无法确认其是否为具有相应规模和历史地位的欧洲挂毯组。
missing.en: Missing the accession number, the specific tapestry group corresponding to the title, date, place of production, and materials; the current record does not establish whether it is a European tapestry group of the implied scale and historical standing.

missing.zh: 缺Hendrik van der Cammen的作者归属依据及其与该挂毯组的关系；若为作坊归属或艺术家姓名误识，其类别代表性会改变。
missing.en: Missing the basis for attributing the group to Hendrik van der Cammen and documentation of his relationship to it; if the attribution is to a workshop or the artist is misidentified, its category representativeness would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺具体馆藏记录、年代材质及艺术家归属依据。
top_missing_en: Missing the specific collection record, date, materials, and basis for the artist attribution.

missing.zh: 缺馆方或考古来源确认该片确属梅胡墓捕鱼场景，并说明其在墓葬中的原始位置；若场景或墓葬归属不同，其古王国墓葬艺术代表性会改变。
missing.en: Missing museum or archaeological confirmation that the fragment belongs to the fishing scene from Mehu’s tomb, including its original position in the tomb; a different scene or tomb attribution would change its representativeness for Old Kingdom funerary art.

missing.zh: 缺出土地、发掘记录及与其他墓葬构件的关系；这些资料决定其是否具有明确考古语境而非一般局部浮雕的价值。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, excavation record, and relationship to other tomb elements; these determine whether it has a defined archaeological context rather than merely the value of a generic relief fragment.

top_missing_zh: 缺梅胡墓捕鱼场景归属及其考古语境。
top_missing_en: Missing confirmation of the Mehu-tomb attribution and archaeological context.

missing.zh: 缺“Pseudo groupe of Penmeru”所指人物、群像构成及馆方/学术术语依据；若对象性质或人物归属不同，其古王国墓葬雕塑代表性会改变。
missing.en: Missing the identity of the person or persons referred to by “Pseudo groupe of Penmeru,” the group’s composition, and the museum or scholarly basis for the term; a different object type or attribution would change its representativeness for Old Kingdom funerary sculpture.

missing.zh: 缺出土地、墓葬关系、发掘语境及具体年代依据；这些资料决定其是否能支撑关于古王国丧葬实践的历史解释。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, tomb association, excavation context, and specific dating basis; these determine whether it can support the historical interpretation of Old Kingdom funerary practice.

top_missing_zh: 缺伪群像术语、人物归属及考古墓葬语境的权威说明。
top_missing_en: Missing authoritative documentation of the pseudo-group terminology, attribution, and archaeological tomb context.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方馆藏记录对对象身份、确切年代、材质及器形的确认；若其并非约公元前3000年的早王朝油膏器，年代与类型代表性依据会改变。

top_missing_zh: 缺MFA同类早王朝石制油膏器的完整比较及馆内相对排名。
top_missing_en: A complete comparison with MFA's Early Dynastic stone ointment vessels and its relative standing within the museum is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对伊西斯与荷鲁斯组合、确切年代及图像身份的确认；若题名或年代归属不同，宗教史解释和代表性判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA's official confirmation of the Isis-and-Horus group, its precise date, and its iconographic identification; a different title or dating would change the religious-historical interpretation and representativeness assessment.

missing.zh: 缺该件的出土地点、考古语境或明确入藏来源；若有重要考古语境，可能改变其在MFA埃及收藏中的地位。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, archaeological context, or documented acquisition provenance; an important archaeological context could change its standing within MFA's Egyptian collection.

missing.zh: 缺MFA埃及晚期青铜神像的同类数量、比较对象及馆内相对排名，无法验证其是否具有超出常规品的不可替代性。
missing.en: Missing the number of comparable Late Period Egyptian bronze divine figures at MFA, the comparison set, and the object's relative rank, so its distinctiveness beyond a conventional example cannot be verified.

top_missing_en: The number of comparable Late Period Egyptian bronze divine figures at MFA, the comparison set, and the object's relative rank are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录对库伊恩胡夫身份、确切年代及雕像类型的确认；若不属于早期王朝私人石雕像，当前历史代表性依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA's official confirmation of Khuienkhufu's identity, precise date, and statue type; if it is not an Early Dynastic private stone statue, the basis for its historical representativeness would change.

missing.zh: 缺出土地点、墓葬或遗址语境及入藏来源；明确的考古语境可能显著改变其在MFA埃及考古叙事中的重要性。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, tomb or site context, and acquisition provenance; a documented archaeological context could materially change its importance within MFA's Egyptian archaeological narrative.

missing.zh: 缺MFA早期王朝私人石雕像的完整比较及馆内相对排名，无法核实其是否为同类中的突出对象。
missing.en: Missing a complete comparison with MFA's Early Dynastic private stone statues and its relative standing within the museum, so it cannot be verified whether it is an outstanding example of its type.

top_missing_zh: 缺MFA早期王朝私人石雕像的完整比较及馆内相对排名。

missing.en: Missing MFA's official confirmation of the leopard's association with Thutmose IV and the royal context, its precise date, and the relationship between its components; if the royal association or dating is not sustained, the current basis for high historical significance and rarity would change.

missing.zh: 缺该件的出土地点、考古发掘记录、原始使用语境及入藏来源。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, excavation documentation, original use context, and acquisition provenance.

missing.zh: 缺MFA埃及动物木雕及王室相关木雕的同类数量、比较对象和馆内相对排名，无法证明其确属全馆同类中的突出或不可替代对象。
missing.en: Missing the number of comparable Egyptian animal and royal-related wooden sculptures at MFA, the comparison set, and the object's relative rank, so it cannot be shown to be an outstanding or irreplaceable example within the museum.

top_missing_zh: 缺官方资料确认其与图特摩斯四世及王室语境的关系。
top_missing_en: Official documentation confirming its association with Thutmose IV and the royal context is missing.

missing.zh: 缺该雕像的出土地点、墓葬语境、发掘记录及入藏来源；明确考古语境可能改变其在MFA埃及收藏中的重要性。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, tomb context, excavation record, and acquisition provenance; a documented archaeological context could change its importance within MFA's Egyptian collection.

missing.zh: 缺MFA古王国石灰岩雕像的完整比较及馆内相对排名，无法核实其是否确为同类中最具典范性者。

top_missing_zh: 缺MFA古王国石灰岩雕像的完整比较及馆内相对排名。

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认Ptahneferti身份、少年形象的解释及确切年代；若题名、人物身份或年代不同，当前类型和历史价值判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA's official confirmation of Ptahneferti's identity, the interpretation of the youthful figure, and the precise date; a different title, identity, or dating would change the current assessment of its typological and historical value.

missing.zh: 缺出土地点、墓葬语境、发掘记录及入藏来源。
missing.en: Missing the findspot, tomb context, excavation record, and acquisition provenance.

top_missing_en: A complete comparison with MFA's Old Kingdom figure sculptures and its relative standing within the museum are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认“拟人化地产”题名、图像含义、确切年代及其在墓葬组合中的功能；若题名或功能解释不同，现有社会史代表性依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA's official confirmation of the title 'Personified estates,' its iconographic meaning, precise date, and function within the funerary ensemble; a different title or functional interpretation would change the current basis for social-historical representativeness.

missing.zh: 缺出土地点、墓葬语境、所属墓主或建筑组合及入藏来源。

missing.zh: 缺MFA古王国石灰岩小型雕像的完整比较及馆内相对排名，无法验证其与同组对象的实际重复程度。
missing.en: Missing a complete comparison with MFA's small Old Kingdom limestone sculptures and its relative standing within the museum, so the actual degree of duplication with the comparison group cannot be verified.

top_missing_zh: 缺该件在墓葬组合中的确切功能及考古语境。
top_missing_en: Its precise function within the funerary ensemble and its archaeological context are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA北方巴洛克及佛兰德风俗画的同类数量、比较对象和馆内相对排名。

top_missing_zh: 缺MFA官方对小戴维·泰尼尔斯作者归属及作品年代的确认。

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认《历代帝王像》的作者归属性质（真迹、传为、归于或后世摹本）、完整程度及确切年代；这些差异会直接改变其在中国绘画史中的地位。
missing.en: Missing MFA's official record specifying the nature of the attribution of Picture of Ancient Emperors—autograph, attributed, workshop, or later copy—as well as its completeness and precise date; these differences would directly change its position in Chinese painting history.

missing.zh: 缺该卷的来源、流传记录、入藏背景及相关学术鉴定史。
missing.en: Missing the scroll's provenance, ownership history, acquisition context, and relevant scholarly attribution history.

missing.zh: 缺MFA中国古代人物画、帝王图及唐代绘画的完整比较和馆内相对排名，无法核实其是否属于支撑MFA中国绘画身份的核心作品。
missing.en: Missing a complete comparison with MFA's ancient Chinese figure paintings, imperial portraiture, and Tang-period paintings, together with its relative standing within the museum, so it cannot be verified whether it is a core work supporting MFA's identity in Chinese painting.

top_missing_zh: 缺MFA官方明确的作者归属性质及作品完整程度。
top_missing_en: MFA's explicit official attribution status and confirmation of the work's completeness are missing.

missing.zh: 缺该组壁毯的MFA官方馆藏记录、馆藏号、具体组成年份和件数，以及对彼得·库克·范·阿尔斯特的作者归属确认；若并非其作品或并非约1520年的重要组作，当前代表性依据会改变。

missing.zh: 缺壁毯的尺寸、织造地点或作坊、保存状态、完整来源及原始委托或使用语境。

missing.zh: 缺MFA欧洲文艺复兴历史叙事壁毯的同类数量、比较对象和馆内相对排名，无法证明其是馆内同类的首要代表。

missing.zh: 缺作者或作坊归属、织造地点、尺寸、保存状态及完整来源；这些资料决定其是否为15世纪早期丝绸壁毯中的突出实例。
missing.en: Missing the attribution to an artist or workshop, place of production, dimensions, condition, and complete provenance; these facts determine whether it is an outstanding example of fifteenth-century silk tapestry.

missing.zh: 缺MFA欧洲历史叙事壁毯的同类数量、比较对象和馆内相对排名，无法支撑其当前高不可替代性判断。
missing.en: Missing the number of comparable European historical-narrative tapestries at MFA, the comparison set, and the object's relative standing within the museum, so its current high distinctiveness assessment cannot be supported.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认《圣保罗殉道》的馆藏号、具体组作、完整程度及1460年日期；若对象身份或年代不同，当前历史和工艺价值依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA's official record confirming the accession number, specific group, completeness, and 1460 date of The Martyrdom of Saint Paul; a different object identity or date would change the current basis for its historical and technical significance.

missing.zh: 缺作者或作坊归属、织造地点、尺寸、保存状态、完整来源及原始委托或使用语境。

missing.zh: 缺MFA欧洲历史叙事壁毯的同类数量、比较对象和馆内相对排名，无法证明其在MFA壁毯收藏中属于高位代表。
missing.en: Missing the number of comparable European historical-narrative tapestries at MFA, the comparison set, and the object's relative standing within the museum, so its high representational standing in MFA's tapestry collection cannot be demonstrated.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方馆藏记录对博韦工场归属、确切制作年代及作品组套关系的确认；若并非该工场原作或属于罕见完整组套，历史重要性与不可替代性判断会改变。

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况及图像资料，无法判断其视觉规模和工艺表现是否足以区别于MFA同类壁毯。
missing.en: Missing dimensions, condition, and image documentation needed to determine whether its visual scale and workmanship distinguish it from comparable MFA tapestries.

missing.zh: 缺其在MFA同类藏品中的比较位置及展陈/馆方重点地位。
missing.en: Missing its comparative position among MFA holdings and evidence of display or curatorial prominence.

top_missing_zh: 缺MFA官方记录及同类比较，无法确认该壁毯是否只是常规装饰性藏品，还是具有罕见组套或馆内代表性。
top_missing_en: Missing MFA documentation and collection-level comparison needed to determine whether this is a routine decorative textile or a rare, representative set component.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认其确切年代、制作地/工坊及纹章所对应人物或家族；这些信息若显示其属于重要历史人物或关键中世纪壁毯体系，会改变历史意义判断。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the precise date, place/workshop, and the person or family represented by the arms; identifying an important historical patron or major tapestry program would change its significance.

missing.zh: 缺展陈状态及其在MFA中世纪壁毯藏品中的比较位置。

top_missing_zh: 缺纹章身份、原始组套及官方年代/工坊确认；这些信息可能决定它是普通残片还是具有重要历史指向的遗存。
top_missing_en: Missing identification of the arms, original set, and official date/workshop attribution; these could determine whether it is an ordinary fragment or a historically important survivor.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认其文化归属、制作年代及雕像功能；不同的文化归属或年代可能显著改变其古代美洲艺术史地位。

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况和图像资料，无法判断其视觉表现是否达到组内代表性水平。

top_missing_en: Missing official confirmation of cultural attribution and archaeological context, which directly affects whether this is a routine ancient American sculpture or a highly representative object.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方馆藏记录、馆藏号及考古发掘资料对人物身份、出土地和组合关系的确认。

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、材质/技术、保存状况及图像资料，无法核实其作为古王国王室雕塑典范的具体依据。
missing.en: Missing dimensions, material/technique, condition, and image documentation needed to substantiate its status as a major Old Kingdom royal sculpture.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方资料确认其核心展品或馆内重点地位，以及其在古王国王权雕塑中的比较位置。

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认Henry Newell的身份、模型所代表的船只及制作归属；若关联重要船舶或历史事件，意义判断会改变。

missing.zh: 缺模型尺寸、比例、制作技术、保存状况和图像资料，无法判断其工艺与视觉表现是否在同类中突出。
missing.en: Missing model dimensions, scale, technique, condition, and image documentation needed to determine whether its craftsmanship and visual impact are exceptional among comparable models.

missing.zh: 缺来源/委托背景、展陈状态及其在MFA十九世纪美国船模中的比较位置。
missing.en: Missing provenance/commissioning context, display status, and comparative position among MFA's nineteenth-century American ship models.

top_missing_zh: 缺模型所代表船只和作者身份的官方确认，以及与同类船模的馆藏比较。

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认塞赫迈特身份、确切年代及其制作/改刻情况。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the Sekhmet identification, precise date, and any evidence of manufacture or recutting history.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、保存状况、图像资料及是否带有铭文或特殊图像特征，无法判断其是否超出MFA同类神像的常规水平。
missing.en: Missing dimensions, condition, images, and information on inscriptions or distinctive iconography needed to determine whether it exceeds the ordinary level of comparable MFA statues.

missing.zh: 缺出土/流传来源、展陈状态及其在MFA塞赫迈特和新王国神祇雕塑中的比较位置。

top_missing_zh: 缺尺寸、铭文/特殊特征及馆内同类比较，无法直接支撑其高于常规塞赫迈特像的代表性。
top_missing_en: Missing dimensions, inscriptions/distinctive features, and collection-level comparison needed to substantiate representativeness above a routine Sekhmet statue.

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认该物件的确切功能（标签、护符或其他遗物）、文化归属及公元前四千纪年代。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the object's precise function, cultural attribution, and fourth-millennium BCE date.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、象牙材质鉴定、制作技术、保存状况及图像资料，无法判断其形式和工艺是否具有突出性。

missing.zh: 缺出土地点、考古语境、来源及其在MFA早期埃及小型遗物中的比较位置。
missing.en: Missing findspot, archaeological context, provenance, and comparative position among MFA's early Egyptian small objects.

top_missing_zh: 缺物件功能、文化归属和考古语境的官方确认；这些信息决定其早期埃及研究价值是否超出一般小型遗物。

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认奈芙蒂斯身份、确切年代及青铜制作归属。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the Nephthys identification, precise date, and bronze attribution.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、制作技术、保存状况、铭文或特殊图像特征，无法判断其是否只是常规小型神像。

missing.zh: 缺出土/流传来源、葬仪语境、展陈状态及其在MFA埃及神祇雕塑中的比较位置。

missing.zh: 缺MFA官方记录确认奥西里斯身份、确切年代及青铜制作归属。
missing.en: Missing MFA confirmation of the Osiris identification, precise date, and bronze attribution.

missing.zh: 缺尺寸、制作技术、保存状况、铭文或特殊图像特征，无法判断其是否在同类青铜神像中具有突出性。

missing.zh: 缺出土/流传来源、葬仪语境、展陈状态及其在MFA埃及神祇雕塑中的比较位置。

top_missing_zh: 缺官方语境资料和同类比较，无法确认其奥西里斯图像是否具有足以区别于常规青铜神像的特殊历史或形式价值。
top_missing_en: Missing official contextual documentation and collection-level comparison needed to determine whether its Osiris image has historical or formal significance beyond a routine bronze statue.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方记录对阿努比斯像确切年代、制作区域/时期及用途的确认；若并非约公元前1000年的埃及葬仪青铜神像，历史与教育价值判断会改变。

missing.en: MFA confirmation of its gallery placement or role in the collection narrative is missing; if it is a core Egyptian-art display rather than a routine stored object, the Tier assessment could change.

top_missing_zh: 缺该件在MFA埃及艺术同类藏品中的实际排名与稀缺性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the object's actual rank and rarity among MFA's Egyptian-art holdings is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方对巴鸟确切年代、木材类型、制作区域及葬仪用途的确认；若对象年代或功能不同，当前历史叙事和Tier依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA confirmation of the ba-bird's exact date, wood type, production region, and funerary function is missing; if its date or function differs, the historical narrative and Tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该件在MFA古埃及葬仪遗物中的同类数量、相对排名及稀有性信息；现有组内代表性不能代替全馆比较。
missing.en: Information is missing on the number, relative rank, and rarity of comparable funerary objects in MFA's Egyptian collection; the current within-list representation cannot substitute for a museum-wide comparison.

missing.zh: 缺MFA对其是否为埃及艺术核心展陈或具有特别考古语境的确认；这会影响其馆藏身份价值。
missing.en: MFA confirmation of whether it is a core Egyptian-art display or has a particularly significant archaeological context is missing; this would affect its institutional significance.

top_missing_zh: 缺该木制巴鸟在MFA古埃及葬仪遗物中的全馆相对排名与稀有性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the object's museum-wide rank and rarity among MFA's Egyptian funerary objects is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方确认其确为猴形 alabastron，并说明确切年代、产地/文化及容器用途；这些事实若不同，会改变其古代地中海艺术史价值。
missing.en: MFA confirmation that it is indeed a monkey-shaped alabastron, together with its exact date, place/culture of production, and vessel function, is missing; different answers would change its art-historical significance.

missing.zh: 缺该猴形容器在MFA古代地中海藏品中的同类数量、相对排名及存世稀缺性；这直接关系到其所谓唯一性和不可替代性。
missing.en: Information is missing on the number of comparable objects at MFA, this object's relative standing, and its rarity among surviving examples; this directly bears on its claimed uniqueness and distinctiveness.

top_missing_zh: 缺猴形 alabastron 在MFA同类藏品中的相对排名及存世稀缺性证据。
top_missing_en: Evidence of the monkey-shaped alabastron's relative rank among MFA comparables and its rarity among surviving examples is missing.

missing.zh: 缺该船模所代表的确切船型、建造者/设计者、制作地点及用途；若它对应重要船型、人物或历史事件，Tier依据会显著改变。
missing.en: The exact vessel type, maker/designer, place of production, and purpose represented by the model are missing; if it relates to an important vessel type, person, or historical event, the Tier basis would change substantially.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方确认其材质、年代精度及尺寸；尤其是名称中的“copper”未出现在库中metadata字段，需核实其是否确为铜制。
missing.en: MFA confirmation of its material, dating precision, and dimensions is missing; notably, “copper” appears in the name but not in the stored metadata fields and needs verification.

missing.zh: 缺其在MFA欧洲船模藏品中的同类数量、年代排名和稀有性信息；现有“年代最早”的判断未有全馆比较依据。
missing.en: Information is missing on the number of comparable European ship models at MFA, its chronological rank, and its rarity; the claim that it is the earliest lacks a museum-wide comparative basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺船模所对应的具体船型、历史语境及其在MFA船模中的实际排名。
top_missing_en: The specific vessel type, historical context, and actual rank among MFA's ship models are missing.

missing.zh: 缺该模型所代表的确切船型、建造者/设计者、制作地点及用途；若其与重要船舶或历史事件有关，当前Tier可能改变。
missing.en: The exact vessel type, maker/designer, place of production, and purpose represented by the model are missing; if it is associated with an important ship or historical event, the current Tier could change.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方对1875年断代、木材材质和尺寸的确认；年代或尺寸若不同，会影响其航海技术史和工艺史价值。
missing.en: MFA confirmation of the 1875 date, wooden material, and dimensions is missing; different dating or dimensions would affect its technological and craft-historical value.

missing.zh: 缺其在MFA欧洲船模中的同类数量、相对排名及稀有性信息；“重复度最高”尚未由全馆藏品比较支持。
missing.en: Information is missing on the number of comparable European ship models at MFA, its relative standing, and rarity; the claim of highest duplication is not supported by a museum-wide comparison.

top_missing_zh: 缺该模型的具体船型与历史语境，以及其在MFA船模中的全馆相对排名。
top_missing_en: The model's specific vessel type and historical context, as well as its museum-wide rank among MFA ship models, are missing.

missing.zh: 缺该模型所代表的确切船型、建造者/设计者、制作地点及用途；这些信息若显示其对应重要船舶或技术史节点，Tier依据会改变。
missing.en: The exact vessel type, maker/designer, place of production, and purpose represented by the model are missing; if these identify an important vessel or technological-historical moment, the Tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方对1800年断代、木材材质和尺寸的确认；这些事实会影响其年代代表性及工艺史价值。
missing.en: MFA confirmation of the 1800 date, wooden material, and dimensions is missing; these facts would affect its chronological representativeness and craft-historical value.

missing.zh: 缺其在MFA欧洲船模中的同类数量、相对排名及稀有性信息；现有“年代居中、代表性居中”没有全馆比较依据。
missing.en: Information is missing on the number of comparable European ship models at MFA, its relative standing, and rarity; the current claims of middle chronological position and representation lack a museum-wide basis.

top_missing_zh: 缺该模型的具体船型与历史用途，以及其在MFA船模中的全馆相对排名。
top_missing_en: The model's specific vessel type and historical use, as well as its museum-wide rank among MFA ship models, are missing.

missing.zh: 缺艺术家归属、画派/地域及题材来源的馆方或学术确认；若并非现有假设下的17世纪欧洲宗教画作，Tier判断会改变。
missing.en: Curatorial or scholarly confirmation of the artist attribution, school/region, and subject provenance is missing; if it is not the presumed seventeenth-century European religious painting, the Tier assessment would change.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸、委托或原属收藏背景，以及在同类作品中的艺术史地位；这些信息决定它是否只是常规宗教画，还是具有较高不可替代性。
missing.en: The dimensions, commission or original-collection history, and art-historical standing among comparable works are missing; these facts determine whether it is a routine religious painting or unusually distinctive.

missing.zh: 缺其在MFA欧洲宗教绘画中的同类数量与相对排名；“组内唯一”不能证明它在全馆同类中独特。
missing.en: The number and relative rank of comparable European religious paintings at MFA are missing; being unique within the supplied group does not establish distinctiveness museum-wide.

top_missing_zh: 缺艺术家归属及其在MFA同类宗教绘画中的全馆相对地位。
top_missing_en: The artist attribution and the object's museum-wide standing among comparable religious paintings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方或权威图录对牟利羅归属、创作年代和作品完整性的确认；若为工作坊、仿作或归属有争议，当前B级依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA or authoritative catalogue confirmation of the Murillo attribution, date, and completeness of the work is missing; if it is a workshop piece, copy, or disputed attribution, the current Tier basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该画在牟利羅作品及MFA西班牙黄金时代绘画中的相对排名、代表性和稀缺性信息；现有“组内第3”不足以支持全馆不可替代性判断。
missing.en: Information is missing on the painting's relative rank, representativeness, and rarity within Murillo's works and MFA's Spanish Golden Age holdings; the stated third-place group ranking is insufficient for a museum-wide distinctiveness assessment.

missing.zh: 缺馆方确认其展陈位置及在MFA古典绘画叙事中的实际作用；若为核心展品而非一般藏品，Tier判断可能改变。
missing.en: Curatorial confirmation of its display location and actual role in MFA's Old Master narrative is missing; if it is a core display rather than a routine holding, the Tier assessment could change.

top_missing_zh: 缺牟利羅归属的权威确认及该画在MFA西班牙绘画藏品中的实际排名。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the Murillo attribution and the painting's actual rank among MFA's Spanish holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺艺术家/作坊归属、确切制作地域及年代范围的馆方或学术确认；这些事实若不同，会改变其作为中世纪中欧宗教画的历史价值。
missing.en: Curatorial or scholarly confirmation of the artist/workshop attribution, exact region of production, and date range is missing; different answers would change its historical value as a Central European medieval religious painting.

missing.zh: 缺作品尺寸、原始用途或委托背景，以及同类作品的存世稀缺性；这些信息决定其是否达到“稀有”及高历史教育价值的依据。
missing.en: The dimensions, original use or commission context, and scarcity among surviving comparable works are missing; these facts determine whether the claims of rarity and high historical-educational value are supported.

missing.zh: 缺其在MFA中世纪中欧宗教绘画中的同类数量与相对排名；现有组内唯一不能证明其全馆不可替代性。
missing.en: The number and relative rank of comparable Central European medieval religious paintings at MFA are missing; being unique within the supplied group does not establish museum-wide distinctiveness.

top_missing_zh: 缺作品归属、产地的权威确认及其在MFA中世纪宗教画中的全馆相对排名。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the attribution and place of production, along with its museum-wide rank among MFA's medieval religious paintings, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方或权威图录对埃尔·格列柯归属、1609年断代及作品完整性的确认；若归属或完整性不同，A等级的核心依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA or authoritative catalogue confirmation of the El Greco attribution, 1609 date, and completeness of the work is missing; if the attribution or completeness differs, the core basis for Tier A would change.

missing.zh: 缺该肖像在埃尔·格列柯作品及MFA西班牙黄金时代绘画中的艺术史排名、代表性与稀缺性信息；“组内第1”不足以证明其全馆不可替代性。
missing.en: Information is missing on the portrait's art-historical rank, representativeness, and rarity within El Greco's works and MFA's Spanish Golden Age holdings; being first within the supplied group does not establish museum-wide distinctiveness.

missing.zh: 缺馆方确认其是否为核心展陈及其在MFA古典绘画叙事中的具体地位；这直接关系到其作为馆藏亮点的依据。
missing.en: Curatorial confirmation of whether it is a core display and of its specific role in MFA's Old Master narrative is missing; this directly affects the basis for treating it as a collection highlight.

top_missing_zh: 缺埃尔·格列柯归属的权威确认及该肖像在MFA西班牙绘画中的全馆相对地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the El Greco attribution and the portrait's museum-wide standing among MFA's Spanish holdings are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方确认William Sergeant Kendall归属、1900年断代、肖像对象身份及作品用途；若艺术家归属或对象身份不同，美国艺术史价值会改变。
missing.en: MFA confirmation of the William Sergeant Kendall attribution, 1900 date, sitter's identity, and purpose of the work is missing; different attribution or sitter information would change its significance in American art history.

missing.zh: 缺该雕塑在MFA美国艺术藏品中的同类数量、相对排名、委托背景及稀缺性信息；“组内唯一”不足以证明其全馆代表性。
missing.en: Information is missing on the number of comparable objects at MFA, its relative rank, commission context, and rarity within the museum's American-art holdings; being unique within the supplied group does not establish museum-wide representativeness.

top_missing_zh: 缺该雕塑在MFA美国艺术藏品中的实际排名及其委托或人物背景。
top_missing_en: The sculpture's actual rank within MFA's American-art holdings and its commission or sitter context are missing.

missing.zh: 缺MFA馆方或权威图录对博斯归属、1496年断代及三联画完整性的确认；若是作坊作品、残缺组合或归属有争议，A等级依据会改变。
missing.en: MFA or authoritative catalogue confirmation of the Bosch attribution, 1496 date, and completeness of the triptych is missing; if it is a workshop work, incomplete assemblage, or disputed attribution, the Tier A basis would change.

missing.zh: 缺该三联画在博斯作品及北方文艺复兴绘画中的艺术史排名、存世数量和稀缺性信息；这些事实直接决定其不可替代性。
missing.en: Information is missing on the triptych's art-historical rank, number of surviving examples, and rarity within Bosch's works and Northern Renaissance painting; these facts directly determine its distinctiveness.

missing.zh: 缺馆方确认其展陈位置及在MFA古典绘画叙事中的核心程度；若并非核心展品，当前A等级的馆藏身份依据会改变。
missing.en: Curatorial confirmation of its display location and degree of centrality in MFA's Old Master narrative is missing; if it is not a core display, the institutional basis for Tier A would change.

top_missing_zh: 缺博斯归属与三联画完整性的权威确认，以及其在北方文艺复兴藏品中的全馆相对地位。
top_missing_en: Authoritative confirmation of the Bosch attribution and triptych completeness, together with its museum-wide standing among Northern Renaissance holdings, is missing.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品标题、艺术家归属、1750 年断代和纸本材质的核实；若官网记录存在不同归属或断代，作品的历史重要性判断会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official verification of the title, artist attribution, 1750 date, and paper support; a different attribution or date in the museum record would change the assessment of the work’s historical importance.

missing.zh: 缺尼哈尔·昌德及本作在基什金格尔／拉贾斯坦细密画中的学术地位，以及本作相对于 MFA 同类藏品的具体排名依据；现有“组内居首”只有 AI 评分文字支持。
missing.en: Missing scholarly evidence for Nihâl Chand’s and this work’s position within Kishangarh/Rajasthani miniature painting, together with a concrete comparison showing its rank among MFA’s comparable holdings; the claim that it is the group leader is supported only by the prior AI scoring text.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅位置、当前展出状态和作品尺寸；这些事实会直接影响其在 MFA 现场可见度及其作为馆藏代表作的判断。
missing.en: Missing the MFA gallery location, current display status, and dimensions; these facts directly affect the assessment of its on-site visibility and representativeness within the MFA collection.

top_missing_zh: 缺本作相对于 MFA 同类印度细密画藏品的可核实比较排名，以及支持其“组内居首”和较高历史重要性的学术或馆方资料。
top_missing_en: Missing verifiable comparative evidence placing this work among MFA’s comparable Indian miniature holdings, along with scholarly or museum documentation supporting its claimed leading position and historical importance.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对作品标题、阿黛勒·罗曼尼归属、1808 年断代和油彩材质的核实；若馆方归属或断代不同，现有 Tier C 的历史定位依据会改变。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official verification of the title, Adèle Romany attribution, 1808 date, and oil-paint medium; a different museum attribution or date would change the basis for its historical placement at Tier C.

missing.zh: 缺阿黛勒·罗曼尼及本作在法国十九世纪女性艺术家、肖像画和沙龙艺术史中的可核实地位，以及本作与 MFA 同类肖像画的比较依据；现有“地位有限”和“相较组内法布尔肖像较弱”只有 AI 评分文字支持。
missing.en: Missing verifiable evidence for Adèle Romany’s and this work’s standing in the history of nineteenth-century French women artists, portraiture, and the Salon, as well as a comparison with MFA’s comparable portraits; the claims that her standing is limited and that this work is weaker than the Fabre portrait are supported only by the prior AI scoring text.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 对本作是否作为罗曼尼或十九世纪法国肖像画的重要例证展示或重点介绍的记录；若馆方定位显著不同，会影响其馆藏代表性判断。
missing.en: Missing MFA documentation of whether the work is displayed or highlighted as an important example of Romany’s work or nineteenth-century French portraiture; a substantially different museum positioning would affect its assessment as a representative holding.

top_missing_zh: 缺能证明阿黛勒·罗曼尼及本作历史地位、并将其与 MFA 同类法国十九世纪肖像画比较的馆方或学术资料。
top_missing_en: Missing museum or scholarly evidence establishing Adèle Romany’s and this work’s historical standing and comparing it with MFA’s other nineteenth-century French portraits.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方馆藏记录对《Street Singer》、爱德华·马奈归属、1862 年断代和油彩材质的核实；目前仅有 Wikidata 来源，尚未形成馆方证据链。
missing.en: Missing MFA’s official verification of Street Singer, the Édouard Manet attribution, the 1862 date, and the oil-paint medium; the record currently relies only on Wikidata and lacks a museum-sourced evidence chain.

missing.zh: 缺权威艺术史或马奈作品目录对本作在马奈创作生涯中的位置、艺术史重要性及其与“都市现代生活／绘画语言推进”关系的具体论证；现有打分依据不能作为外部事实来源。
missing.en: Missing authoritative art-historical or catalogue evidence establishing the work’s place in Manet’s career, its art-historical importance, and its specific relation to the development of urban modern-life painting and pictorial language; the existing scoring rationale cannot serve as an external factual source.

missing.zh: 缺 MFA 官方展厅位置、当前展出状态、尺寸及馆方对其作为法国现代绘画核心藏品的展示定位；这些事实直接影响其现场可见度和 MFA 身份代表性判断。
missing.en: Missing the MFA gallery location, current display status, dimensions, and the museum’s presentation of the work as a core holding of French modern painting; these facts directly affect its on-site visibility and representativeness of MFA’s institutional identity.

top_missing_zh: 缺 MFA 馆方记录及权威艺术史资料，证明这件具体的《Street Singer》在马奈作品序列和 MFA 法国现代绘画收藏中的核心地位。
top_missing_en: Missing MFA documentation and authoritative art-historical evidence establishing this specific Street Singer’s central place in Manet’s oeuvre and in MFA’s French modern-painting collection.
